title: A Child's Journey (Investigations)
summary: A Child's Journey is a global investigation that can be found on Frozen Mogo and Matron's Orphanage. There are eight parts that comprise this investigation. It is part of the Hope Burns Bright chapter in the Light and Rain story arc.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mogo Sprout

A Child's Journey is a global investigation that can be found on Frozen Mogo and Matron's Orphanage. There are eight parts that comprise this investigation. It is part of the Hope Burns Bright chapter in the Light and Rain story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: A young alien refugee on Mogo makes diary entries to chronicle their journey into darkness.

sections.title: Part 1: Bad Matron
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Region: Base of Mountain: Refugee Camp
Location: Behind the tent west of the destroyed wall of the Green Lantern Outpost.

Investigation: Kennik: " Other kids have been talking about something lately. They say the Matron is taking all of the kids here to the Orphanage, not just the actual orphans. No one has proof... yet. But I'm going to find the truth!"

sections.title: Part 2: Escape!
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Region: Base of Mountain: Red Lantern Encampment
Location: Just outside of the southernmost encampment, by the southeast corner.

Investigation: Kennik: " They heard about me snooping around and were going to take me away, but my Durlan friend warned me before they got to our tent. I ran away and wiggled out of a small hole in the fence before they could find me. It's cold and scary, but I need to stay free if I'm going to expose their crimes."

sections.title: Part 3: Hiding Out
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Region: Base of Mountain: Canyon Path
Location: Around the first rock coming from the Red Lantern area.

Investigation: Kennik: " I know I heard Papa's voice last night! He was calling my name - he escaped too! He's looking for me... but so are the Red Lanterns. The storm has helped me hide, but that won't last forever. I hope they don't get Papa... please don't get Papa!"

sections.title: Part 4: Papa's Camp
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Region: Base of Mountain: Canyon Path
Location: At the first dead end coming from the Red Lantern area.

Investigation: Kennik: " I think Papa's camp is around here somewhere, but he's just as good at hiding as I am... I can't find his trail anywhere! But the Red guys are still patrolling and hunting, and I heard one of them say there's two of us at large - that means Papa and me. We're both free... for now."

sections.title: Part 5: Red Lanterns!
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Region: Base of Mountain: Canyon Path
Location: At the final dead end coming from the Red Lantern area.

Investigation: Kennik: " Oh, grife! That Red Lantern that looks like a ball with arms and legs - I think he saw me! They know where I am, and the storm has cleared. I gotta find a new hiding place, fast... or they're gonna get me. I hope Papa's still free... and alive... cause I might not be much longer."

sections.title: Part 6: Bad Place
items: Zone: Matron's Orphanage
Region: Containment Level
Instance: Matron's Orphanage (Walk-In)
Location: At the A side, inside cell number 02 to the east.

Investigation: Kennik: " This is no orphanage - it's a prison. No, it's worse - they take kids away and they never come back. Everyone's scared... well, almost everyone. My new friend from Earth isn't scared of anything. Earth is where people like Batman and Superman and like... a dozen Green Lanterns live. She says the good guys will come and save us... I sure hope she's right!"

sections.title: Part 7: The Monster
items: Zone: Matron's Orphanage
Instance: Matron's Orphanage (Walk-In)
Location: Inside Bleez's room, behind some crates at the northeastern section.

Investigation: Kennik: " Grife... I saw the Matron's real face today. She got mad at the Boss Red Lantern and started to yell at him... and her disguise tech shut down. I knew she was doing terrible stuff to kids, but now I know she's a monster physically too. When I saw her real face... I got scared for the first time. Real scared."

sections.title: Part 8: Lost Friend
items: Zone: Matron's Orphanage
Instance: Matron's Orphanage (Walk-In)
Location: Inside the cell where Kennik was being held.

Investigation: Kennik: " Oh, no. They took the Earth girl away today. My only friend. She was so brave - everyone else freaks out when the guards come for them, but not her. She even bit one of them! I hope... when they come for me, I hope I can be that brave. And... I hope I see her again someday."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Guy Gardner, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Things got pretty rough out on Mogo for a while... hard times for a lot of people. But this kid? This kid's gonna be Green Lantern material when she grows up. Count on it!"

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with a Stabilizing Blue Lantern Energy catalyst.

sections.title: Trivia
items: These investigations are a sequel to the Tales of Kennik story blog.; In Tales of Kennik, it is revealed that the device Kennik uses to record these entries is called a Thoughtscriber, which is based on the Thanagarian tech used to make the Absorbascon.
In Part 5, the "Red Lantern that looks like a ball with arms and legs" is Zilius Zox. He's yet to appear in the game.

The fastest way to get to Matron's Orphanage is by using the teleport at the Green Lantern Outpost and selecting the Blue Lantern Outpost, then using the portal at the cave south of the outpost to the Base of Mountain.

summary: A Work Outing is a global briefing that can be found in the Iceberg Lounge challenge. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Episode 25.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Work Outing is a global briefing that can be found in the Iceberg Lounge challenge. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Episode 25.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Sometimes heroes need a break too. These phone recordings of Zatanna, Black Canary, and the Huntress show how they let off a little steam."

sections.title: Part 1: Chilling at Iceberg
items: Zone: ( Gotham City)
Region: Iceberg Lounge
Location: In the round party room with the iceberg, on a intermediate ceiling left of the entrance

Briefing: Zatanna:" Canary, it's Zatanna. I heard that the Iceberg Lounge is reopening this week. I'm sure that "legitimate businessman," Oswald Cobblepot's, up to absolutely nothing naughty. What do you say we head over and have a drink or two while we keep an eye an the joint?"

images.label: A Work Outing - Chilling at Iceberg

sections.title: Part 2: Corrupt Coop
items: Zone: ( Gotham City)
Region: Iceberg Lounge
Location: In the kitchen room on the right side behind a kitchen table

Briefing: Black Canary:" Ugggh, Z. You know how I feel about the Penguin. That creep gives birds everywhere a bad name. And Oracle said that Batman's got a guy on the inside for opening night. For now, I'm going to avoid that place. It's like a prehistoric penguin barfed up an art deco bird sanctuary."

sections.title: Part 3: All Business, No Play
items: Zone: ( Gotham City)
Region: Iceberg Lounge
Location: At the entrance to the second room with thugs - where Harley lock-picks a door - on the left entrance

Briefing: The Huntress:" Hey, Zatanna, I got your message. I would really love to cut loose with you at the new Iceberg Lounge, but I'm trying to figure out Harley and Ivy's next move. Nothing they do makes sense... Knock one back for me if you make it out?"

images.label: A Work Outing - All Business, No Play

sections.title: Part 4: A Bird Most Foul
items: Zone: ( Gotham City)
Region: Iceberg Lounge
Location: In the very last room with the gemerald hidden in a file cabinet (which needs to be smashed first)
Briefing: Zatanna:" *Sigh* You guys are probably right. I doubt anything interesting will happen on opening night anyway."

images.label: A Work Outing - A Bird Most Foul

On a roof at the Southwest corner of Ace Chemicals Plant.
"Chemical Analysis - samples 16 and 17. These two samples were taken from different colored chemlings... I'm going to try adding part of 16 to 17. Wait, do we have a fire extinguisher?"
One block Northeast of Ace Chemicals on the roof of the building with two pillars.
"Chemical Analysis - sample 9. This is it, patient zero. I was hoping it'd be a cute little monkey, but no..."
On the roof of the entrance into Ace Chemicals.
"Chemical Analysis - sample 12. Luckily, we parked the HAZMAT van under a tree. We've got plenty of mutant bird... samples to examine."
On the ground floor of the building in the Southeast corner of Ace Chemicals.
"Chemical Analysis - sample 10: I'm analyzing sea water from the shore near Ace Chemicals. This stuff is so toxic, it makes the mutant alligators and gorillas seem cuddly."
In the middle of the platform off shore to the North of Ace Chemicals.
"Chemical Analysis - sample 37. I didn't really need to examine this rock, but oh man, this tech loaned from Steelworks is so awesome. Oh! Hand me that pen! I mean, sample 38.
Next to the parking garage sign to the East of Ace Chemicals.

title: Agamemno Contingency (Briefings)
summary: 1. New Protocol - Gotham (East End Police Station).

sections.title: Briefings
items: 1. New Protocol - Gotham (East End Police Station).

“This is Batman, security level Omega, password: Delta Charlie dash two seven dash five dash one nine three nine. Enable new protocol. Title: Agamemno Contingency. Recently, an extraterrestrial power swapped the bodies of the Justice League with members of the Secret Society of Supervillains. We were able to reverse this process, and undo what damage had been done to our reputations and private lives, but should anything like this happen again, or should any of the core members of the League turn rogue, we need to have plans in place to handle each and every one of us, should we become a threat. The members of the League are my teammates, but…we need to be prepared for the worst. Always.”—Batman
2. Codename: Last Son - Gotham (Crime Alley).

“Agamemno contingency, file code name: Last Son. If Superman ever becomes a threat to the planet, the following protocols will need to be enacted to ensure our survival. The sample of Green Kryptonite in vault 7B provided by Superman himself will incapacitate him with brief exposure, and prolonged exposure would, in all probability, be fatal. Portions of this kryptonite, under exposure to radiation, created a variation of Kryptonite that is red in color. Side effects of this type of kryptonite are unknown, further testing is required.“—Batman
3. Codename: Red Sands - Metropolis (between Star Labs and Steelworks).

“Agamemno contingency, file code name: Red Sands. J'onn J'onzz, the Manhunter from Mars, is the heart and soul of the Justice League. However, his strength and speed make him a formidable opponent should he ever turn against us. His vulnerability to fire would be hard to exploit in a defensive position. However, research suggests that a nanite virus spiked with magnesium would cause his skin to combust in contact with the air, neutralizing him as a threat. Must investigate further.“—Batman
4. Codename: 2814 - Gotham (GCPD HQ).

“Agamemno contingency, file code name: 2814. The ring of a Green Lantern is the most powerful weapon in the universe, limited only by the imagination of the bearer. The ring cannot be separated from the wielder except in the event of their death, and the ring's natural defenses prevent direct attack. But in order to use the ring, the Corps member needs to be able to see what they are doing. While an attack on the eyes would be ill advised due to the defenses of the ring *see table 38b for full offensive lists and their attendant probabilities of success*, research indicates that a post-hypnotic suggestion could be planted into the Green Lantern’s psyche, causing them to believe themselves blind. The ring would then make them blind, enforced by their own willpower. Must test out this theory on Guy Gardner.“—Batman
5. Codename: Olympus - Metropolis (Metro Station Building).

“Agamemno contingency, file code name: Olympus. Diana is a good friend…which is just one reason it would be difficult to face her in combat should she turn against the League. It's not a thought I relish. But if it must be done, the following strategy could be useful. If she could be convinced that she is fighting an equal, she could then theoretically be trapped in an unending cycle of combat against a phantom opponent. Must investigate feasibility of neural virtual reality technology.“—Batman
6. Codename: Polymer - Gotham (southwest of Crime Alley).

“Agamemno contingency, file code name: Polymer. Plastic Man - a unique opponent. Every molecule of his body is under his command, and he can make himself into anything he imagines. We're lucky that he's on our side, and that he's more concerned with being comic relief than anything else, but should he turn…freezing him with liquid nitrogen or some other agent is the best emergency response I've been able to identify. After that…it's just a question of storage.“—Batman
7. Agamemno Notes - Gotham (far right side bridge, east of East End Free Clinic).

“Agamemno contingency, notes section. Basic counters to other JLA members require further research. Flash: Paralysis? Green Arrow: immobilize one of his arms. Zatanna: Trachea trauma *a well-timed blow would easily do the trick*. Red Tornado: EMP. Firestorm: Phantom Zone? Lack of raw material should nullify his powers. Aquaman: Hydrophobia *investigate modification of Scarecrow's fear toxin*. Black Canary: Tear gas, if administered quickly enough, should cut off her ability to speak…and scream. Alternatively, I have recordings of her scream, which if played back at equal intensity, can cancel out the sound waves. If these contingency plans are discovered in the wake of my being incapacitated, please understand…this had to be done for each of us. Which brings us to: Agamemno contingency, codename: Detective. While Batman is a master strategist and combatant, he is only human. The best way to disable his strategic abilities would be to distract him. His parents are an excellent blind spot, as is his endless crusade to protect the innocent. Taking hostages is a good distraction. Particularly if they're friends or family.“—Batman

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Batman, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I might not always be around, but with heroes like you in this world, I won't need to be. That's why I've trusted you with access to my most dangerous, my most important secrets. You're my last contingency if everything else goes wrong. And if anything should ever happen to Batman... make sure you give that Bruce Wayne one hell of a eulogy."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " We won't be doing this dance forever. One day... I might lose, and I knew that someone might need my contingency files. Someone not a villain as powerful, ruthless, and unstoppable as you. You've never let me forget how you're always one step ahead. I can only hope that my allies on the Justice League are up to the challenge of facing my most formidable foe head on."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The entity known as the Spectre has been the Spirit of Vengeance since time unknown. Whatever has caused his rampage has also manifested magical spheres containing glimmers of the Spectre's own thoughts. Obtaining this knowledge will be well worth the effort.

table.caption: Collectibles
rows: This is Wrath mortal, A life ended too soon, a pilot with a sense of redemption. A police officer caught in the fires of corruption. All these and more, the Spectre has been
West of Union Station. West side of bridge on the boardwalk, behind phone booths
Listen to Hubris, mortal. It is the sound of dozens of mages lifting their voices to cast spells, then screaming as their lives are ended
4 Blocks West of Union Station, outside West side Metropolis Plaza
Close your eyes mortal, and see redemption. An enormous winged yellow beast rises up before you and cows to a booming voice
Near Glenmorgan Square kiosk, phone booths South side.
Do not expect to see Compassion, mortal. There is none left
Building West of Hubris amulet. Top of building under the satellite dish
Mortal, I warn you. Empathy can be a dangerous well and has drowned many
On upper walkway, linking 3 buildings, East of Redemption amulet.
Listen to Vengeance, mortal. Hear the whispers around you - sins and transgressions committed by everyday people. The Spectre's work is never done.
2nd garden level up in middle of Lexcorp Tower, Northside garden beds.

title: Arkham Asylum (Briefings)
summary: Arkham Asylum is a global briefing comprised in four parts.

sections.title: Overview
items: Arkham Asylum is a global briefing comprised in four parts.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Arkham Asylum's labyrinthine halls have new masters!

sections.title: Part 1: Arkham Aslyum: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Lobby
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: South End of the lobby, way above the entrance

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale with Gotham Now! Arkham Asylum, Gotham's Institute for the Criminally Insane, has a long and checkered past. Past and present residents include everyone from the Joker to the Riddler."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 2: Arkham Aslyum: Jeremiah Arkham
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Cell Block 3: Minimum Security
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: In the Lobby, follow the frozen path until you reach Cell Block 3: Minimum Security. It's on a beam girder supporting the walkway to the right of the entrance.

Briefing: Jeremiah Arkham:" Session 1970. Jeremiah Arkham, dictating. Mister Freeze hides his broken heart under a layer of cold. I think the man really yearns for a family, for children. I introduced him to a new way to use his freeze powers using new robotic advancements. I think the result was quite a breakthrough for him."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 3: Arkham Aslyum: Jeremiah Arkham
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Therapy Fulfillment Center
Instance: Arkham Asylum

Location: In the Lobby, follow the path with gas canisters (to the West) until you arrive at the Therapy Fulfillment Center. It's next to a giant pipe near the exit leading to the Amadeus Memorial Theater.

Briefing: Jeremiah Arkham:" Session 1959. Jeremiah Arkham, dictating. The Scarecrow. Such timid soul, really, inflicting fears to hide behind his own. I suggested he tried to share his vision of the world with the doctors. I do like to see my patients empowered."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 4: Arkham Aslyum: Jeremiah Arkham
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Hall of Records
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: In the Lobby, follow the path with plants until you reach the Hall of Records. It's at the Southeast corner, behind a tree.

Briefing: Jeremiah Arkham:" Session 1959. Jeremiah Arkham, dictating. Poison Ivy, a sweet girl really, merely in need of guidance in how to live a productive life. How to get back to her roots. I think in our last session, I really got through to her. Looking forward to seeing the results."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Vicki Vale, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Gotham Now News Brief: GCPD SWAT forces continue to keep Arkham Island under tight security lockdown tonight after what might be the first 'break in' attempt in Asylum history. Sources close to the Asylum indicate that three inmates had gained control of the facility. For Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with 1 Source Mark.

sections.title: Trivia
items: In the game, all of the titles parts are misspelled as "Arkham Aslyum" instead of "Arkham Asylum."

Though in Part 2's audio Jeremiah Arkham says "I introduced him to a new way to use his freeze powers using new robotic advancements," the subtitles instead says "I introduced him to some of Poison Ivy's sentient chill-resistant plants. She calls them golems." The written lines probably refer to a previous version of the text that didn't make it to the final cut.

title: Arkham Session Notes (Investigations)
summary: Arkham Session Notes is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across Arkham Island in the city of Gotham, near quest objectives for the Home Turf daily missions. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Arkham Session Notes is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across Arkham Island in the city of Gotham, near quest objectives for the Home Turf daily missions. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Doctor Arkham is noticeably upset at the growing animosity between some of his more complicated patients. He is certain he can help Pamela Isley, Jonathan Crane, and Victor Fries work through whatever has come between them. These notes provide insight into both Arkham and his wards.

sections.title: Session Note 11-14
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Arkham Island
Location: Behind the crypt in the cemetery
Investigation: Doctor Arkham:" Arkham Session notes. 11-14. Ms. Isley...Pamela. I really don't think Crane and Fries are trying to upset you... It's probably just a big misunderstanding."

sections.title: Session Note 11-13
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Arkham Island
Location: North Side of Arkham Island in the Main Road under a light pole.

Investigation: Doctor Arkham:" Arkham Session notes. 11-13. Good afternoon, Pamela. The orderlies tell me that someone's been sending poison flowers to Doctor Crane and Doctor Fries. You know you're not allowed to give your special... gifts to other patients."

sections.title: Session Note 10-21
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Arkham Island
Location: On the guard tower

Investigation: Doctor Arkham:" Arkham Session notes. 10-21. Victor. Doctor Fries, are you listening to me? Pamela was quite upset that someone froze all of her seedlings. I wouldn't stop and smell any roses any time soon."

sections.title: Session Note 10-24
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Arkham Island
Location:
Investigation: Doctor Arkham:" Arkham Session notes. 10-24. Victor. Doctor Fries. I'm sure your anxieties are related to the trauma you've endured, not Doctor Crane's fear toxin."

sections.title: Session Note 12-21
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Arkham Island
Location:
Investigation: Doctor Arkham:" Arkham Session notes. 12-21. Crane. I'm convinced that your obsession with fear is causing your paranoia of the other patients. They are not out to get you."

sections.title: Session Note 12-26
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Arkham Island
Location: Between the A/C units

Investigation: Doctor Arkham:" Arkham Session notes. 12-26. Crane. I've noticed a dramatic rise in anxiety at the Asylum. We've had to double medication dosage. That wouldn't have anything to do with you, would it?"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Steel or the T.O. Morrow, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " These session notes from Jeremiah Arkham's interviews may be disturbing, but they will definitely help me figure out what Morrow is up to at Arkham Asylum. I appreciate your collecting them for me. Thanks."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Jeremiah Arkham's sessions with his patients read like the back of a discount DVD in the horror section. While I admire the way he turned them against each other, he truly lacks a greater, scientific vision. That works out well for me, I suppose."

sections.title: Item
items: This collection rewards the player with the Crackling Bugzapper base item.

sections.title: Videos
items: Dc Universe Online Arkham Session Notes Investigations

sections.title: Trivia
items: The first numbers on the note correspond to the patients: Mister Freeze is 10, Poison Ivy is 11, and Scarecrow is 12.
The last numbers probably correspond to the day the notes were recorded. Therefore, the chronological order of the notes are: 11-13, 11-14, 10-21, 12-21, 10-24, and 12-26.

title: Arkham Unleashed: Episode I (Briefings)
summary: Arkham Unleashed: Episode 1 is an Episode Briefing that can be found in the East End district of Gotham City. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: See Also: Player Briefings
Arkham Unleashed: Episode 1 is an Episode Briefing that can be found in the East End district of Gotham City. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Scarecrow unleashes terror on Gotham's East End!

sections.title: Part 1: Arkham I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: Top of the tall building one block Northwest of the East End Police Station/ Bat-Signal.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale and JLA Watch. The Batman. Gotham's very own caped crusader. A vigilante who works outside the law to eradicate all crime. Now, he joins Superman and Wonder Woman to lead our new heroes against Brainiac and all other threats. Reports that his vast computer database is connected to all possible data is said... to be vast... What's with this reception?"

sections.title: Part 2: Arkham I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: At the very top of the building Southwest of East End Bowery.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " Vicki Vale with an urgent Gotham Now alert! The crazed criminal scientist called the " Scarecrow" has escaped from Arkham Asylum and is reportedly loose on the East End. This fear-obsessed villain uses air-borne gas to create terrifying hallucinations. The GCPD and Gotham hazmat are in the area, but can even Batman stop Scarecrow's latest reign of terror? This is Vicki Vale for Gotham Now."

sections.title: Part 3: Arkham I: Police Radio
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: Halfway up the building South of the Malone Improvement District.

Briefing: Officer: " Code 30! Code 30! Officer needs assistance! Scarecrow's thugs and fear gas are overwhelming the rescue efforts at the East End Clinic. We need Hazmat to clear the area. O-oh! I-I've never seen anything like this! I-It's a mass hallucination! Like your worse nightmares are rea- No! No! No! Stay awaaaaaay!"

sections.title: Part 4: Arkham I: Police Radio
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: At the very top of the building Northwest from East End Free Clinic and South from the Amusement Mile area.
Briefing: Bullock: " Bullock to dispatch, we found Scarecrow's hideout. Batwoman's going in."
Female Officer: " Did I read that, Officer Bullock? Batwoman's going in?"

Bullock: " Yeah yeah, she's the new kid in town. Ho oh, but you ain't seen this chick in action. She doesn't clear Scarecrow out, we ain't got a chance. I'll say this for Bat's costumed freaks: *phew* when they hit, they hit hard."

sections.title: Part 5: Arkham I: Batman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: At the top of the building Southwest of the East End Free Clinic, with the Diane's Diamonds billboard.
Briefing: Batman: " This is Batman to Bullock. Batwoman is tracking down the Scarecrow. She's armed with an older version of my antidote. Don't risk your men; we're handling it. Batman out."

sections.title: Part 6: Arkham I: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: At the building Southwest of East End Bowery (the same from Part 2), on top of the Karaoke/ Lounge pink/purple neon sign.

Briefing: Joker: " *laughs* Oh! Are these big bad hallucinations of the Scarecrow scaring you? Well I know what you're really afraid of... Me! I'm not even here, and you're hallucinating my voice! But you'll be seeing me soon enough, and there'll be enough nightmares for everyone! Ha! Ha!"

sections.title: Meta briefings
items: Arkham Unleashed: Episode 1 is one of three briefings that comprise the meta briefing Arkham Unleashed.
See Arkham Unleashed: Episode 2 and Arkham Unleashed: Episode 3 for more information about the other briefings in the set.

table.caption: Mail message
rows: " " Gotham Now News Brief: The East End will sleep better tonight knowing the Scarecrow is once again behind bars in Arkham Asylum. Batwoman, Gotham's newest crimefighter, was seen leaving the area with a group of mysterious persons in tow. For Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale. ""

title: Arkham Unleashed: Episode II (Briefings)
summary: Arkham Unleashed: Episode II is an Episode Briefing that can be found in both Burnley and Otisburg districts of Gotham City. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Arkham Unleashed: Episode II is an Episode Briefing that can be found in both Burnley and Otisburg districts of Gotham City. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Pretty Poison Ivy wreaks havoc on the Otisburg district!

sections.title: Part 1: Arkham II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: Two blocks west of the Amusement Mile map marker. Just above street level in a small plaza area. Just to the west of a large blue glass window hotel.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" With Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale. The Giordano Gardens area is under strict quarantine after an attack by former botanist, Doctor Pamela Isley, now better known as Poison Ivy. The mean Queen of Green claims the world for plants using pheromones and the plants themselves as weapons. Is Ivy looking at another stay in Arkham or will Gotham be a new kind of urban jungle? Stay tuned."

sections.title: Part 2: Arkham II: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: Between the buildings east of GCPD 12th Precinct, east from the Knightsdome Sporting Complex.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I'm Jack Ryder and You Are Wrong! Why? Because you think when crazies go to Arkham Asylum, they get better. Asylum for the Criminally Insane...my left butt-cheek! Never mind that the place is a revolving door for psychos. They actually come out worse! There's something deeply wrong going on in Arkham, friend. And if you don't believe me. You are wrong!"

sections.title: Part 3: Arkham II: Harvey Bullock
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: At the middle of the block Southeast of the Giordano Botanical Gardens.
Briefing: Bullock:" Dispatch, this is Bullock. Bat sent in the Boy Wonder, but there's no word. SCU and the new hero should be on this, right? Well they can catch up, I'm going in!"
Female Officer: " 10-4, Bullock. Use extreme caution and your green(?) breather against Ivy's spores."
Bullock: " Oh yeah, yeah, I can't breathe through my nose anyway. Damn adenoids! Eh, Bullock out."

sections.title: Part 4: Arkham II: Catwoman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On a rooftop Southwest of Giordano Botanical Gardens.

Briefing: Catwoman:" *rings* *click* *beep* Pamela. Selina. I don't know what you're up to, but Harley is feeling left out. That means she's calling me. Every. Five. Minutes. Frankly, she's driving me batty, and we both know how much I hate that. Whatever your botanical scheme is, give it a rest, and give her a ring. Hmm? Ciao. *click*"

sections.title: Part 5: Arkham II: Batman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: On the upper levels of the unfinished tall building West from Doctor Szilagyi, two blocks North from the Giordano Botanical Gardens.

Briefing: Batman:" Batman to GCPD. Do not attempt to apprehend Poison Ivy alone. She uses pheromones to entrance people and force them to her will. They're pollen-based, so the entire area is contaminated. Robin is recruiting the new heroes to get her back to Arkham. Leave it in their hands. Batman out."

sections.title: Part 6: Arkham II: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: On the construction site East from the Millicent Mayne Plaza area, next to the Hotel.

Briefing: Joker:" Ring! Ring! Yeaaah... Joker here. I hear my fellow Arkham Ex-Pat Ivy is kicking up a notch over in Giordano Gardens. I don't have much of a green thumb myself. I never managed to keep a single plant alive! Hmm. Or a pet. Or a friend. Hehe. Spot a trend? Well don't let me keep you. If she doesn't kill you, I'm sure I will."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Vicki Vale, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Gotham Now News Brief: Roughly a dozen GCPD officers are in quarantine tonight after a conclusion to the 'Ivy' incident near the Giordano Garden. We'll follow their recovery as it progresses. For Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Mister Freeze reaches out to freeze fast the heart of Gotham City!"

sections.title: Part 1: Arkham III: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: Northeast of Robinson Park, on the ground between two dumpsters (assuming they haven't been destroyed by someone), near the building with the neon 'Restaurant' sign.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch. Green Arrow and Black Canary. Lovebirds? Or just partners in crime fighting? Dashing Green Arrow is a straight shooting Robin Hood for the underdog, while glamorous Black Canary's shattering canary cry sends the bad guys reeling. The Justice League will neither confirm nor deny their relationship, but villains everywhere know that when it comes to these two, three is definitely a crowd."

sections.title: Part 2: Arkham III: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On the roof of a building two blocks East from the Gotham Mercy General Hospital area, behind the Levitz Cameras billboard.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Gotham Now with Vicki Vale. The Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane refused to comment on if the cryogenically-contained villain, Mister Freeze, managed to escape into Gotham. Mister Freeze is said to be obsessed with curing his terminally ill wife, Nora, no matter what that means for the rest of Gotham. So if you feel a chill in the air, look out! This is Gotham Now."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 3: Arkham III: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On the roof of a building North of The Pillars of Hades and in front of a Tavern

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I am Jack Ryder and You Are Wrong! Why? Because of the Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane. If you think everything is hunky-dory down at the nut factory, you oughta be committed. Every five seconds, another certified lunatic breaks loose. Scarecrow, Ivy, now Mister Freeze. Anyone see a pattern here? Cause if you don't friend, gotta tell you. You are wrong!"

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 4: Arkham III: Commissioner Gordon
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: Inside an elevated train terminal, East from the Gotham Mercy General Hospital complex.

Briefing: Commissioner Gordon: " This is Commissioner Gordon to all GCPD and SCU on sight. Someone in Arkham forgot to lock the door. We just tackled Scarecrow and Ivy's mess and now we've got Mister Freeze out in the town. He uses diamonds to power his freeze equipment, so keep a lookout. He'll be targeting the stones. Good luck and stay safe."

sections.title: Part 5: Arkham III: Batman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: Atop the building with the Gallery sign, South of the Gotham Mercy General Hospital complex.

Briefing: Batman: " This is Batman to Commissioner Gordon. Mister Freeze will likely head for a major medical facility to try and raise his wife Nora from her cryochamber. He's never given up, even after his first medical treatment backfired, and forced him to spend his life in subfreezing temperatures. I'm sending in my new allies along with Green Arrow and Black Canary to contain the damage. Batman out."

sections.title: Part 6: Arkham III: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On the middle of the rooftop of the shorter building with four towers, North of the Gotham Mercy General Hospital complex.

Briefing: Joker: " Hello! Don't think I can't see you. If you're so keen to explore the inside of a hospital, I'll be happy to put you there. Maybe your good friend Mister Freeze will even put you in ice like his dear departed wife. Now tick tock, time's a wasting."

sections.title: Mail Messages

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Gotham Now News Brief: The area around Gotham Mercy Hospital is still being dethawed tonight as GCPD officers look for clues amidst the ice. Reports from the scene indicate some kind of villainous skirmish, with forces of the Joker facing off with those of Mr. Freeze. More as it becomes available. For Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale."

sections.title: Overview
items: Artemis Found is a global briefing that can be found in the Themiscira part of the Seeing Shades Again solo challenge. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Amazon Fury Part III episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Themyscira is not the only home to the Amazons. These messages left in the magic crystals reveal some of the history behind the Bana-Mighdall and the fierce warrior, Artemis."

sections.title: Part 1: The Bana-Mighdall
items: Zone: Seeing Shades Again
Region: Themyscira: Palace District
Location: Right above the entrance for the instance

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" It is little known that Themyscira is not the only home to Amazons. 3000 years ago, there were two Amazon Queens, Hippolyta and Antiope, who split the nation. My mother's tribe traveled to Themyscira to lead immortal lives and to guard the Gates of the Tartarus. Antiope took her people to Egypt, where they built the majestic city of Bana-Mighdall. They became mortal, mingling in the world of men, and created a reputation of fierce warriors and forgers of exceptional weapons."

sections.title: Part 2: Proud, Strong, and Fierce!
items: Zone: Seeing Shades Again
Region: Themyscira: Palace District
Location: On the corner of the courtyard

Briefing: Artemis:" I was born a Bana-Mighdall, strong, fierce, and proud. But to my tribe I seemed an anachronism, a reminder of the time when the Amazons were of one tribe and immortal, so I was sent to live on Themyscira. But to them I am nothing BUT Bana-Mighdall, my Amazon "blood" having been diluted from centuries of mating with mortal men, forever a foreigner, a half-breed."

sections.title: Part 3: Hair-Raising Battle
items: Zone: Seeing Shades Again
Region: Themyscira: Palace District
Location: On a planter in the corner before the last room

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" It is true that Artemis is a ferocious, sometimes excessively violent warrior, but she is as loyal an Amazon as any I have met. I am proud to have fought by her side on more than one adventure. And I must admit... the hair is almost as impressive as her skill with bow."

sections.title: Part 4: Artemis Unleashed
items: Zone: Seeing Shades Again
Region: Themyscira: Palace District
Location: Behind a palm tree to the right of the temple

Briefing: Artemis:" For a time I held the mantle of "Wonder Woman", but apparently the world of men was not ready for such a fearsome fighter, and those whom I saved seemed more afraid than grateful. I was not even allowed to sit in Diana's place during meetings of the famed Justice League. But that time is past, and I now protect one who is more than appreciative of my skill in battle. The "Seer" found me at my most despondent and gave me new purpose... someone to fight for!"

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Incredible that you found these on Themyscira. The Bana-Mighdall are very protective of their history. This is great information to have, thanks."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Family "squabbles" are always useful... especially if you ever need to pit one side against each other. Good job finding these."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Bang Baby or not, the Big Bang started everything.

sections.title: Part 1: The Bigger Picture
items: Zone: Shock: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Region: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Location: To the north behind some plants and in front of a painting, directly adjacent to the entrance.

Investigation: Ebon: " Typical Static, messing up the cash flow. Had he let it play out, he would've seen that getting bread was only step one of my plan. Step two would've been leading a revolt from inside the Meta-Therapy Clinic with all the captured Bang Babies. Oh well."

images.label: Bang Baby Bonanza - The Bigger Picture

sections.title: Part 2: Prepare for Take Off
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: In the northeast, on a rooftop four blocks down and two blocks left.
Investigation: Static: " Sparks between me and Rocket are destined to fly. Opposites attract. She'd know that if she wasn't skipping chemistry class. Us two, we're ionic chemical bonds."

images.label: Bang Baby Bonanza - Prepare for Take Off

sections.title: Part 3: Have to Do Better
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: One block south of the mission hub, at streetlevel.

Investigation: Icon: " At least this time it was an otherworldly threat. However, this evil would not have been possible without assistance from humans you voted in power. You still have flaws in your societal structure that you need to fix in order to prevent such treachery."

images.label: Bang Baby Bonanza - Have to Do Better

sections.title: Part 4: Always Recruiting
items: Zone: Shock: Abandoned Subway
Region: Abandoned Subway
Location: In the southeast corner of the area where you fight Turtledove.

Investigation: Ebon: " Aye, Static, there's still a place for you in the Metabreeds. Just say the word. I'll teach you how to be cool." Static Shock: " And the answer's still no. Haven't you heard? Blerds are in now."

sections.title: Part 5: Diversity Matters
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: At the east of the area two blocks left and one block down from the canal, at east-side midlevel.
Investigation: Cyborg: " I see a lot more people that look like me in Dakota. I gotta visit more often."

sections.title: Part 6: Stand Up
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: At the south edge of the area on a rooftop in the fourth block counted from west.

Investigation: Rocket: " I get my superpowers from my belt, so technically I'm not even a Bang Baby. But it doesn't matter, because you shouldn't have to be one to help. Any injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere!"

sections.title: Part 7: Juggling Responsibilities
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: At the entrance of Lincoln High School (around the building where Jinx appears)
Investigation: Static: " Rescuing those Bang Babies took up a lot of time. My 4.0 is definitely in jeopardy. Wish I could just tell my teachers who I am!"

sections.title: Part 8: Hustler's Mentality
items: Zone: Shock: Abandoned Subway
Region: Abandoned Subway
Location: In the southwest corner of the room where you fight DaBomb.

Investigation: Ebon: " I'm startin' to realize the real way to get to the bag. If I lift the stuff that turned us into Bang Babies in the first place and start sellin' that... I'm the city's next billionaire."

title: Beginning of the End: Episode I (Briefings)
summary: Beginning of the End: Episode I is an Episode Briefing that can be found near and in locations relating to the story arc " Beginning of the End". There are 6 parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: See Also: Player Briefings
Beginning of the End: Episode I is an Episode Briefing that can be found near and in locations relating to the story arc " Beginning of the End". There are 6 parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The HIVE invades the Metropolis Metrodome in Little Bohemia!

sections.title: Part 1: The End I: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: On top of the building Northeast from the Metropolis Metrodome.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live. Just blocks from the Metropolis Metrodome where LexCorp, STAR Labs, and the HIVE are at war. The HIVE is led by their Queen Bee, an alien princess from the planet Korll who uses her mind control pollen to swell her insectile ranks. The JLA is advising all citizens to stay out of the area until further notice. More as the story progresses."

sections.title: Part 2: The End I: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Travel West from the dome, and look for a building with blue skylights. The token is at ground level at the corner of the building.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane, reporting on the ongoing conflict between two of our planet's mightiest beings. The man of steel, Superman, and the man of money, Lex Luthor. Both Superman and Lex have sworn to lead the new generation of powered beings into battle, but against Brainiac, or each other? Stay tuned to Daily Planet Live."

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 1
Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 1 Map

sections.title: Part 3: The End I: Metrodome Ad
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: On the roof of the STAR Labs Facility, at particularly tall building directly South of the Metropolis Metrodome.

Briefing: Announcer:" The Metropolis Metrodome! The world most advanced sports and convention facility. Whether it's to see the big game, attend the latest rally for superhuman powers, check out advanced alien technology, or purchase new charms and spells, Metropolis swarms to the Metropolis Metrodome."

sections.title: Part 4: The End I: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: In the garden directly North of the Metropolis Metrodome and the portal for the HIVE Base. Check by the trees against the street, it will be at the Western side.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I am Jack Ryder and You Are Wrong! Why? Because you think Queen Bee and the HIVE are no threat compared to Brainiac. Brainiac isn't using hypno-pollen to covert humans into mindless, sexless drones. You heard me! Mindless, sexless drones! Who wants that?! No one! You may think you're safe, friend, but you are wrong."

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 4
Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 4 Map

sections.title: Part 5: The End I: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia

Location: In a corner of the ledge that runs around the top of the Metropolis Metrodome. Explore the Southwest side of this ledge and look between the wall and a radio antenna to find the token glowing away back there.

Briefing: Lex Luthor:" This is Luthor to LexCorp. Keep the bugs away from my Exobytes at all costs. I'm sending in reinforcements to help beat back the HIVE, so I repeat, defend the Exobytes. Sacrifice yourself if necessary. Are we clear? Luthor out."

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 5
Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 5 Map

sections.title: Part 6: The End I: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia

Location: In a corner of the ledge that runs around the top of the Metropolis Metrodome. Explore the Southeast side of this ledge and look between the wall and a radio antenna to find the token glowing away back there - it's on the opposite end of the Southern ledge that token number 5 is.

Briefing: Superman:" Superman to STAR Labs. HIVE is attacking both STAR Labs and LexCorp's Exobyte supply and taking them to the stadium. Your first priority is to defend yourselves. I am sending in reinforcements to help. You're in good hands. Superman out."

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 6
Beginning of the End - Episode 1 - Part 6 Map

title: Beginning of the End: Episode II (Briefings)
summary: The mysterious OMACs return under the watchful Brother Eye!

sections.title: Overview
items: See Also: Player Briefings

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The mysterious OMACs return under the watchful Brother Eye!

sections.title: Part 1: The End II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: At the top of the tall brown building North of the Monarch Playing Card Company.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" Welcome to Gotham Now! I'm Vicki Vale. The super-villain, Killer Frost, was recently spotted here in Gotham City. Killer Frost is attracted to body heat, which she drains from her victims to power her cold-based attacks. Witnesses have described her assault as "like a deadly blizzard with lipstick." The Special Crimes Unit has issued an all hands alert."

sections.title: Part 2: The End II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: Southwest of the Stagg Enterprises Gotham HQ, at the gap splitting the building in half.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch. One of the Justice League's hottest members, Fire, has burned more than a few criminals in her time. Most famous for her stint in Justice League International with her partner, Ice, this Brazilian bombshell's powers are as fiery as her name. She is now setting Metropolis alight in her work with the Justice League proper.""

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 2
Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 2 Map

sections.title: Part 3: The End II: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: Southwest of KnightsDome, at the top of Gotham S.T.A.R. Labs. It's under the satellite dish.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I am Jack Ryder and You Are Wrong! Why? Because you think the OMAC virus is a germ, like the flu. Well I have news for you, friend. The OMAC virus was made from Brainiac tech! Think the Brother Eye satellite who controls them was destroyed? Think Lex and the Society and freaking Brainiac will let this weapon slip through their fingers? Sorry, friend, but you are wrong!"

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 3
Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 3 Map

sections.title: Part 4: The End II: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: On the block East of the KnightDome's parking lot, inside the planter.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live on the OMAC situation in Gotham City. The Brother Eye satellite was designed to keep watch on Earth's most powerful entities. Its take-over by Maxwell Lord unleashed the deadly OMAC virus, forcing the satellite's destruction. But was it really destroyed? The Daily Planet has learned that a section of the satellite may be still functional deep below Gotham City. Stay tuned to Daily Planet Live."

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 4
Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 4 Map

sections.title: Part 5: The End II: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: On the ground at South side of the Knightsdome building, off to the right of the entrance.

Briefing: Joker:" Joker here. Bats in the belfry made these EMP devices to short out the OMAC virus. That's right. He made a death satellite in the sky. Then he made a device that could kill the death satellite in the sky. Ha! Ha! Now that's a paranoia I can appreciate!"

images.label: Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 5
Beginning of the End - Episode 2 - Part 5 Map

sections.title: Part 6: The End II: Superman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: On the Southwest side of KnightsDome, under a satellite dish.

Briefing: Superman:" This is Superman. Listen carefully. Lex Luthor designed the OMAC virus with help from the US government based on Brainiac's own technology. There's no telling how will it react with Exobyte-given powers if you can even be infected. Hero, villain, it doesn't matter. Stay safe. Superman out."

sections.title: Part 7: The End II: Superman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: On the North side of the KnightsDome, on the balcony under the sign.
Briefing: OMAC:" Unit unable to connect to creator. Searching frequencies."

Superman:" Batman, this is Superman from the Watchtower with Martian Manhunter. We only see a single energy source matching the MK1 frequency, so the good news is that only one piece of Brother Eye is activated. The bad news is that energy is fluctuating wildly, and it looks like Brainiac... Batman, are you reading this? We're experiencing a lot of distortions in this line. I'm switching now."

sections.title: Part 8: The End II: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: Northwest from the OMAC Base, along the the edge of the boardwalk after the turn.

Briefing: Lex Luthor:" Killer Frost, this is Luthor. I know you're not bright, so I'll make it simple. The Society wants your report on Brother Eye's mysterious reactivation. Now! That computer brain holds all of Batman's data on superpowered humans around the globe. We need to own that data or destroy it. So do it! Luthor out."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Vicki Vale, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Gotham Now News Brief: Citizens and police officers continue to be released from OMAC shells tonight in the Otisburg district after a heated conflict with the machine intelligence Brother Eye. Sources on the scene from the JLA and SCU refused to comment on this alarming situation. For Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale."

title: Cadmus Research Findings (Investigations)
summary: Cadmus Research Findings is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across the Area 51. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Cadmus Research Findings is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across the Area 51. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Area 51 is one of US Government's most secret installations, where Cadmus is currently running experiments on green kryptonite. Brainiac's attack provides a perfect opportunity to see exactly what Cadmus has discovered about this exotic mineral."

sections.title: Part 1: Cadmus Research Findings - Kryptonite and Lead
items: Investigation 1, located in the Fuel Depot
Zone: Area 51
Region: Fuel Depot
Location: There are 2 nodes for this part within the Fuel Depot: one at the southwestern corner, and other at the center north edge.
Investigation: " Chief Researcher's log; Initial findings indicate that lead may block some amount of kryptonite radiation."

sections.title: Part 2: Cadmus Research Findings - Radiation Poisoning
items: Investigation 2, found in the Ammo Dump
Zone: Area 51
Region: Ammo Dump

Location: There are 2 nodes for this part within the Ammo Dump: one on th second floor of the northern building, on the outside where you fight Subprime Regulator Beta; the other is on ground level, near the southeastern corner.
Investigation: " Chief Researcher's log; it's possible that kryptonite may cause radiation poisoning in humans."

sections.title: Part 3: Cadmus Research Findings - Possible Energy Source
items: Investigation 3, within Command and Control
Zone: Area 51
Region: Command and Control

Location: There are 2 nodes for this part within the Area 51 Command and Control. The first option is located turning right from the entrance, next to the wall; the second option is in the area where you fight Subprime Regulator Zeta, to the North.
Investigation: " Chief Researcher's log; there are indications that kryptonite may have applications as an energy source."

sections.title: Part 4: Cadmus Research Findings - Effect on Kryptonians
items: Investigation 4, within Command and Control
Zone: Area 51
Region: Command and Control
Location: At the northern corner, ground level.
Investigation: " Chief Researcher's log; our research confirms that kryptonite causes considerable harm to kryptonians."

sections.title: Part 5: Cadmus Research Findings - Types of Kryptonite
items: Investigation 5, at the Brainiac Invasion Point
Zone: Area 51
Region: Brainiac Invasion Point
Location: There are 2 nodes for this part: One southeast of the teleporter to the Brainiac Ship; the on street level, next to a light to the South.
Investigation: " Chief Researcher's log; there are a variety of kryptonite isotopes, distinguished by color."

table.caption: Mail message

title: CCPD Case Files: Speed Dating (Investigations)
summary: CCPD Case Files: Speed Dating is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Earth 3 Gotham open world zone, featured as part of the Earth 3 episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: CCPD Case Files: Speed Dating is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Earth 3 Gotham open world zone, featured as part of the Earth 3 episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "The speed demon known as Johnny Quick and his diminutive "shortcakes" Atomica have an interesting history, just ask Detective Leonard Snart."

sections.title: Part 1: Mad Love
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location:

Investigation: GCPD Officer Snart: "Case file: 2234. Detective Leonard Snart reporting. Jonathan Allen AKA Johnny Quick and his girlfriend Rhonda Pineda have been on a crime spree to rival Bonnie and Clyde. Their penchant for violence only rivals their perverse lust for one another. Detective Rory and I have sworn not to rest until these two monsters are brought to justice."

images.label: CCPD Case Files - Speed Dating - Mad Love

sections.title: Part 2: Natural Born Killers
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location:

Investigation: GCPD Officer Snart: "Case file: 2234. Detective Leonard Snart reporting. Allen and Pineda set fire to a middle school yesterday. No demands, no ransom, for no other reason than to watch it burn. Mick and I managed to save all of the children, but two teachers paid the ultimate price. These two can run like the devil, but there isn't a small enough hole for them to hide from us."

images.label: CCPD Case Files - Speed Dating - Natural Born Killers

sections.title: Part 3: Nowhere Left To Run
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location:

Investigation: GCPD Officer Snart: "Case file 2234. Detective Leonard Snart reporting. We've got Allen and Pineda cornered on the roof of Central City's S.T.A.R. Labs. There is nowhere left for them to run..."

images.label: CCPD Case Files - Speed Dating - Nowhere Left To Run

sections.title: Part 4: Rebirth
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location:

Investigation: GCPD Officer Snart: "Case file 2234: Detective Leonard Snart reporting. That bolt of lightning that hit Allen transformed him and Pineda. Allen, or Johnny Quick, as he call himself, is able to move faster than the eye can see. Pineda, now using the alias Atomica, fell through the skylight onto experimental shrinking tech, and can now shrink to the size of an atom. We barely made it out of there with our lives."

images.label: CCPD Case Files - Speed Dating - Rebirth

sections.title: Part 5: Running with the Devil
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location:

Investigation: GCPD Officer Snart: "Case file 2234: Detective Leonard Snart reporting. My worst nightmares are confirmed. Johnny Quick and Atomica have joined forces with Owlman, Superwoman, and Ultraman to form some kind of Crime Syndicate. What can one good man with a badge and a gun do against gods? I'll tell you what he can't do...quit. I may not be Q-Ranger or Sir Solomon Grundy, but I'm not quitting until Allen and Pineda pay for their crimes. Not until I'm dead."

images.label: CCPD Case Files - Speed Dating - Running with the Devil

sections.title: Item
items: This collection rewards the player with the Worn Crowbar catalyst item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: All of the pieces are items related to the whereabouts of the crowbar used by the Joker to murder Jason Todd, Batman's second Robin. It references the storylines A Death in the Family (1988), Knightfall (1993), and The Black Mirror (2011). The game hints that each of the parts are steps in the player's search for the infamous tool.

Gotham River Survey Document: During the events of Knightfall (in which Bane breaks Batman's back, as referenced by Deathstroke in the duo version of Cape Carmine Lighthouse), Joker and Scarecrow teamed up to try and kill the Batman. They kidnapped Gotham City's Mayor Armand Krol in order to lure the Dark Knight to the Gotham River Tunnel; there, Scarecrow's toxin affected the Bat and made him have vision of Jason's murder, and their confrontation ended with Scarecrow flooding the tunnel. The same tunnel might have been the place where the player's character found the lead to the crowbar.

Smudged 1-900 Number: For the original publication of A Death in the Family, DC Comics set up a 1-900 number hotline to let readers decide the fate of Jason Todd; 5,343 votes were cast for his death, barely surpassing the 5,271 votes for saving him. This may indicate that the player's character is aware that they're a fictional character in a video game.

Ticket to Lebanon: When Jason Todd finds out that the woman he thought to be his mother was actually his stepmother, he began an investigation to track his biological mother - his investigation took him to Lebanon, where the Joker was smuggling a cruise missile to terrorists. When the crowbar is found (see item 4), it was described as coming from Beirut, Lebanon.

Mirror House Invitation: In the comics, Dick Grayson is the new Batman and, disguised as the CEO William Rhodes, infiltrates the Mirror House, a mobile auction house used to sell super-villain artifacts and the location of the infamous crowbar, which he discovers by accident. This story is told in The Black Mirror, but the messages from Oracle and Calculator imply that the player's character was the one who tracked down the weapon; the new hero told Oracle who, in turn, informed Batman (Bruce Wayne) about its location. Joker and Calculator are not involved in the events of the original story.

items: This collection was first available for the event in 2019.
How to Shrink Friends and Influence People is a pun on the title of the best-seller self-help book How to Win Friends and Influence People by Dale Carnegie, first published in 1936.
