title: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour (Briefings)
summary: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour is a Global Briefing introduced in Lightning Strikes that can be found in various places in Metropolis, Gotham City, and Central City. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour is a Global Briefing introduced in Lightning Strikes that can be found in various places in Metropolis, Gotham City, and Central City. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Dexter Myles is the greatest Shakespearean actor of our time and the curator of the Flash Museum. Find out more about the Rogues by finding clips of the Museum Audio Tour."

sections.title: Part 1: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Weather Wizard
items: Zone: Central City
Region: Central City
Location: On Flash Museum's east roof, near the pipes.

Briefing: Dexter Myles:"' Such sheets of fire, such bursts of horrid thunder, such groans of wind and rain!' Weather Wizard is capable of these woes and much more. He's next on our tour, so let's move forward as I describe the blizzard he summoned on a balmy day..."

images.label: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour - Weather Wizard

sections.title: Part 2: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Professor Zoom
items: Zone: Central City
Region: Central City
Location: Next to Flash Museum's south entrance, behind a column.

Briefing: Dexter Myles: "'' Something wicked this way comes.' And it comes from the future! Ooo! Our next villain on this tour is Professor Zoom, evil's answer to our hero, the Flash! Obsessed with causing the Scarlet Speedster trouble, he will race through time itself!"

images.label: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour - Professor Zoom

sections.title: Part 3: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Captain Cold
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: 2nd building East of Midtown MPD Station lots of windows & gold/yellow top. At the top, west side of building in between air conditioner and antenna.

Briefing: Dexter Myles: "' Now is the winter of our discontent.' Brrr-rr-rrr! First on our museum tour is Captain Cold. Perhaps one of Flash's most recognizable foes and leader of the infamous Rogues. Do not mistake him for Mister Freeze lest you wish to face the chill of his Absolute-Zero guns."

sections.title: Part 4: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Abra Kadabra
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Location: One block North of Mannheim's Chinese Theater. On top of Hotel with blue and red awnings. Between air vent and water tower.

Briefing: Dexter Myles:"' Double, double, toil and trouble' Abra Kadabra will burst your bubble! Originally a technological con-artist from the future, he betrayed his fellow rogues in an effort to gain actual magical powers from the demon Neron ."

sections.title: Part 5: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Heat Wave
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Diamond District
Location: Three buildings west of bottled Courthouse. Square building with view of water. At Northwest corner, under arch.

Briefing: Dexter Myles: "' Heat not a furnace for your foe so hot that it do singe yourself.' Next on the tour is Heat Wave, quite the tragic villain. His fascination with fire has burned many...himself included."

sections.title: Part 6: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: The Top
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: Science Spire. North side Balcony near top with blue windows.

Briefing: Dexter Myles:"' Better to be eaten to death with rust than to be scoured to nothing with perpetual motion.' I imagine these are words the rogue on our tour would live by! The Top is capable of spinning at speeds so great he can deflect bullets and alter minds."

sections.title: Part 7: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Pied Piper
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: One building west of the Greenhouse in the Giordano Botanical Gardens. On top of building next to southwest tower.

Briefing: Dexter Myles: "' If music be the food of love, play on' good sirs! But our next rogue, the Pied Piper, can turn delightful melodies into dangerous maladies. Born deaf, but later cured, he soon became obsessed with music, creating a flute that can bend even the strongest wills."

sections.title: Part 8: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Trickster
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Otisburg
Location: Monarch Playing Card Company. On top of building support at the northwest corner of the building.

Briefing: Dexter Myles:"' Such tricks hath strong imagination.' Take heed the great bard's words for it is too easy to underestimate the Trickster and his dastardly gag-themed gadgets. His cleverness has been causing woes for the Flash for quite a long time."

sections.title: Part 9: Dexter Myles' Audio Tour: Captain Boomerang
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location:
Briefing: Dexter Myles:"' There's small choice in rotten apples.' With Captain Boomerang the apple did not fall far from the tree! Both father and son have donned this guise and both are on display!"

items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Dexter Myles, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " We strive to inform the public about the Flash's adventures and enemies. As fascinating as they may be they are quite the dangerous fellows! Be careful out there good sirs and madams."

sections.title: Overview
items: Discord's Delights is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across locations in the Patchwork Themyscira open world zone, and the instances Wonderverse: Temples of Source Power, Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea, and Wonderverse: Fractured God Sphere as part of the Wonderverse episode. sections.title: Synopsis
items: Evidence that even the potential collapse of the multiverse cannot thwart greek tragedies.

sections.title: Part 1: The Problem with Atlantis
items: Zone: Patchwork Themyscira
Region: Atlantean Invasion
Location: Up on the rocks, next a group of Amazon camp working as a supply distribution points with crates.

Investigation: Queen Diana: " My sisters-in-arms are still oblivious to the threat from their own native sea. I wish I could show them the depths of Atlantean treachery, but I worry how much I can trust the other Wonder Women. After all, I was not immune to Atlantean deception, and I must assume the other Wonder Women share my same foolish trust. Bombshell Diana certainly, is too far gone. She actually considers Mera to be her first love! Is opening their eyes even possible?"

sections.title: Part 2: Queen Diana's Lament
items: Zone: Crypt of Penthesilea
Instance: Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea
Location: In the hallway leading to the chamber where you face Queen Diana.
Investigation: Queen Diana: " The burden of queenship makes for a heavy helm."

sections.title: Part 3: The Depths of Poseidon's Despair
items: Zone: Atlantis Bridge
Instance: Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea
Location: In the back of Poseidon's arena, next to a crate of Source fragments.
Investigation: Poseidon: " I can swell tides and move the ground, but the ocean always falls to the depths. The truth is that it takes all my strength to simply maintain my shores."

sections.title: Part 4: Hera's Godly Distractions
items: Zone: Fractured God Sphere
Region: Olympus
Instance: Wonderverse: Fractured God Sphere
Location: On the fountain before climbing the stairs.
Investigation: Hera: " Sowing chaos in the Sphere of the Gods has brought me the chance I need at restoring Zeus."

sections.title: Part 5: Queen Diana's Eulogy for Penthesilea
items: Zone: Shrine of Hippolyta
Instance: Wonderverse: Temples of Source Power
Location: In the room with the interactive Hippolyta Effigy, up on a niche in the center facing the door to the next room.
Investigation: Queen Diana: " You warned me against Emperor Orin, Penthesilea, but not even you could have predicted Mera's attempt on my life. I wish I'd had your wisdom here."

sections.title: Part 6: Queen Diana's Rationale
items: Zone: Shrine of Hippolyta
Instance: Wonderverse: Temples of Source Power
Location: In the final room, on the water to the north next to the exit portal.
Investigation: Queen Diana: " I take no pleasure in genocide. Spilling Atlantean blood is necessary to ensure that Nubia's Council is free to pursue their aims."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Eris, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes
Villains

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " You caught me! Sure, those investigations might show how I sowed little Strife here and Discord there, but how is a Goddess to resist when there are so many Themysciras to play with? Too bad your own doubles never showed up, I have a feeling your betters might have assembled all this evidence just a hair quicker, don't you think? - Eris, Goddess of Strife and Discord"

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Thought you'd appreciate evidence of my handiwork! Isn't life so much fun when you get to needle the Gods and their so-called heroes? Well, it's even better when there are multiple Themysciras to toy with. It's just too bad your own alternate selves never showed up, now those people really know how to go wild! -Eris, Goddess of Strife and Discord"

items: " Membership may way and wane, but magic always need protection."

sections.title: Part 1: Real and Stage Magic
items: Zone: JLDC: Town Square Theater
Region: Town Square Theater
Location: In the room where you fight Cursed Wonder Girl behind the debris at the wall

Briefing: Zatanna:" Stage magic requires more than sleight-of-hand, flashy lights, and a fast tongue. It's crafting a story, building a desire, then pulling off a delicious twist. Yeah, real magic helps, but there's a reason nobody lines up for Doctor Fate's recitations. Can you imagine what a snoozefest that'd be?"

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Real and Stage Magic

sections.title: Part 2: Giovanni's Memory
items: Zone: JLDC: Town Square Theater
Region: Town Square Theater
Location: At the end of the hallway towards the make-up room, at the right wall behind some cardboard boxes
Briefing: Zatanna:" I always try to honor dad's memory. Giovanni, this one's for you."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Giovanni's Memory

sections.title: Part 3: Constantine Approaching Etrigan
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: On a crane over a construction site at the bottom right corner of the map.

Briefing: Constantine:" Jason Blood, first step in a standard exorcism would be to discover the demon's name." Etrigan:" Gone, gone the form of man, rise the demon Etrigan!" Constantine:" Next step: discover motivation. So, Etrigan, now that Blood's indisposed, let's go over what it is that you want."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Constantine Approaching Etrigan

sections.title: Part 4: Circe Helping the JLD
items: Zone: JLDC: Cursed Themyscira
Region: Cursed Themyscira
Location: In the area where you fight Cursed Wonder Woman and Cursed Circe to the left up on a balcony
Briefing: Circe:" Greatness speaks for itself, understood?"

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Circe Helping the JLD

sections.title: Part 5: Wonder Woman Guiding Magic
items: Zone: JLDC: Cursed Themyscira
Region: Cursed Themyscira
Location: In the area of the final fight on the first storey of the structure on the far left

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" The Justice League Dark is necessary for the threats that the Justice League cannot face alone. Guiding those with magical abilities has always been, and will always be, my charge."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Wonder Woman Guiding Magic

sections.title: Part 6: Hecate's Magical Betrayal
items: Zone: JLDC: Cursed Themyscira
Region: Cursed Themyscira
Location: In the area of the final fight in the far right corner
Briefing: Wonder Woman:" The Gods of Olympus can be fickle, but Hecate has always been friendly, caring, and protective. Her attack liquifies a foundation I had thought solid."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Hecate's Magical Betrayal

sections.title: Part 7: Wonder Girl
items: Zone: JLDC: Town Square Theater
Region: Town Square Theater
Location: In the last hall where you fight Cursed Zatanna on the left side in one of the VIP boxes
Briefing: Wonder Girl:" Of course, yeah, I'm here to help Wonder Woman, but honestly, I'm also a really big fan of Zatanna."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Wonder Girl

sections.title: Part 8: Swamp Thing's Perspective
items: Zone: JLDC: Cursed House of Mystery
Region: Cursed House of Mystery
Location: Up at the final boss arena.
Briefing: Swamp Thing:" Seen from my perspective, the desires of men feel distant, disconnected. Life means more, wants more. And I am burdened with protecting it."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Swamp Thing's Perspective

sections.title: Part 9: Kahndaqi Relic Return
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: On the building south from the House of Mystery.
Briefing: Mary:" Isis and I were leaning on Gotham U to return Kahndaqi artifacts when all this went down, and then of course we had to help!"

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Kahndaqi Relic Return

sections.title: Part 10: Wrathful Warning
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: On the top the 15 Kane Street (Abandoned) building.
Briefing: Phantom Stranger:" A god's wrath may punish, but also warn. Perhaps this is Hecate's true goal."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Wrathful Warning

sections.title: Part 11: Batgirl's Weird
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: On the side of a building east from the Gentleman Ghost arena.
Briefing: Batgirl:" I like... the weird. Am weird."

images.label: Dramatic History of the JLD - Batgirl's Weird

title: Dying of the Light: Episode I (Briefings)
summary: Dying of the Light: Episode 1 is an Episode Briefing that can be found in the Historic District of Metropolis. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Dying of the Light: Episode 1 is an Episode Briefing that can be found in the Historic District of Metropolis. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The Green Lantern Corps takes its fight with the Yellow Corps to Earth!

sections.title: Part 1: Dying Light I: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Location: Rooftop of Urgent Care. North of City Hall.

Briefing: Lois Lane : "This is Daily Planet Live and I’m Lois Lane. Intergalactic peace-keeping force, the Green Lantern Corps is on Earth investigating a mysterious interference with their rings. Often called “the most powerful weapon in the universe”, Green Lantern rings draw upon the user’s own will to create green hard-light constructs. The Sinestro Corps reports similar issues with their rings and accuse the Green Lanterns of sabotage. Peaceful negotiations seem unlikely."

sections.title: Part 2: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Location: Back of City Hall, across the street ground level by burning fire.

Briefing: Vicki Vale : "This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch! Green Lantern – John Stewart. Not just a member of the Justice League, but a leader of an intergalactic police force, able to create hard-light constructs from the force of his will alone. When not fighting crime, Stewart runs his own architectural agency. Check out his work at the new Justice League Watchtower."

sections.title: Part 3: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Location: Rooftop, West of City Hall.

Briefing: Jack Ryder : "I’m Jack Ryder and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because the Green Lantern rings are the most powerful weapons in the universe and now, we have dozens, no, hundreds, no, THOUSANDS of them here on Earth! Not to mention all those Sinestro rings blasting out yellow fear. What’s next, pink, orange, blue? You think there are only two Corps out there in the galaxy? Well, friend, YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Location: Ground-Level, South Dam Entrance in front of Right-Side Statue. South of City Hall.

Briefing: Lois Lane : "This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. The fear-obsessed intergalactic criminal Sinestro is at large in Metropolis today, despite the Green Lantern Corps’ campaign to bring him down. Sinestro and his followers use fear where the Green Lanterns use will to power their rings. Citizens are warned to steer clear of the conflict."

sections.title: Part 5: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Location: Ground-Level, Behind building, Northeast of City Hall.

Briefing: Lex Luthor : "*beep* Lex Luthor speaking. Don’t waste my time, Mr. Mayor. LexCorp employs the vast majority of Metropolis’ citizens, in fact I own most of the island. I’d hate to have to withdraw my support should you not clear up this… little misunderstanding about the Metahuman Wing at Metropolis General Hospital. And no, Lex Luthor doesn’t threaten. He acts."

images.label: Dying Light I - Lex Luthor Map

sections.title: Part 6: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Location: Ground-Level, Sidewalk in front of "Gallery" building (with "Stacy's" posters), directly South of Metropolis Museum of Art.

Briefing: Superman:" This is Superman to City Hall staff and security. We are temporarily evacuating City Hall. So if you can hear my voice clear the area now. If you cannot get to safety either I or the Metropolis Police will find you. They are trained to rescue civilians in these situations. Stay hidden, stay calm, and the situation will be resolved shortly."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Lois Lane, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Daily Planet News Brief: Wreckage and debris are all that remains in the wake of the Historic District's brush with intersellar conflict. The city estimate damages in the billions of dollars, and fighting continues in some parts of the district. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

title: Dying of the Light: Episode II (Briefings)
summary: Sinestro pits his Lantern Corps against the might of the JSA!

sections.title: Overview
items: See Also: Player Briefings

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Sinestro pits his Lantern Corps against the might of the JSA!

sections.title: Part 1: Dying Light II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: On the top of the building South of the bottled Daily Planet Building.

Briefing: Vicki Vale : "This is Vicki Vale with the JLA Watch on one of my personal favorite members of the Justice Society, Alan Scott. This dashing Green Lantern doesn't need a ring to channel the power of the mystical Starheart. Along with Jay Garrick, Alan Scott is the heart of the Justice Society, working alongside Power Girl, Captain Marvel, Wildcat, and more when not fighting intergalactic evil with the Green Lantern Corps."

images.label: Dying of the lightII - vicki vale - alan scott

sections.title: Part 2: Dying Light II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: On the lower part of a building three blocks East from the Midtown Police Station, near the trees.

Briefing: Vicki Vale : "I'm Vicki Vale, and this is JLA Watch on Hawkman and Hawkgirl; two birds of a feather fighting together with the Justice Society and the Justice League. Hawkman and Hawkgirl will not confirm but rumor has it that even death cannot separate them for long. Instead, they are endlessly reincarnated to find each other again. Look for them flying high above Metropolis."

sections.title: Part 3: Dying Light II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: Southeast from Centennial Park, in the area where cylindrical buildings form a circle. The node is on the top of the building that's facing a Pub and a Photo-Mart.

Briefing: Vicki Vale : "This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch on the Justice Society's big, bad bruiser, Wildcat. A long time member of the Justice Society, Wildcat has no meta-human powers but remains a force to be reckoned with. Criminals are lucky to make even one round against this burly boxer. We asked how he would handle Brainiac and the scores of new villains. His response? 'With a one-two punch.' I'm Vicki Vale."

images.label: Dying of the lightII - vicki vale

sections.title: Part 4: Dying Light II: Maggie Sawyer
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: West from the area where cylindrical buildings form a circle, on the top of a building with a subway sign on the ground level.

Briefing: Maggie Sawyer : "This is Captain Sawyer to all Science Police Units. All units prepare for transport of the special containment unit. Even with Sinestro's ring close to drained, his powers of fear are no joke, and his forces will be looking for him. So let's focus and leave the drama at home. It's go time, people."

images.label: Dying of the lightII - maggie sawyer

sections.title: Part 5: Dying Light II: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: From the hero rally point at the South margin, next to the bridge to Little Bohemia, the node is on the ground level between the first and second buildings to the North.

Briefing: Lex Luthor: "Charity, this is Lex on the coded frequency. Report in your attempt to infiltrate the Science Police. So far they prove remarkably... resistant to our usual takeover policies. Perhaps the Green and Yellow Lantern Corps War's the opening we need. Don't. Make. Me. Wait. Or I'll replace you with another agent. I'm sure we'll be speaking soon."

sections.title: Part 6: Dying Light II: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: East from the bridge to Little Bohemia, the node is on the top of a origamic-ish skyscraper.

Briefing: Superman: "This is Superman. Alan, Jay, are you there? I'm at the Watchtower with Martian Manhunter. The JSA proximity alarm has been triggered. We've been unable to raise Captain Marvel and Conduct, and Power Girl is in Smallville dealing with the fallout from Luthor's Doomsday experiment. Do you need JLA backup? Please respond. If no response to this hail, I will send in reinforcements. Again, please respond."

title: Emotional Entities (Briefings)
summary: Emotional Entities is a global briefing describing the entities that embody the each of the emotional energies that comprise the Emotional Spectrum. It is part of the War of the Light Part II episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Emotional Entities is a global briefing describing the entities that embody the each of the emotional energies that comprise the Emotional Spectrum. It is part of the War of the Light Part II episode.

references.label: War of the Light Part II

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Hal Jordan is one of the most knowledgable experts on the Emotional Entities. As such, he's giving a report to Green Lanterns and their allies.

sections.title: Part 1: The Butcher
items: Zone: Metropolis Battlezone
Region: Midtown
Location: Top of building, east of Rage mist area, 3 blocks Northeast of Hero rally point.

Briefing: Hal Jordan:" All right, listen up. The Butcher is the embodiment of Rage, which makes up the red light of the emotional spectrum. Red Lanterns like Atrocitus are consumed by that rage and are some of the toughest enemies we've had to face. The Butcher's rage has taken over one of our greatest members, Guy Gardner, on multiple occasions. And I thought Guy had a big mouth when he had a green ring."

sections.title: Part 2: Ophidian
items: Zone: Metropolis Battlezone
Region: Historic District
Location: Middle of LexCorp Tower

Briefing: Hal Jordan:" Now, I'm going to tell you about the incarnation of Avarice, Ophidian. A big, orange space snake. Oan records suggest that Ophidian popped into existence when a creature ate more than it needed for the first time. While overabundance can seem awesome, I will let you know now, that beings driven by greed are in misery. Larfleeze's actions are inexcusable, but what that orange ring puts him through is brutal."

sections.title: Part 3: Parallax
items: Zone: Spark of Parallax
Region: Qward
Location: First 'corridor', behind the rocks.

Briefing: Hal Jordan:" The manifestation of Fear, Parallax, was born the first time a creature experienced terror. The Sinestro Corps convert that same terror into yellow hard-light constructs which they can use in their twisted plans of domination and control. I have experienced a direct connection to Parallax. It was not an experience I ever want to have again."

sections.title: Part 4: Ion
items: Zone: Spark of Ion
Region: Oa Central Power Battery
Location: Avaricious Cheetah room, behind the battery Hal Jordan uses to recharge his ring before the battle.

Briefing: Hal Jordan:" Obviously, we're pretty familiar with Ion, the embodiment of Will. It's believed that Ion came to existence when a life form first willed itself to move. Did you know that Lantern Rayner was once host to Ion? Now he serves as a member of the Honor Guard with great pride."

sections.title: Part 5: Adara
items: Zone: Metropolis Battlezone
Region: Midtown
Location: Building furthest directly North of Midtown Outpost; next to bridge in Blue Lantern Mist.

Briefing: Hal Jordan:" According to Oan records, the embodiment of Hope, Adara, was born the first time a sentient being prayed in a time of danger. Despite the Guardians' doubts, I've come to know that Hope can be a very powerful ally."

sections.title: Part 6: The Predator
items: Zone: Love and War
Region: Zamaron
Location: At final boss area ( Carol Ferris must be defeated to make crystal destructible)

Briefing: Hal Jordan:" Love...is complicated. Carol and the rest of the Star Sapphires see it as the greatest o all emotions and try to protect it, but love's volatile and sometimes damn hard to predict. The entity of love Predator, isn't any different. It can be domineering, hell, all entities can be. And since they've been nearly destroyed, they'll do anything to cling to their existence."

sections.title: Part 7: The Other Entity
items: Zone: Avarice Impurity
Region: Oa Central Power Battery
Location: Inside Larfleeze's room, next to the entrance.

Briefing: Hal Jordan:" Finally, I know that there's another entity, but I haven't heard or seen much of it in this war. Perhaps it has escaped whatever happened to the rest of the emotional entities. Guess we'll find out eventually, huh."

summary: Enigmatic Puzzles is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across the Otisburg district of the city of Gotham, near quest objectives for the story arc "_". There are six parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Enigmatic Puzzles is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across the Otisburg district of the city of Gotham, near quest objectives for the story arc "_". There are six parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Edward Nygma's love of mind-taxing puzzles and games is well known. Collecting an assortment of his favorites might give us insight into the mind of the Prince of Puzzles.

table.caption: Collectibles
rows: Riddler here... Bah. This coffee table book is simply derivative of a greater work.
Riddler here.. I see you've stopped to find my Go. What a classic game of wits. Zhou Dynasty classic.
This is Riddler. Ah, the Towers of Hanoi. In order to understand the Towers you must... understand the Towers.
Riddler here...I'm no fan of the Knight but I do enjoy controlling the pawns.
Riddler here...The Soma cube is akin to an elegant philosophy...But I'm sure someone of your mental capacity is more familiar with the brightly colored puzzle cube.
Riddler here...this puzzle box, when correctly put together, reveals an internal secret.... Think of it like the prize inside a box of Booster Bits.

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Batman or the Riddler, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Nygma is famous for his love of puzzles, but rarely are they a harmless game. I'll keep these puzzles you gathered onhand. They may serve to solve a future mystery."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " The more of them you take, the more of them you leave! What are they? Not the puzzles you gathered, although I do appreciate you returning them to me. Give up? Footprints!"

Etrigan's Thoughts is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across locations in Cursed Gotham City as part of the Justice League Dark Cursed episode. There are 7 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Speaking on the team, it's The Demon's own esteem.

sections.title: Part 1: Etrigan on Constantine
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: On the top of the building in front of The Gotham Tap Room, located south from the House of Mystery.

Investigation: Etrigan: " Constantine? A fool, fumbling with power, only dimly perceived, while the dark lords glower. He sees not that his efforts in vain, only delay the time his soul they do claim."

sections.title: Part 2: Etrigan on Zatanna
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: Over a Stacy's billboard at a tall building west from Gotham Cemetery, on the limit of the map.
Investigation: Etrigan: " Simple intent said plain but in reverse, as effective a pretense as a rhyming curse. She's deceptively formidable as a foe; Have caution, lest ye meet with woe.'"

sections.title: Part 3: Etrigan on Batman
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: At a building east from 15 Kane Street (Abandoned), northwest from the Moon-Touched Gorgon arena.
Investigation: Etrigan: " Something's amiss and out of place, when mice with wings wear a human face. Blind to the realm beyond this one, as an enemy it's known he's second to none.'"

sections.title: Part 4: Etrigan on Merlin
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: On the top of the building north from the Gentleman Ghost arena.
Investigation: Etrigan: " I inflict torture, combat and infinite pain. Your restraint, prison, and servitude are my bane."

sections.title: Part 5: Etrigan on Gentleman Ghost
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: At the mausoleum in Gotham Cemetery, halfway between the Moon-Touched Gorgon and Gentleman Ghost.
Investigation: Etrigan: " Does that motley appearance make you brave? Or simply serve it to swaddle your grave?"

images.label: Etrigan's Thoughts - Etrigan on Gentleman Ghost

sections.title: Part 6: Etrigan on Superman
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: At the side of a building east from Gotham Cemetery.
Investigation: Etrigan: " Yea, coiffure curled and muscles flexed, but when with magic he is hexed, leader of so-called supermen, kneels 'fore Hell's best, Etrigan!"

sections.title: Part 7: Etrigan on a Futile Future
items: Zone: Cursed Gotham City
Location: At the second to the east building from the House of Mystery.
Investigation: Etrigan: " Watching you battle like black ants upon red, and I looming 'bove your hill, one or one thousand, all will be dead, you scurry, you flurry, to me you stand still."

images.label: Etrigan's Thoughts - Etrigan on a Futile Future

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Zatanna, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Yeah, Etrigan might be a self-interested, back-stabbing demon who puts his own interests above the JLD... but he also comes through in a pinch. Kinda like Constantine, I guess, so guess we gotta give Etrigan a pass on this one. Just be glad you never came up. Nothing gets feels quite so personal as an insult to meter and rhyme."

sections.title: Overview
items: Falcone's Finest is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across the Burnley district of the city of Gotham, near quest objectives for the story arc Gotham's Gang War's Episode 1. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The GCPD keeps extensive files on Falcone's chief lieutenants. Recovering those files would raise eyebrows with a number of interested parties.

sections.title: Part 1: GCPD File on "Knuckles" Farrelli
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley

Location: There are two nodes for this part in the Burnley Waterfront, both at the same block with a building two blocks south of East End Big Belly Burger (in front of Intergang Penthouse) / one block southwest of the East End Regal Hotel / two blocks west and one block south of the LexCorp Reclamation Project ( Party Crashers mission area). One is on sidewalk at the northwestern street corner, and the other is next to the planter at the southeastern corner.
Investigation: GCPD Officer: " GCPD File: "Knuckles" Farrelli - Wanted on multiple counts of assault and battery."

sections.title: Part 2: GCPD File on "Matches" Malone
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley

Location: There are two nodes for this part, both at the East End Big Belly Burger parking lot in front of Intergang Penthouse ( Smash and Grab mission area). One is at the southwestern corner by a damaged Big Belly sign next to some GCPD cars, and the other is by a fallen Big Belly sign at the northeastern corner.
Investigation: GCPD Officer: " GCPD File: "the Match" Malone - Six counts of arson, three convictions, and one count of insurance fraud."

sections.title: Part 3: GCPD File on "Carbomb" Carmine
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley

Location: There are two nodes for this part, both at the area of the conflict between the Falcone mob and the GCPD southeast of The Gotham Tap Room, the North Burnley Nightclub (first The Big Paycheck mission area). One is in an alleyway behind the building southeast of the Tap Room [image]. The other is in the alleyway northeast of the Gotham Freight Yards sign.
Investigation: GCPD Officer: " GCPD File: "Carbomb" Carmine - Freelance agent hired out to numerous overseas operations, trained in Europe."

sections.title: Part 4: GCPD File on "Aggro" Antonio
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: There are two nodes for this part. One is on the sidewalk north of the Gotham Freight Yards sign, crossing the street near Professor Daft [image].
Investigation: GCPD Officer: " GCPD File: "Aggro" Antonio - Former Football player for the Gotham Knights, wanted in connection with four bank robberies."

sections.title: Part 5: GCPD File on Eliot "the Eel" Spencer
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley

sections.title: Trivia
items: Matches Malone and his brother Carver were a pair of small-time criminals who had resorted to a life of crime after they were orphaned. Their specialty was insurance fraud and arson, but they never crossed the line into violence. Looking to expand their trade, the brothers made a move to Gotham City where they ran afoul of the Batman. Attracting the vigilante's attention when Carver was murdered, although Malone was the prime suspect, there was no concrete evidence to make the charges stick and Matches was released. Undeterred, the Batman watched Matches' every move until he apparently committed suicide by torching himself with gasoline. However, Batman, who had been attempting to establish a criminal alias for himself to help gather information, opted to not report the death and instead adopted Matches' identity to use as an alias within the criminal underworld.

Investigation: Nightwing: " Nightwing. Daily report. The trouble with Trigon's sons has grown out of control. They're snatching people off the streets! And dragging them into Trigon's prison realm. This dimension is like my worst nightmare. Gotham gone to hell. with no chance of redemption."

sections.title: Part 4: Nightwing's Report 8-04
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Location: Southwest corner of the central area, on one of lava-like patches

Investigation: Nightwing: " Nightwing. Daily report. Like any loving family, there's quite a bit of rivalry among Trigon's children. They each have their own followers, their own Cult. Each of them deparate to prove their value to their father figure. I wouldn't know what that's like."

sections.title: Part 5: Nightwing's Report 8-05
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Location: East side of Wrath's Territory, inside the bridge-like structure in the central pillar.

Investigation: Nightwing: " Nightwing. Daily report. All this... this 'sinful energy' being generated... It's starting to get to some of us. Gar's been flirting with every woman in camp, even the Sentinels. Wonder Girl's been bemoaning how she wishes she were as 'cool' as Wonder Woman. Cyborg snapped at one of the new recruits. I seem to remain immune to the sins. It must be my skills and training."

sections.title: Part 6: Nightwing's Report 8-06
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Location: North side of Lust's Territory, within one of the arches in the central pillar.

Investigation: Nightwing: " Nightwing. Daily report. No matter how bad things get, I know the Titans will stick together and put an end to Trigon and his sons. Wonder Woman and I are working on a new plan, it should turn the tide in our favor. We agree that we should bring the fight to Trigon himself."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Thank you for recovering these reports and keeping them out of Circe's hands. Your efforts are vital in helping us keep Trigon imprisoned."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Poor little Nightwing. He's having so much trouble keeping a handle on current events, Of course, he's only one little moral surrounded by goddesses and demons."

title: Gotham's Gang War: Episode I (Briefings)
summary: Gotham's Gang War: Episode I is an episode briefing that can be found in the Burnley district of Gotham City. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Gotham's Gang War: Episode I is an episode briefing that can be found in the Burnley district of Gotham City. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The Falcones and the GCPD slug it out in Burnley!"

sections.title: Part 1: Gang War I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: Under the railway West of Ellis Memorial Convalescent House.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale and Gotham Now! The Joker. *beat* No matter how often Batman defeats his terrifying schemes, nothing ever cures his psychopathic drive to burn Gotham to the ground. Now, with the new generation of superpowered tech villains under his control, can anyone hope to keep the Joker from driving this city mad? Vicki Vale, for Gotham Now!"

sections.title: Part 2: Gang War I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: Inside the Gotham Freight Yards grounds, West of the crane on the ground, next to a pile of shipping containers.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" Vicki Vale for Gotham Now! Crime: these new superpowered villains have made gang violence in Gotham worse than ever. But reports indicate that Batman's ally, the Huntress, is meeting the mob head-on. Gotham's hospitals are stocked with crime lords cursing her name. Who will triumph on these mean streets? Stay tuned to Gotham Now!"

sections.title: Part 3: Gang War I: Commissioner Gordon
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On the front of a building with Gotham Gazette billboards, West from Gotham Freight Yards.

Briefing: Commissioner Gordon:" Commissioner Gordon to all units. The Falcone Crime Family is set to receive a ship of Apokoliptian weaponry at the East End freight yards. That means every costumed crazy freak in town is going to war - Bane, Two-Face, the Penguin, you name it. We're going to stop Gotham's gang war now and stop it hard. Let's get it done!"

sections.title: Part 4: Gang War I: Police Radio
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On the top of the building in Gotham Freight Yards, next to the crane.

Briefing: Officer:" Special Crimes Unit to GCPD remote units. The criminal Catwoman has been sighted in the East End. Suspect is wanted for numerous robberies throughout Gotham and is considered armed and very dangerous. Do not attempt to intercept. Repeat, do not intercept. Call for Special Crimes support immediately."

sections.title: Part 5: Gang War I: Batman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: Across the street of Gotham Tap Room, in front of the Credit Union building
Briefing: Police Dispatch: " Dispatch, emergen..." --/
Batman: *breaking in* " This is Batman. I'm sending in the Huntress to deal with the Falcones. She takes a - personal interest in mob violence. She'll shut this down. Batman out."

sections.title: Part 6: Gang War I: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On the building Northwest from the Original Wayne Enterprises Building, on the side with a Gallery sign.
Briefing: Joker:" Now for a real bang. Will it be them or you? You'll never know until you try! *laughs*"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Vicki Vale, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Gotham Now News Brief: Fires continue to burn in Burnley tonight after an altercation between the Falcone Mob and the GCPD. The vigilante known as the Huntress was seen accepting medical attention from a GCPD unit before leaving the scene. For Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale."

title: Gotham's Gang War: Episode II (Briefings)
summary: Bane and the Falcones skirmish in the Gotham's East End!

sections.title: Overview
items: See Also: Player Briefings

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Bane and the Falcones skirmish in the Gotham's East End!

sections.title: Part 1: Gang War II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: Two blocks West from Cape Carmine Lighthouse, on the top of a building with Gotham Gazette and Yap outdoors next to the villain rally point.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" Welcome to Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale. Batman and the Joker: a deadly duo. Now Batman's fight against the Joker's lethal chaos has reached a new level. Gotham Now has learned that both Batman and Joker are leading entire hero and villain factions. In fact, everyone from the Falcones to the Penguin are building up their ranks. What does this mean for Gotham? Stay tuned to Gotham Now"

sections.title: Part 2: Gang War II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: On the building Northwest of the Old Soder Cola Plant.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Gotham Now, and I'm Vicki Vale, with alarming reports that the steroid-addicted muscleman Bane has returned to Gotham, and that use of his drug, Venom, is spreading. Bane is wanted in over 17 countries, on charges ranging from assault to an attempted military coup. Is he back now to once again try to take down the Bat? We'll keep you posted."

sections.title: Part 3: Gang War II: Booster Gold
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: On the building West of Old Soder Cola Plant. It's visible from the Part 2 spot.

Briefing: Booster Gold: " Hey kids, this is Booster Gold! I don't need drugs to have superpowers, and neither do you! Villains like Bane think Venom makes them strong, but steroids just make you weak. So remember, Booster Gold says: 'Stay gold, stay away from Venom!'"
Announcer:" This message was brought to you by the Martha Wayne Foundation. "

sections.title: Part 4: Gang War II: Police Radio
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: At the construction site Northeast from the docks, on the second floor.

Briefing: Harvey Bullock: " BULLOCK to dispatch. We got both Killer Croc and Nightwing in the city tonight. I hear Croc's working muscle for the Falcones, so between the freaky reptile and Batman's showoff flyboy, eh, it's anybody's bet who takes down Bane first."
DISPATCH: " Sounds like a popular guy."
BULLOCK: " Yeah, life's hard for us he-men. Say, you doing anything later tonight? *pause*. Dispatch? Aw, c'maaaan!'"

sections.title: Part 5: Gang War II: Batman/Bane
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: On the top of a fire exit staircase, at a group of small buildings West of Cape Carmine Lighthouse.
Briefing: Bane: " I am Bane, and this is the voice of the enemy. The Bat! I will break him!"

Batman: " This is Batman. That Venom you're injecting, it will destroy you from the inside. There is only one kind of strength and it doesn't come from a drug, but until you come clean you'll never know what that is."

sections.title: Part 6: Gang War II: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Location: On the building facing the docks.

Briefing: Joker: "*interference* Harley, I have TOLD you, DO NOT touch my equipment! I can't tell if this is set to send or receive or electrocute. Why, I could be broadcasting this signal that Morrow rigged and liquifying every brain cell in Gotham at this very moment. Daddy has a GANG WAR to plan! I've got Bane and the Falcones at each other's throats, now all I need is - Harley, *noises off* You what?! DON'T tidy! DON'T! DON'T TOUCH ANYTH - *clicks off*"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Vicki Vale, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Gotham Now News Brief: Police are still unable to explain tonight how a massive gang riot broke out in Gotham's East End. From reports, powered heroes and villains jumped in the fray on both sides of the conflict. Details are still pending at this late hour. For Gotham Now, I'm Vicki Vale."

Part 3 and 5 reference the Batman: Venom storyline from 1991, in which Batman decides to use an experimental drug after failing to save a little girl's life, which leads to addiction. It features the first appearance of the drug Venom.

title: Hall of Doom Holographic Tokens (Investigations)
summary: Hall of Doom Holographic Tokens is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Hall of Doom, and is only available to Villains. There are 4 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Hall of Doom Holographic Tokens is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Hall of Doom, and is only available to Villains. There are 4 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: These holographic tokens are dispensed in each of the major area of the enormous Hall of Doom base. They were established by the base's under-minions as informational uploads for the hundreds of new villains that now rule the lower echelons of the station.

sections.title: Part 1: Magic Wing Token
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Location: In the Magic Wing of the Hall of Doom, under the entrance ramp on the north side of the room.
Investigation: Calculator: " Calculator here. You've found the Magic-wing holo-token. These Society members use occult forces for evil, they're mentored by the goddess Circe."

sections.title: Part 2: Tech Wing Token
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Location: In the Tech Wing of the Hall of Doom, under the entrance overhang on the North side of the room.

Investigation: Calculator: " Calculator here. That impressive symbol is the mark of the tech wing. Tech-using Society members use technology and gadgetry to spread mayhem and villainy. They're lead, so to speak, by the Joker."

sections.title: Part 3: Meta Wing Token
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Location: In the Meta Wing of the Hall of Doom, under the entrance ramp on the right side of the room.
Investigation: Calculator: " Calculator here. That would be a Meta Wing holo-token. Meta Society members have power in their genes. As in DNA. They're mentored by Lex Luthor."

sections.title: Part 4: Hub Token
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Location: Under the hub of the Hall of Doom, in the Pit, right around the center.
Investigation: Calculator: " This is Calculator. The holo-token represents the Hub, the core of the Hall of Doom - the seat of power for the Secret Society of Super-Villains."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from the Lex Luthor, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Welcome to the Society, well done gathering those holo-tokens. Just remember: We have every trick at our disposal, every opportunity available, and no one and nothing will stop us. They're going to try. But that just makes our final victory even more triumphant."

items: This collection rewards the player with the Shielded Promethium Shirt chest item (Style: Contemporary Tech).

title: Hawkgirl's Quandary (Briefings)
summary: Hawkgirl's Quandary is a global briefing that can be found in the Thanagar open world zone and the Metal Pt. II: The Phoenix Cannon raid. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Metal Part II episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Hawkgirl's Quandary is a global briefing that can be found in the Thanagar open world zone and the Metal Pt. II: The Phoenix Cannon raid. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Metal Part II episode.

references.label: Metal Pt. II: The Phoenix Cannon

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Hawkgirl's loyalities are torn. How can she fulfill her obligations to Earth, Thanagar, the Blackhawks, and Hawkman without betraying any of them... Or herself?"

sections.title: Part 1: The Blackhawks
items: Zone: Thanagar
Location: On top of a platform in the large round zone in the Northwest.

Briefing: Hawkgirl:" I was honored to start working with the Blackhawks. They're a legendary fighting squad of pilots without peer. Most people don't know that ever since World War II, their organization has continued fighting the forces of evil!"

sections.title: Part 2: Thanagarian Politics
items: Zone: Thanagar
Location: In the upper south corner of the small round area in the west of the area.

Briefing: Hawkgirl:" Thanagarians respect strength, but it takes more than power to gain their trust. Helping them against their enemies in the Cult of the Seven Devils is a step in the right direction."

sections.title: Part 3: Dare to Hope?
items: Zone: Thanagar
Location: To the west, between three trees up on a cliff

Briefing: Hawkgirl:" I don't know if Wonder Woman is indominable or just naive to still have hope. Earth's been invaded, Hawkman and Superman and missing or captured. Evil versions of Batman are running rampant. Even our efforts to evacuate won't save most of Earth's population... and none of that matters if all of reality sinks into the Dark Multiverse."

sections.title: Part 4: Competing Loyalities
items: Zone: Thanagar
Location: In the bushes a little northwest of the safezone.
Briefing: Hawkgirl:" Earth. Thanagar. The Justice League. The Blackhawks. And then there's Hawkman. Can I be loyal to all of them without betraying any of them?"

sections.title: Part 5: Maces out
items: Zone: Metal Pt. II: The Phoenix Cannon
Location: In the hall where you start out, on the first storey towards the exit on the left behind some containers.

Briefing: Hawkgirl:" With everything we're facing, it's hard to stay hopeful. Sometimes I wish I could just focus on fighting without worrying about the big picture. Hitting things is just so much more... satisfying."

references.label: Metal Pt. II: The Phoenix Cannon

rows: " The outlook on this battle with the Dark Multiverse is bleak. We're fighting on multiple fronts, including inside our own heads!"

sections.title: Overview
items: Hearts of Darkness: Episode 1 is an Episode Briefing That can be found in the Tomorrow District of Metropolis. There are six parts that comprise this briefing and it is part of the Hearts of Darkness story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Giganta and Wonder Girl face off in the Tomorrow District!

sections.title: Part 1: Darkness I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the roof garden of the building 2 blocks South from the Metro Station Building, North of Lieutenant Lethantos.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " I'm Vicki Vale and this is JLA Watch! Today: Wonder Girl! Daughter of Zeus? Former champion of Ares? Or just an ordinary teen - with extraordinary powers? Luckily for us, she follows in the footsteps of her mentor, Wonder Woman, and even the Amazons of Themyscira hail her as one of their own. Together, they use their Olympian god-given talents to battle tyranny."

sections.title: Part 2: Darkness I: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On mid-level roof of the building two blocks North from the Metro Station Building and West of Starrware.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane at Daily Planet live. S.T.A.R Labs recently released the body swapping research of Dr. Doris Zuel, also known as " Giganta". Giganta, a known criminal, has the ability to grow to enormous size and is the sworn enemy of Wonder Woman. S.T.A.R Labs said, quote: "They saw no harm in releasing the research since only a miracle could make it work." I'm Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live."

sections.title: Part 3: Darkness I: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the top of the building where the Metropolis Tomorrow District Skilled Aerial Movement Challenge is located, South from the station across the street from the Science Spire.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I'm Jack Ryder, and you are wrong - if you think the goddess Circe's Bestiamorphs all came from ancient Greece! You'll know different the moment Circe makes you her animal slave! That's right, her buddies the Bestiamorphs all used to be as human as you and me. YOU could spend the rest of your life as a rhino! In a thong! Think I'm joking? YOU ARE WRONG!"

references.label: Metropolis Tomorrow District Skilled Aerial Movement Challenge

sections.title: Part 4: Darkness I: Maggie Sawyer
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the roof garden near the top of the building East of Metro Station Building.

Briefing: Maggie Sawyer: " This is Captain Sawyer to all MPD Science Police units. I've authorized Wonder Woman's Amazon army to operate in Metropolis against a possible occult threat. These are armed woman warriors, people, with an ironclad culture of honor in combat, so don't cross them. Any issues should be directed to DMA Agent Diana Prince. Sawyer out."

sections.title: Part 5: Darkness I: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District

Location: In the Jerry White Memorial Eco Corridor area, on the top of the building on the Bar, a Gallery, a Games store, a Sun Doller Coffee, and a Pharmachy on the ground level - West of Lieutenant Lethantos. It's near a swimming pool and a tree.
Briefing: Circe: " Your goddess speaks. See what occurs when magic is used by those who refuse to understand it? Only those who embrace its power are fit to rule!"

sections.title: Part 6: Darkness I: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the building Southwest from the New Troy Central Station block. On the East side of building, on the covered balcony.

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " This is Wonder Woman, and I have left this orb for those seeking the truth. Circe seeks to steal Wonder Girl's power and enslave the Amazons. Break her deceptions and lead us to victory."

sections.title: Overview
items: Hearts of Darkness: Episode 2 is an Episode Briefing That can be found in the Chinatown district of Metropolis. There are six parts that comprise this briefing. The first three can only be found in the Chinatown Electronics, a Walk-In instance accessible only for characters mentored by Wonder Woman or Circe; characters of other origins must form a group with a character of magic origin to access the instance.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Wonder Woman and Circe race to grab all the mystical exobytes they can!

sections.title: Part 1: Darkness II: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Instance: Chinatown Electronics
Location: Second room, behind a pipe in the wall (before the portal).

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. Doctor Fate's magic confirms other scientific research that Exobyte canisters can be sorted by content. While each tiny Exobyte contains a mixture of magical, technological, or metahuman information, canisters can clearly be sorted by type. What does this tell us about Brainiac's agenda here on Earth? More as we have it on Daily Planet Live."

sections.title: Part 2: Darkness II: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Instance: Chinatown Electronics
Location: In The Guardian's Chamber (Minotaur arena), behind the brazier in front an Antique Defender Carving at the North wall.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I am Jack Ryder and you are wrong! Because no mortal man has ever been to the Amazon Island of Themyscira, but the Amazons are ALL over our "Man's world"! Now we've got man-beasts and minotaurs and giant living statues popping out all over the place! Think they'll invite us over to Paradise Island when this is done? YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 3: Darkness II: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Instance: Chinatown Electronics
Location: Before entering the Scrying Chamber, face the room then turn around - it's behind a pile of ruble. (Don't enter before collecting the node, the passage will shut once you get in.)

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I am Jack Ryder, and you are wrong! Why? Because you don't believe that right under this city, maybe even right next door, exist some of the most dangerous occult locations in the world! That's right, friend, they're not in Themyscira. Not in Limbo. Not in the Shadowlands. Circe, Eclipso, Brother Blood - they're setting up shop right here! Don't believe me? YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Darkness II: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Instance: Circe's Stronghold
Location: In the first room of the instance up above on the ledge by the entrance.

Briefing: ' Lois Lane: ' " STAR Labs, Lexcorp, WayneTech, Cadmus, and other research facilities around the globe reported mass thefts of magical Exobytes from their facilities today. According to Lucius Fox of WayneTech, any Exobyte container holding occult information disappeared "as if by magic". The Science Police, Gotham's Special Crimes Unit, and the Sentinels of Magic have all been assigned to the case."

sections.title: Part 5: Darkness II: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Instance: Circe's Stronghold
Location: Inside Circe's Throne Room, next to the entrance.
Briefing: Circe: " *ringingly* I AM CIRCE! I AM YOUR GODDESS AND WILL BE OBEYED! Magical Exobytes belong to magic users alone! Heed my will - or become my slave!"

sections.title: Part 6: Darkness II: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Instance: Circe's Stronghold
Location: In the room after the first portal, the node is above the entrance, on the top of a column (you can hear it when you go inside).

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " I leave this Orb for all who fight to change destiny! Exobytes carry the powers Brainiac stole from our future. They belong to us all! We must keep them safe - and use them against Brainiac's tyranny!"

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Doctor Fate, Zatanna, and the Sentinels of Magic go up against Eclipso in Midtown Metropolis!

sections.title: Part 1: Darkness III: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: On top of the Metropolis Fire Department Engine Co. 128 building, two blocks North of Cain Street Mall.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. The goddess Circe is spreading occult energies across Metropolis. But the Justice League's spellmistress, Zatanna, remains undaunted. She confirmed that the Sentinels of Magic have secret bases across the world to keep Circe's power in check. As she says, quote, "The Sentinels still have a few tricks up our sleeves.""

sections.title: Part 2: Darkness III: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: In the alley behind the housing complex East of Cain Street Mall, next to two Trash Dumpsters.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " This is Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Because you think poetry is all flowers and sunshine! I have it from good authority that in hell - the fiery pit hell, you know the one - the top demons - get this - speak in rhymes. Like the Demon Etrigan, a red ball of fiery hate who spews poetry like lava! Think poetry is just for sissies? YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 3: Darkness III: Diamond District
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown

Location: Near the building South of the Sentinels of Magic Base (Midtown) (the base is located Southeast from Cain Street Mall, the portal is only visible to villains). The node is on the ground- level on the side facing the water.

Briefing: Announcer: " Sun and moon. Day and night. You and your special someone. When two things just go together, you know it's right. That's when it's time to head to the Diamond District. Our merchants have the best selection of jewelry you'll find anywhere, for the most reasonable prices. Metropolis' Diamond District. A jewel in the heart of the city."

sections.title: Part 4: Darkness III: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: South of Cain Street Mall, under the bridge to Little Bohemia. The node is next to planters near the water.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " This is Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because that dark shadow over Metropolis isn't pollution, it's Eclipso's darkness, bringing about eternal night! His spells turn people into spellbound thralls to serve his every dark whim! Think the new heroes are gonna be able to stop this? Sorry, friends, YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 5: Darkness III: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: On the ground- level among the housing complexes South of Centennial Park, Northeast from the Sentinels of Magic area.

Briefing: Circe: " This is Circe. I am not a forgiving goddess - and I am most displeased. My servant Eclipso seeks only to free the Spectre from his human bonds! And yet you, a so-called hero, seek only to imprison him once more! Call yourself what you like - [seductive, threatening] I see your heart, and I know it lies."

sections.title: Part 6: Darkness III: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown

Location: On the roof of a building West of Cain Street Mall. It has an Ice Cream shop, a Video store, a Sun Doller Coffee, a 1hr Photo, a Custom Furniture store, and a Blaze Comics shop on the ground-level.

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " I am Wonder Woman. May this Orb of Athena bring some small light to your dark path. For if you succeed in uniting Eclipso's Heart of Darkness, you will unleash an evil to corrupt even the power of the gods. No one can control it - certainly not Circe. Turn from your path... before it is too late!"

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Aquaman leads an Atlantean assault against the Drylanders!"

sections.title: Part 1: Darkness IV: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Suicide Slums
Location: On the roof of a Metro Station Building next to the highway.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. Aquaman, the King of the Seas, is famed for his massive strength, as well as his natural prowess underseas. Together with the Justice League, Aquaman has always worked for peace between the surface and the kingdom of Atlantis. Now Queen Mera's recent disappearance may mean the end of that dream. Stay tuned to Daily Planet Live."

sections.title: Part 2: Darkness IV: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Suicide Slums

Location: In the area under construction, right in the center of the first floor above the ground of a construction site South from a "Cinema" building with a Nora's Frozen Treats billboard on the roof.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale with a special JLA Watch! on the Justice League's Martian Manhunter. The sole survivor of the Martian race, the Manhunter is a powerful telepath and a gentle shapeshifter. And with those shifting skills, you never know! The person next to you just could be - Martian Manhunter!"

sections.title: Part 3: Darkness IV: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Suicide Slums
Location: On the top of the tower at the entrance to The Metropolis Shipyards.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I am Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because Atlantis is rising, friend, and the fish people want this world back! They claim they're descendants of the original " magis" of earth, and they've got the magic to turn us all into water-sucking slaves. Think you won't be spending your life as a muck-sucking guppy by the time they're through? Hate to break it to you, friend, but YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Darkness IV: Booster Gold
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Suicide Slums
Location: Outside of the Northeast docks, near a Doctor Fate's Ankh.

Briefing: Booster Gold: " Hey kids! This is Booster Gold. Sometimes people think they're better than you, because they have powers and you don't. Isn't that unfair? So remember - Booster says, stay Gold! Give people a chance before you call them two-bit publicity-hogging glory hounds! 'Cause that really hurts a guy's feelings, y'know?"
VOICE: " This message is brought to you by the Martha Wayne Foundation."

sections.title: Part 5: Darkness IV: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Suicide Slums
Location: On the stairs at the entrance of one the houses in the housing complex located Southeast from Ace o' Clubs and North from a Metro Station Building.

Briefing: Circe: " Atlanteans! It is Mera, your queen! I have returned! Now, together with Arthur, your King, I command you - Rise! Enslave the dry-landers! Claim your heritage and rule earth, sea and air! No longer must our pure magical blood cower beneath the waves - attack! And take what is ours! Atlantis shall live again!"

sections.title: Part 6: Darkness IV: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Suicide Slums

Location: On the top of building with a Bibbo's Burgers billboard, Southwest to the Steelworks sign, across the street of an abandoned Liquor shop/ Bar. There may be a Distressed Citizen next to the node.

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " J'onn, this is Diana. You must get close enough to this " Queen Mera" to read her mind. Your telepathic skills should allow you to discern the real story behind this invasion - and free Aquaman himself!"

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The unquiet dead rise as the Spectre terrorizes Downtown Metropolis!

sections.title: Part 1: Darkness V: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: Next to a building West of the Metropolis Bank near the bridge leaving Metropolis. The node is on the Southeast corner of said building.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch! on the emerald warriors Green Lantern and Green Arrow! Long-time friends through thick and thin - and we're talking death, alien possession, even a few ends of the world! - the two continue to fight side by side against villainy. Look for this lean mean green fighting team wherever injustice is found!"

sections.title: Part 2: Darkness V: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: On the rooftop of the Lexor Hotel building two blocks Northwest from the Lair of the Spectre / the Glenmorgan Square point of interest.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane at Daily Planet Live with an urgent Sentinels of Magic report. Eclipso, once God's fallen agent of vengeance, has escaped from his Sentinels of Magic prison and is loose in the city. Eclipso is able to unleash the dark side of human nature, symbolized by the Eclipse. He will target any powerful supernatural source for his own; all citizens are warned to be on guard."

sections.title: Part 3: Darkness V: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown

Location: Glenmorgan Square, on the building behind Doctor Occult, the one with billboard advertising The Daily Planet and a Green Lantern Corps exhibition in the Metropolis Museum of Art. The node is on the balcony of the Lounge on the North side.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " This is Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because the end is nigh, my friends! Ever hear of the Spectre? He's God's Vengeance, friends, and now he's not working alone! That's right, he's released an army of angry spirits to judge humanity! Think no one sees your sins? Think you can always be forgiven? Better think again, friends, because YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Darkness V: Booster Gold
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: On the top of the central building (a.k.a. Lair of the Spectre) in Glenmorgan Square.

Briefing: Booster Gold: " Hey kids. This is Booster Gold. Judging people before you get to know them isn't fair to them or you. Don't judge a book by its cover - I mean, even if you don't read that many books. This is Booster Gold reminding you to Stay Gold! Get to know someone first!"
VOICE: " This message was brought to you by the Martha Wayne Foundation."

sections.title: Part 5: Darkness V: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: From the point where the Eastern highway meets the ground, go East until you get to the curve, then turn South. The node is next to the golden statue of Pegasus and Bellerophon.

Briefing: Circe: " This is Circe. I am not a forgiving goddess - and I am most displeased. My servant Eclipso seeks only to free the Spectre from his human bonds! And yet you, a so-called hero, seek only to imprison him once more! Call yourself what you like - [seductive, threatening] I see your heart, and I know it lies."

sections.title: Part 6: Darkness V: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: On the golden building West from the bridge leaving Metropolis.

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " Wonder Woman to all my allies. We must cure the Spectre's madness before he takes vengeance on all worlds! But, remember even he deserves our compassion. What you see here is magic robbed of humanity. This is the world Circe would make for us. Give the Spectre back his soul - and protect all of ours."

sections.title: Trivia
items: For Part 1:; Oliver Queen and Hal Jordan became an iconic duo during their partnership after Oliver lost his wealth and went through an identity crisis. Green Arrow became co-protagonist in the Green Lantern comics by issue #76 (1970), a partnership that would grant them the title of "Hard Travelling Heroes." The duo was dissolved in issue #122 (1979) for editorial reasons.; When Vicki Vale mentions " a few ends of the world," she's referencing all of the events that are known to the DC Universe as "Crisis" (a major crossover event across multiple issues that usually resulted in a soft reboot). Up to that point, the events were: Crisis on Infinite Earths (1985-1986), Zero Hour (1994), and Infinite Crisis (2005-2006).; Vicki Vale refers to " alien possessions," probably alluding to two events. The first is the storyline Emerald Twilight (1994), in which Parallax was able to possess Hal Jordan after he found out his city had been destroyed (this possession is referenced yet again in the S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility alert and the Spark of Parallax solo challenge). The second is Blackest Night (2009-2010), in which Green Arrow succumbed to Nekron and became a Black Lantern.; Green Arrow died by sacrificing himself to save Metropolis from a terrorist attack ( Green Arrow #101, 1995). During the events of The Final Night (1996), Oliver was resurrected by Parallax-possessed Hal Jordan (those events made them vulnerable to Nekron during Blackest Night), and Jordan sacrificed himself to stop the Sun from going supernova and exterminating life on Earth. Hal Jordan's spirit would later be taken by the Spectre as his new host during Day of Judgment (1999), as a way to atone his actions as Parallax (Hal becomes a temporary host for the Spectre again during the Lair of the Spectre instance, and that version of the characters make brief apparitions in House of Legends' Living Quarters). In Green Lantern: Rebirth (2004-2005), the Spectre managed to purge Parallax from Jordan's soul and left to find another host, and a Guardian directed the spirit to his old preserved body, bringing him back to life as Green Lantern in time to save Green Arrow and Kyle Rayner from Sinestro. Green Arrow died briefly when he became a Black Lantern during Blackest Night, but was revived by Hal Jordan with the power of the White Lantern Corps.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "The Shadowlands beckon as Circe and Wonder Woman spar!"

sections.title: Part 1: Darkness VI: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Instance: C.A.O. Dam
Location: Last room, on a recess to the North (upper-level).

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live. The Sentinels of Magic report that an imbalance in magical force seen worldwide is the result of Brainiac's initial attacks on the magical realms. Dimensions under attack include Limbo, which has been utterly transformed by Brainiac's influence. Lightkeeper Lee spoke for the Sentinels, saying that a complete defeat of Brainiac is the only hope."

sections.title: Part 2: Darkness VI: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Instance: C.A.O. Dam
Location: Last room, on a recess to the South (upper-level).

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch! Fans of the Justice League know that other realms are linked to our own as sources of power. One of these is the Shadowlands, source of Obsidian's power. A mysterious land of darkness not yet fully explored, its powers are yet to be understood even by the magic users who dare its dark thresholds."

sections.title: Part 3: Darkness VI: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Instance: C.A.O. Dam
Location: Limbo: At the train-wreck in the second room.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I am Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! You think heroes and villains don't hang out? You think they don't call a truce over a brewski and swap war stories? Well, friend, let me tell you about the Oblivion Bar, where magical mooks hang out sipping eye of newt and tongue of bat! Don't believe me? Think it can't be real? Well, friend, the YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Darkness VI: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Historic District
Instance: Oblivion Bar Walk-In / Shadowlands Duo
Location: Shadowlands: In the first room, behind the violet beam.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live. The first results of Brainiac's attacks on the magical realms were seen here in Metropolis, where Madame Xanadu's magic shop is closing its doors until the crisis has passed. According to the chain owner, Madame Xanadu, the magical artifacts were seen weeping and crying out in pain, creating a negative atmosphere for customers and shop staff alike."

summary: History of Mordru is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across ... as part of the Justice League Dark episode. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: History of Mordru is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across ... as part of the Justice League Dark episode. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The Wizard at the Rock of Eternity assigned me a book report on Mordru from the Historama. Nobody told me being Shazam included homework!

sections.title: Part 1: Immortal Lord of Chaos
items: Zone: Limbo Town
Instance: JLD: Fellowship of the Arcane
Location: Behind the shack in the north of the map

Investigation: Shazam: " According to the Historama, Mordru is one of the most powerful Lords of Chaos, destined to survive even after the end of the universe. Weird to think he'll be causing trouble a thousand years in the future. I sure hope there's always heroes brave enough to fight against him!"

images.label: History of Mordru - Immortal Lord of Chaos

sections.title: Part 2: Entombed
items: Zone: Shattered Gotham
Instance: JLD: Shattered Gotham
Location: On the slanted small floating structure to the right of the entrance area. (You need to jump through the portal left to it to reach it.)

Investigation: Shazam: " The Historama says Mordru existed even before the universe was created. They called him "Lord Wrynn" on Gemworld. That's where he first got buried alive. No wonder he was so mad about getting entombed in the Rock of Eternity."

sections.title: Part 3: Fated to fall
items: Zone: Shattered Gotham
Instance: JLD: Shattered Gotham
Location: On a small floating structure you pass by on your advance through the map - the one where you need to jump from into the moving portal

Investigation: Shazam: " Mordru tried to steal Dr. Fate's helmet and Fate sealed him in the Rock of Eternity? That's a baller move. Why do I have to read about this in the Historama? Oh, right. Because Fate wouldn't know a story if bit him in the amulet."

images.label: History of Mordru - Fated to Fall

sections.title: Part 4: Taphephobe
items: Zone: Chaos Gotham
Location: On the ground level of the Pillars of Hades in Robinson Park

Investigation: Shazam: " Mordru has taphephobia? What the heck is that, Historama? Oh, fear of being buried alive. So then what's claustrophobia? Never mind. Feels disrespectful to use the Historama for stuff I can search with my phone."

sections.title: Part 5: Plethora of Powers
items: Zone: JLD: Shattered Gotham

Location: On the single large round floating island at the right middle of the map. (You have to take the portal off the roof of the temple and then let the ground portal catapult you onto the island.)

Investigation: Shazam: " Astral projection, flight, force fields, teleportation, energy blasts, reality manipulation... geez, Historama! Is there anything Mordru can't do?[pause] Oh, thanks! I'm sure him having no sense of humor will come in real useful if we sic Beast Boy on him."

images.label: History of Mordru - Plethora of Powers

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Dear fellow hero, here's some stuff you should know about Mordru. He's the worst! Your friend, Shazam"

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I, Mordru, bequeath this knowledge upon you, my newest vassal. Learn well that you may better serve your dark lord!"

sections.title: Item
