sections.title: Trivia
items: Most of these investigations reference the events of the storylines JSA: Savage Times and JSA: Princes of Darkness (2002-2004), more specifically issues #42 and #43, and #45 through #51. Although it canonizes those events in the game's main continuity, it also highlights key differences; in DCUO, Shazam was not present in the story and, apparently, the Doctor Fate in the story was Kent Nelson instead of Hector Hall.; For Part 1:; It references the words of Fate as he buried Mordru: " Even as the stars burn out and the universe dies, even as time itself ends--you will still be trapped here, preserved like an insect in amber."; It alludes to the fact that, in the comics, Mordru was created to serve as an enemy to the Legion of Super-Heroes: " The Justice Society started something that not even you can erase. From the new generations within our ranks, to the men and women of the Justice League and the Teen Titans... even thousands of years after our final battle - a legion of heroes will still exist." - Doctor Fate (Hector Hall); In Part 2:; "Entombed," directly references Hall's words: " Mordru is finished. Entombed in a place where he'll hurt no one."; Both the investigation and the comics reference the events of the Amethyst limited series (1987-1988), the story about how Mordru came to possess Lord Wrynn of Gemworld.; The information in Part 4 was uncovered by Doctor Fate: " I've looked into your soul, Mordru. I know what you fear more than anything. Being constrained. Bound. Buried."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The HIVE is attempting to mine Exobytes embedded in the surface of the Moon!"

sections.title: Part 1: HIVE Moon Base: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Region: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Location: Center of map - between Inprocessing Center and Harvester.

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" This is Amanda Waller to Checkmate. The moon is loaded with exobytes from Future Luthor's detonation. If the Justice League or the Society don't succeed in taking out Brainiac's HIVE minions, I'm authorized to take extreme measures. We're all fond of the moon, but planetary security is on the line."

sections.title: Part 2: HIVE Moon Base: Lois Lane
items: Zone: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Region: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Location: Southern part of map, between Inprocessing Center and Harvester.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" Lois Lane reporting for Daily Planet Live on an urgent situation developing on the moon, where Queen Bee and her mind-controlled HIVE are moon mining for exobyte canisters embedded in its surface. All evidence points to the HIVE being in league with Brainiac. Both the Justice League and the Society of Supervillains have released full-scale alerts."

sections.title: Part 3: HIVE Moon Base: Booster Gold
items: Zone: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Region: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Location: North of Harvester, above where Harvester boss spawns.

Briefing: Booster Gold:" Hey kids! This is Booster Gold. I don't need to join a super-crime confederation to feel tough, and neither do you. Villains think destroying free thought and forcing others into crime makes them powerful, but it just makes them bullies. So remember - Booster says, stay Gold!"
Voice:" This message was brought to you by the Martha Wayne Foundation."

sections.title: Part 4: HIVE Moon Base: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Region: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Location: Southeast leg of Harvester.

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" Waller STAR Labs with executive override code A-W-C-M-1. Realign the camera on Geosat-7 for a better look at the HIVE operation on the Moon - and the heroes and villains swarming in to take them out. We can't get good intel on their numbers without some optical surveillance. Make it happen. Waller out."

sections.title: Part 5: HIVE Moon Base: Agent Serenity
items: Zone: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Region: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Location: H.I.V.E Starport, underneath the ramp leading up to all ships from Moon floor.

Briefing: Agent Serenity:" Agent Serenity to Lexcorp. Don't bother trying to communicate with the HIVE. Get those Exobytes. And don't worry about interference from the so-called heroes. Plenty of time to balance the scales back on Earth."

sections.title: Part 6: HIVE Moon Base: Superman
items: Zone: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Region: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
Location: Just west of H.I.V.E. mothership.

Briefing: Superman:" Brainiac, this is Superman. You know who I am. And you know I've defeated you before. But it's not just me standing against you now - it's an entire generation of heroes and villains. This can end peacefully, now, if you simply withdraw from our solar system. I'm offering you this chance. I urge you to act on it... now!"

Investigation: Saint Walker: " Ranx began existence as a sentient city for space-faring traders, but has since grown to be so much more. A menace with a weapons array that may be powerful enough to crack a planet! Ranx's hatred of the Green Lanterns has caused him to join with the Sinestro Corps."

items: Zone: Mogo's Command Center (heroes) / Assault and Battery (villains)

Investigation: Saint Walker: " The people of Metropolis are good people, living, working, raising families. It is a great tragedy that a galactic war has landed on their doorstep. Hope Shines Bright is a global briefing that can be found in Frozen Mogo and Summit of Sorrow. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Hope Burns Bright chapter in the Light and Rain story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Saint Walker of the Blue Lantern Corps reports on those who find Hope in the face of great turmoil and danger on Mogo."

sections.title: Part 1: The Farmer
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Region: Blue Lantern Outpost
Location: Outside of the western wall.

Briefing: Saint Walker: " I met a Durlan farmer today. They proudly showed me their recent Mogoberry crops, harvested in spite of the dangers present now on Mogo. "Easier to have hope on a full belly," they said. I agree."

sections.title: Part 2: The Messenger
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Location: In the area of the second crystal, on the rocks to the south.

Briefing: Saint Walker: " Briya of H'lven delivers news on Mogo when comms are down - and they are often. She told me "Good news gives people hope, so I especially like delivering that." May the Blue Light guide her."

sections.title: Part 3: The Comedian
items: Zone: Frozen Mogo
Region: Abandoned camp
Location: Outside the western wall.

Briefing: Saint Walker: " Finta Gopp tells jokes for a living, and brings hope to others through laughter. I admit, his joke about Sinestro's mustache is quite amusing... to me, at least. Sinestro... not so much."

sections.title: Part 4: The Protector
items: Zone: Summit of Sorrow
Instance: Luzia's Summit of Sorrow
Location: In the area with multiple downed Blue Lanterns, on a column of rock to the north.

Briefing: Saint Walker: " "I'm no Lantern, but I'm big and strong and sometimes, that's enough." - those are the words of Hu-Reitah, a guard at a refugee camp. Their courage brings hope to those they watch over and protect."

sections.title: Part 5: The Reporter
items: Zone: Summit of Sorrow
Instance: Luzia's Summit of Sorrow / HBB: Summit of Sorrow
Location: In the area with 2 fallen Blue Lanterns (where you leave Brother Warth), by the rocks behind the northern Lantern.

Briefing: Saint Walker: " "All will be well - great line. Gonna quote you on that - my readers need to hear such things!" Those are the words of Brrk, an reporter for the Hive Mind of Zhuz. Spreading a message of hope to billions is a most noble deed."

sections.title: Part 6: The Healer
items: Zone: Summit of Sorrow
Instance: Luzia's Summit of Sorrow / HBB: Summit of Sorrow
Location: In the area where you reunite with Saint Walker, by the wall on the northern side.
Briefing: Saint Walker: " Yan Urt is an unusual Khund - a healer, not a warrior. He works tirelessly to help the sick and injured, bringing hope to people who need it most."

sections.title: Part 7: The Builder
items: Zone: Summit of Sorrow
Region: Central Power Battery
Instance: Luzia's Summit of Sorrow / HBB: Summit of Sorrow
Location: Up on the rocks southeast of the Power Battery.

Briefing: Saint Walker: " Aada of Dryad is a skilled stonemason, and works tirelessly to maintain the walls protecting camps on Mogo. A safe haven brings the Blue Light of Hope to all who live within it."

sections.title: Overview
items: Joke's on You is a temporary 5-part briefing during the April Fools Event. The collection nodes appear at several spawning locations in the Amusement Mile area in Gotham City. In contrast to regular briefings, these nodes are purple, and are not continuously present--respawning after a while. Briefing parts already collected reappear in white instead of purple.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The unflappable Titanic Trenton is one of Earth's greatest heroes...to stand around flexing. The Joker and Harley Quinn decide to test his mettle.

sections.title: Part 1: Titanic Interrogation
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Amusement Mile
Location: Randomly at several spawning points around the roller coaster
Briefing: TITANIC TRENTON: *splashing water, choking* What...what the? Oh my god! You're the...
JOKER: The Clown Prince of Crime? How about the Merry Madcap of Mayhem? HA! I've always been fond of that one.
TITANIC TRENTON: What do you want? Why did you bring me here?
JOKER: Calm yourself, my boy! Just a little good old-fashioned Q & A, that's all.
HARLEY QUINN: We provide the Q, you give us the A. You got that?

sections.title: Part 2: Thick as Thieves
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Amusement Mile
Location: Randomly at several spawning points around the roller coaster
Briefing: JOKER: Let's begin, shall we? Why don't you start by telling us what you know about, oh, say... police station security codes.
TITANIC TRENTON: I...I don't know anything. Only the uh... Commissioner has access to those codes.
JOKER: Now, now, no need for lies. We're all friends here. Thick as thieves! Isn't that right, Harley?
HARLEY QUINN: I don't know...I kind of want to kill him.

sections.title: Part 3: Sweating Bullets
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Amusement Mile
Location: Randomly at several spawning points around the roller coaster
Briefing: TITANIC TRENTON: Look, I told you before - I don't know anything!
HARLEY QUINN: He's lyin'. I could spot that poker face from a mile away.
JOKER: She's right, you know. You should really work on that face of yours. This costumed twerp is really beginning to bore me. Harley! Get the goo.
HARLEY QUINN: Comin' right up!

sections.title: Part 4: In Hot Water
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Amusement Mile
Location: Randomly at several spawning points around the roller coaster
Briefing: TITANIC TRENTON: Wait! Please, stop! What is that stuff?!

JOKER: Oh, just a perilous little concoction I whipped up. Pretty nasty stuff. Lucky for you we already gave it a test run on one of your chums from the Watchtower last week. You should've heard him! Mamma! Mamma! Hahahahaa!
HARLEY QUINN: Bet his mamma didn't recognize him after that little makeover. Enough talkin', let's see how your face holds up under pressure...
TITANIC TRENTON: No, please! Not the face! Anything but the face! NOOO!!

sections.title: Part 5: Bon Appetit
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Amusement Mile
Location: Randomly at several spawning points around the roller coaster
Briefing: TITANIC TRENTON: I've told you everything I know! Get that goo away from me!
JOKER: All right, Harley, put the goo back in the fridge. Actually, let me have a taste! *smack smack* Mmm-mmm, tapioca!

sections.title: Note
items: The parts for this briefing can be found in the following locations:
Up in the western edge of the roller coaster, near the entrance archway.
Under the bridge under the roller coaster.
Right bellow the Amusement Mile sign, in one of the lights.
On the roller coaster, at the highest point closest to the tent.
On the tower East of the tent, on the side facing the docks.
On the edge of the crane next to the stern of the ship.

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Harley Quinn, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Woo Boy, me and Mister J sure got Titanic Trenton talkin. But who can blame him? I make a KILLER tapioca pudding!"

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with the Mischievous Brief base item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Titanic Trenton is a male hero appearing while doing the A Daily Dose of Villainy street level mission.
This briefing was first available for one week on occasion of the April Fool's Day 2016
This briefing explains how the Joker got the security codes for the heroes' safehouses, which resulted in the events of The Last Laugh episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mogo Berry
Lantern Corps Notes is a global briefing that can be found in FD: Hidden Lantern Village. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Fearful Day story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Esperanza Cavalera's thoughts on the various Lantern Corps."

sections.title: Part 1: Red
items: Zone: FD: Hidden Lantern Village
Location: First portion of the Village, behind the first trailer on the right side of the main path.

Briefing: Esperanza Cavalera:" Each Red Lantern is driven by rage, often born out of tragic events. Many Reds seek to bring final justice to those who have wronged them - especially their leader, Atrocitus, who blames the Guardians for the destruction of his home sector."

sections.title: Part 2: Orange
items: Zone: FD: Hidden Lantern Village
Location: Second portion of the Village, between the wall and the last trailer on the left side of the main path.

Briefing: Esperanza Cavalera:" The first " Orange Lantern" I met was an energy construct created by Larfleeze, the only actual member of that corps. His all-consuming greed prevents him from sharing his power with anyone else... which is probably for the best."

sections.title: Part 3: Yellow
items: Zone: FD: Hidden Lantern Village
Location: Third portion of the Village (after destroying the rubble), behind the first trailer on the left side.

Briefing: Esperanza Cavalera:" The so-called " Sinestro Corps" was born on the planet Qward in the Antimatter Universe. There, Sinestro found allies who hated the Guardians as much as he did. They forged the first yellow power ring for him, which he used to spread fear throughout the galaxy."

sections.title: Part 4: Green
items: Zone: FD: Hidden Lantern Village
Location: Fourth portion of the Village, behind the second trailer on the right side.

Briefing: Esperanza Cavalera:" I've met several Green Lanterns - some of their best come from Earth. Many of them have worn rings other than Green; my friend John Stewart included. His experience with an Indigo ring has helped my sister Luzia considerably."

sections.title: Part 5: Blue
items: Zone: FD: Hidden Lantern Village
Location: At the start of the cave with yellow crystals, behind the player when they first spawn there.

Briefing: Esperanza Cavalera:" I wouldn't be alive if it weren't for the Blue Lantern Corps and their leader, Saint Walker. He saved my from a murderous band of mercenaries, and recognized the bright hope within my heart - a hope I can now share with the cosmos."

sections.title: Part 6: Indigo
items: Zone: FD: Hidden Lantern Village
Location: In the path between the yellow crystal cave and the final portion of the Village, up on the rocks on the right side.

Briefing: Esperanza Cavalera:" My sister Luzia has joined the Indigo Tribe, and seeks absolution for her crimes amongst their ranks. Her message of compassion has reached many in need of it, and I hope one day her journey back to the light will be complete."

sections.title: Part 7: Violet
items: Zone: FD: Hidden Lantern Village
Location: Southwest of the "Return to Last Location" portal, right behind the trailer.

Briefing: Esperanza Cavalera:" Love can be a very powerful emotion, and it is what drives all Star Sapphires. Their violet light can foster love in even the hardest heart. It can create a tether between loving hearts that can connect across great distances, as their leader Carol Ferris has discovered."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Esperanza Cavalera, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " While I am relatively new to a Lantern Corps, I have met many other wielders of light in my career. Should you encounter a wielder of a power ring, I hope my notes are helpful."

items: Mogo Acorn

Lanterns Lament is a global briefing that can be found in Book of the Black and Nekron's Lair. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Raging Night chapter in the Light and Rain story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Members of the various Lantern Corps reflect on the events in their lives that brought them grief and sorrow."

sections.title: Part 1: Blue
items: Zone: Nekron's Lair
Region: Nekron's cave
Instance: Nekron's Lair of Darkness / RN: Nekron's Lair
Location: In the room just before the Black Power Battery, hidden behind a wall in the southwestern corner.

Briefing: Saint Walker: " In my life, I have witnessed many tragic events... though none have taken a toll greater than the loss of my family on Astonia. I think of them often, and hope they have found peace."

sections.title: Part 2: Red
items: Zone: Nekron's Lair
Region: Swamp
Instance: Nekron's Lair of Darkness / RN: Nekron's Lair
Location: Inside the cave where the Zombie Abomination comes from.

Briefing: Atrocitus: " I shall never forget the massacre of my people at the hands of the Manhunters... the robot puppets of the so-called Guardians. It is the loss that lit the spark of Rage within me, the rage that fuels my ring and gives me power to seek vengeance."

sections.title: Part 3: Orange
items: Zone: Book of the Black
Region: Larfleeze's Chapter
Instance: Book of the Black / RN: Book of the Black Alert / RN: Book of the Black (Raid)
Location: Exiting the coliseum, by the exterior side of the wall to the left.

Briefing: Larfleeze: " Grief? Sorrow? Regret? I have but one regret! I regret that I do not possess each and every thing of value in the entirety of space and time! But they will be mine - oh yes! - they will be mine!"

sections.title: Part 4: Indigo
items: Zone: Nekron's Lair
Region: Refugee camp
Instance: Nekron's Lair of Darkness
Location: Inside a hollow trunk at the southwest corner.

Briefing: Indigo-1: " Prior to becoming the first member of the Indigo Tribe, I was a criminal and a killer. I regret that life, especially the murder of Abin Sur's daughter. As Indigo-1, I seek to atone for those acts through the power of compassion."

sections.title: Part 5: Violet
items: Zone: Nekron's Lair
Region: Swamp
Instance: Nekron's Lair of Darkness / RN: Nekron's Lair
Location: In the corridor leading to the horde with the Zombie Abomination, behind a group of pointy rocks on the southern side.

Briefing: Carol Ferris: " There were times where I wasn't a hero. I was a villain... and I did some terrible things. My mind wasn't entirely my own during those times, but I remember it all... and regret that any of it ever happened."

sections.title: Part 6: Yellow
items: Zone: Book of the Black
Region: Sinestro's Chapter
Instance: Book of the Black / RN: Book of the Black (Raid)
Location: Down near the water by the path leading to Sinestro, eastern side.

Briefing: Sinestro: " I have done many things that would bring a lesser being to suffer great pangs of sorrow... but not I. No, my one, true regret is my fall from grace, my banishment from the Green Lantern Corps... an act that the Guardians shall, in turn, regret."

sections.title: Part 7: Green
items: Zone: Book of the Black

sections.title: Overview
items: Leave of Absence is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Halls of Hades, Labyrinth of Lost Souls and Throne of the Dead raids, featured as part of the Amazon Fury Part II episode. It is comprised of five parts.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "A fallen Amazon reflects on her journey through Hades."

sections.title: Part 1: Crossing the River Styx
items: Zone: Labyrinth of Lost Souls
Location: Labyrinth's Apex ( Asterion's room)

Investigation: Fallen Amazon: " Surrounded by a frightened crowd on the banks of the river Styx, we all watch the water rush furiously by. My toll has been paid, and I will be ferried over at a time of my choosing, but I find it difficult to leave when so many others are stranded here with no way to cross. Some are so desperate, they are braving the current, only to be swept away and drowned repeatedly in their attempts. The perils of the afterlife are as threatening as the life left behind."

sections.title: Part 2: Cerberus' Watchful Eye
items: Zone: Halls of Hades
Location: Pool of Lethe

Investigation: Fallen Amazon: " At the edge of the underworld, I am gripped by fear for the first time in my life...err death. The entry gates are blocked by Cerberus, a terrifyingly large hellhound with multiple heads. He threatens anyone who dares approach with his burning stare, and a growl felt deep within the pit of one's soul. No story, fable, or myth could have prepared me for such a sight."

sections.title: Part 3: Kingdom of Hades
items: Zone: Halls of Hades
Location: Vestibule

Investigation: Fallen Amazon: " We were always taught that if we died with honor, we would go to a place of great beauty and warmth. If this is that grand place, then those teachings need to be drastically revised. It's an overall dreary place, with no sunlight to speak of, no warmth against my skin. Nothing could have prepared me for the size of this realm, or the number of people here with me. I've wandered around for days and have not seen anyone or anything twice."

sections.title: Part 4: Judgment Day
items: Zone: Throne of the Dead
Location: Underground hallway, southeast corner.

Investigation: Fallen Amazon: " I am next to be judged. I've done right by the goddesses, and my people during my time...haven't I? I'm more nervous than I have ever been. My soul is plagued with questions, doubts. Have I done something wrong? Have I done enough right? What will my past reveal to the Judges of the Underworld?"

sections.title: Part 5: Life After Judgment
items: Zone: Throne of the Dead
Location: South antechamber, next to the sazefone.

Investigation: Fallen Amazon: " I am relieved beyond imagination! My judgment went well. Standing before the Three Judges, I was anxious but hopeful. And I was not found wanting. I am now off to the Elysian Fields, where I can return to the duties that I enjoyed while I was with my people on Themyscira."

summary: Legacy of Krypton: Episode I is an Episode Briefing that can be found in Little Bohemia. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

Legacy of Krypton: Episode I is an Episode Briefing that can be found in Little Bohemia. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Lex Luthor and Parasite test the latest in LexCorp technology in Little Bohemia."

sections.title: Part 1: Krypton I: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Met U, roof of the building south of the bell tower.

Briefing: Lois Lane: "This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. The Metropolis Police Department announced today the formation of a new superpowered police force under the command of Captain Maggie Sawyer, formerly of Gotham City's special crimes unit. This new unit. the " MPD Science Police" will handle superpowered magical, meta, and tech crimes on the streets of Metropolis."

sections.title: Part 2: Krypton I: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Ground-level, last building next to the water. Southeast direction behind the bell tower.

Briefing: Lois Lane: "This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. All Charges were dropped today against Lex Luthor, the brilliant and charismatic head of the LexCorp empire. Law experts are stunned and outraged by the outcome. In related news, the Daily Planet has learned that LexCorp groundbreaking new advances in meta and military gear will soon reach the market. Is there a connection? More soon on this ongoing Daily Planet investigation."

sections.title: Part 3: Krypton I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Ground-level, near water. Northeast behind bell tower.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: "This is Vicki Vale with a special JLA Watch! Our subject: Power Girl, the Justice Society's charismatic Kryptonian powerhouse. Superman's cousin from another dimension. Power Girl has all of Superman's amazing abilities as well as his dedication to truth and justice. Look for her in the skies - by Superman's side, with the Justice Society, or supporting our newest heroes."

sections.title: Part 4: Krypton I: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: On the roof of the Met U stadium, in between the two air conditioning units.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: "I am Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because of a purple people-eater named Parasite, friend. He can suck the life force out of everything from a Studebaker to Superman. Even a Kryptonian is no match for Parasite's pain drain! And now Lex is whipping up billions of little parasites. And out of who? You and me, friend, you and me! And if you think he'll stop there - YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 5: Krypton I: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Met U, underneath rail support next to dormatory.

Briefing: Announcer: " LexCorp. It's not just a company. It's a dream - of realizing humanity's true potential. To soar in the skies, race a speeding bullet, stop a locomotive. To be more than merely - super. Want to seize you own power? Don't hesitate. Contact LexCorp today. LexCorp - dedicated to advancing humanity."

sections.title: Part 6: Krypton I: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Met U, southeastern corner of bell tower roof.

Briefing: Superman: "Some of you may recognize me [Cheers from audience] - They call me Superman. [More Cheers, then quiets down] Before I return to the Watchtower [Cheers], let me introduce my cousin, a member of the JSA [Cheers] who you may recognize as well - Power Girl!"
Power Girl: "[over the cheers] This is Power Girl..."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Lois Lane, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Daily Planet News Brief: Police are still gathering evidence today trying to unravel the incident at the University of Metropolis. Though requests to the JSA have been answered, Power Girl remains in seclusion. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

Legacy of Krypton: Episode II is an Episode Briefing that can be found in Little Bohemia. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Dr. Psycho runs wild in Metropolis General Hospital!"

sections.title: Part 1: Legacy of Krypton II: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: West River Quay, on the ground. On the street corner. East of the Hospital, underneath the east bridge leaving Little Bohemia. It is near a the 'Nora's Ice Cream' billboard.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Plant Live. Lex Luthor announced today that the new meta-human medical wing at the Metropolis General Hospital, which is entirely funded by Lex Corp, will also be staffed entirely by Lex Corp as well. Despite the protests of numerous Human Rights groups, the wing currently remains open to meta-humans seeking treatment for what Luthor terms their "unique needs."

sections.title: Part 2: Legacy of Krypton II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Near Metropolis General Hospital. On the ledge of a building, west of the hospital.

Using the map attached to this guide above, you will find this token located near the top of a massive building directly Southwest of Met General. The token is on the south face of this building's ledge with 2 Radar Dishes on top.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale with a special JLA watch on the super-teen called Supergirl. Superman's head strong younger cousin, Supergirl also survived the destruction of Krypton by coming her to planet Earth. She has all of Superman's amazing powers in a teenage girl's body. Lex Luthor, and criminals everywhere, you've been warned."

sections.title: Part 3: Legacy of Krypton II: Director Berganza
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia

Location: Brainiac Incursion Zone, northwest of the Hospital. On a ledge of a gold building, east of the Western Bridge leaving Little Bohemia. It is on the north side of the building, next to the antenna. There is a Brainiac Harvester Ship nearby the building.

Briefing: Director Berganza:" This is Metropolis meta-wing director, Edward Berganza, tendering my official resignation. I will no longer work with that maniac, Doctor Edgard Cizko. Psycho is right. Call him the head of meta-human research? *scoffs* The man's experiments belong in the medieval era, not in a modern hospital. Let Lex Luthor withdraw his funding, I will be calling the authorities."

sections.title: Part 4: Legacy of Krypton II: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Near Metropolis General Hospital. On the ground near the Race starting location. South of the Hospital .

This token is located within an alley running between two buildings. This token is on the est side of the alley, against the west building. The building it is up against has a southeast facing Metro Taxi billboard on its roof.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I am Jack Ryder and you are wrong. Why? Because you think is just a successful businessman when he is out stealing DNA, from us, from Power Girl, Supergirl, new meta humans, even Krypto for all we know! Think Lex won't lie cheat and steal to make those secrets his own? You're fooling yourself friend, in fact.. You are wrong!"

sections.title: Part 5: Legacy of Krypton II: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Metropolis General Hospital. Located on the lower bridge connecting the Helipad (meta-human research wing) and the main building.

Briefing: Lex Luthor:" Luthor to Lexcor, I'm sending in some of our new allies as reinforcements to get our test subjects under control. Oh yes, I understand Dr. Psycho is still inside dealing with our Kryptonian problem. Don't bother extricating him. If he can't survive this on his own, he's not worth saving. Luthor out."

sections.title: Part 6: Legacy of Krypton II: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Metropolis General Hospital. On a ledge about half way up the building, above the Booster Gold Kiosk on the north side of the building.

Briefing: Superman:" Kara, this is Kal-El. Luthor is targeting Kryptonians for their DNA. He cornered Power Girl earlier at her meta-human rally at Metropolis University. This time he may be after you. Be careful. I'm sending in our new allies as reinforcements. Superman out."

sections.title: Trivia
items: Edward Berganza worked as a writer and editor for DC Comics. He began working for the company in the early 1990s and got promoted to Executive Editor in December 2010 – a few days before the release of DC UniverseTM Online. More than one year later, he got demoted to Group Editor after reports of a "series of indiscretions." He got fired in November 2017, after reports of multiple accusations of sexual harassment.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Superman and Lex Luthor battle for control of STAR Lab's research!

sections.title: Part 1: Krypton III: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility

Briefing: Lois Lane: "This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. In breaking news, Doctor Jenette Kahn - widely reputed to be the leading expert on Brainiac's Exobytes - has fled LexCorp for STAR Labs. Doctor Kahn was unavailable for comment, but sources say she refused to participate in Lex Luthor's plans for her research. Doctor Kahn remains under close security until all issues with LexCorp are resolved."

sections.title: Part 2: Krypton III: STAR Labs
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility

Briefing: Announcer: "Welcome to Metropolis STAR Labs! STAR, or the Scientific and Technological Advanced Research Laboratories, were founded to be the world's premiere independent research resource. From our first lab, here in Metropolis, we've grown to have facilities all over the globe, from America to Kahndaq and beyond. We're proud of our work with Superman and the Justice League. STAR Labs - the sky is not the limit!"

sections.title: Part 3: Krypton III: Sarah Charles
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility

Briefing: Doctor Sarah Charles: "Doctor Sarah Charles to all STAR Labs employees. Doctor Kahn believes that Lex Luthor will send Metallo to confiscate her Exobyte research. As you know, Metallo has an enhanced titanium and plasteel frame around a kryptonite heart. Even Superman may not be able to repel this threat. All non-essential personnel are to evacuate now. Maximum security measures are in effect."

sections.title: Part 4: Krypton III: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: S.T.A.R. Labs Facility

Briefing: Vicki Vale: "This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch! We all know Superman is the Man of Steel. But John Henry Irons is Steel himself! Superman's close ally, Steel uses powered armor and a mighty metal hammer to pound out truth and justice. His company, Steelworks, is dedicated to providing the best possible armaments for the JLA. Look for him at Superman's side or wherever the JLA needs him most!"

sections.title: Part 5: Krypton III: Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: S.T.A.R. Labs Facility
Briefing: COMPUTER VOICE: "Security recording 977."
Lex Luthor: "Out of my way! Where is the woman who runs this place? I demand to speak to her immediately."
Doctor Sarah Charles: "Yes, Mister Luthor, I'm Sarah Charles, how may I --"

Lex Luthor: "I'm sure you're aware, Doctor Charles, that scientists at LexCorp sign a very. Strict. Confidentiality agreement. Which has been violated by Doctor Kahn. [Doctor Charles attempts to speak, is cut off] Don't interrupt me, Doctor Charles. Doctor Kahn's Exobyte research belongs to LexCorp. Your actions are an act of war and will be treated accordingly. Good day."

sections.title: Part 6: Krypton III: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: S.T.A.R. Labs Facility
Briefing: S.T.A.R LABS SCEINTIST: "STAR Labs metahuman research arm, Super hearing. Superman, ready...go."

Superman "I hear - wait. That can't be good. Is that... Luthor? With - Metallo? And that's Black Adam, in Bialya on the border of Kahndaq. It's Black Adam. Sorry, professor, I need to alert the JSA -- [equipment clatters, as if headphones being taken off, muttered protests from the professor, recording clicks off] "

rows: " Daily Planet News Brief: STAR Labs and LexCorp still refuse to comment today in what appears to be an inter-corporate war in the heart of Metropolis. Both Superman and Lex Luthor were spotted leaving the area in the wake of the battle. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

sections.title: Trivia
items: During Part 6, Superman hears two events. The first is Lex Luthor hiring Metallo to confiscate Doctor Kahn's research. The second is Black Adam exterminating the people of Bialya - he got manipulated into doing so by Azraeuz when the last of the Four Horsemen of Apokolips fled to the country after having murdered Isis and her brother Osiris, an action that led to the World War III event.
The subtitles for Part 5 indicate Lex Luthor's lines as "DOCTOR SARAH CHARLES".

Briefing: LOIS LANE: I'm not sure I should forgive you, Superman. I'm the one who broke the story about you in the Daily Planet, I even gave you your name! And you give your first interview to that - that schlub, Clark Kent?! /SUPERMAN: My apologies Miss Lane. I'm here now. What would you like to ask me about? /LOSI LANE: All right then. But I'm warning you, I don't pull any punches. So, your powers. How do they work? And is there a Mrs. Superman? /SUPERMAN: Ah... one question at a time, Miss Lane...may I call you Lois? My powers come from Earth's yellow son. They (it's rays) affect me differently giving me my (super) strength, flight, speed, and other powers like heat vision./LOIS: You look human. /SUPERMAN: I assure you, ah, Lois. I'm a man...Just not from Earth and I'll do whatever it takes to keep this planet safe.

sections.title: Overview
items: See Also: Player Briefings

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The face of Metropolis has changed in this altered timeline. Lex Luthor has taken up the mantle of absolute ruler, with the help of an alien enforcer.

sections.title: Part 1: LexCorp Personal Log Entry 6.2
items: Zone: Alternate Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location:

Briefing: Personal Log Entry 6.2. I have been working with LexCorp for about six months. When they shut down the MPD I had little choice. Keeping the peace is all I know. But these guys... they don't serve the people, people serve them.

sections.title: Part 2: Resistance Report 1
items: Zone: Alternate Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location:

Briefing: By the time the rest of us figured it out, Jack Ryder had known what Lex Luthor was up to for years. He tried to warn us, but nobody believed. A single man could orchestrate an entire global financial collapse. May be it won't be so bad for our children. If they never know what Metropolis used to be like, may be they won't know what they are missing.

sections.title: Part 3: LexCorp Personal Log Entry 12.1
items: Zone: Alternate Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location:

Briefing: Personal Log Entry 12.1. I have been working with LexCorp for about a year and I came to speak of the atrocities I have seen. I have been thinking of joining the resistance, but after seeing what they did to Green Arrow while he was in lockup..., I've had second thoughts.

sections.title: Part 4: Resistance Report 2
items: Zone: Alternate Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location:

Briefing: Day 3/25. We've lost some good people at the hands of Lex Luthor and his shocktroopers. Peaceful demeonstrations against the death squads didn't change a thing. So we're turned to more active resistance effort under Green Arrow. We have public oppinion on our side, but that scum Luthor has the media and that... that monster on his.

sections.title: Part 5: Luthor's Decree
items: Zone: Alternate Metropolis
Region: Downtown
Location: Lex Tower, behind a painting near healing barrel. Unlocked after fight with Lex and Superman.

Briefing: I want to thank the people of Metropolis for showing such unwavering support for your new protector, the LexCorp security aparatus. There are of course a few terrorists whose actions threaten our peace. Do not fear. They will be punished - along with their leader Green Arrow.

Luzia's Lament is a global investigation that can be found on Mournful Mogo. There are fourteen parts that comprise this investigation. It is part of the Raging Night chapter of the Light and Rain story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Luzia Cavalera looks back on the dark events of her life that led her to become... Gray."

sections.title: Map
items: Map with points of interest and landmarks for reference

sections.title: Part 1: CopyKat
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Dead Forest
Location: On the rocks by the Sorrow Crystal field by Makeshift Camp

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " I used to be a hero. I called myself CopyKat, because I could 'borrow' powers from others and use them as my own. When Brainiac's forces attacked, I was proud to stand with Superman and defend Metropolis."

sections.title: Part 2: Ambush
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Swamp
Location: Inside a tree stump slightly southwest of Corrupted Leshy's battlefield

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " Nothing lasts forever. One day on patrol, my partner and I were attacked by villains. I barely survived... my partner didn't. I remember them laughing at us before they flew away."

sections.title: Part 3: Vengeance
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Dead Forest
Location: Southwest of first Abandoned Refugee Camp, under the tree by the river of Fatal Corruption.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " I hunted the villains down, and when I found them, I didn't just 'borrow' their powers - I took them. I thought they'd go back to being normal humans... I didn't know taking their powers would kill them. But it did."

sections.title: Part 4: Addiction
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Dead Forest
Location: In the second Abandoned Refugee Camp, next to a trailer.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " Taking powers became an addiction for me. At first, I just took from villains, used it to justify my actions, I killed them, and called it justice... even though I knew I was wrong."

sections.title: Part 5: Reckoning
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Dead Forest
Location: On the pointed rock northeast of the southern bridge located north of the Valley of Sorrow.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " I became a vigilante, and Gotham City was my hunting ground. I had a new name - the Reckoning. I told myself I was doing what Batman didn't have the stomach for... but I knew better. Deep down, I knew I was a killer."

sections.title: Part 6: Neron
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Dead Forest
Location: Ground level, northwest of the southern bridge located north of the Valley of Sorrow.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " My addiction was out of control, and the withdrawals were agonizing. I needed more power, and it wasn't long before anyone with exobytes became my prey. I was on a downward spiral when he found me. Neron."

sections.title: Part 7: Contract
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Valley of Sorrow
Location: In the fog area southeast Brother Warth, behind a rock with a Blue Lantern.
Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " Neron told me pretty lies. Said what I needed to hear, promised me a cure... I just needed to keep killing. For him. And I did."

sections.title: Part 8: Fugitive
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Swamp
Location: On a rock in the black crystal area between the mission hub and the Valley of Sorrow.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " Neron wanted the souls of magic-users, and I delivered... but I got sloppy. Left a trail... a trail picked up by the Bat. He brought in allies to hunt me. He brought in Constantine."

sections.title: Part 9: Kaznia
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Canyon
Location: On the rocks above the canyon, near the mission hub.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " Neron sent me to Kaznia, where Felix Faust was leading a cult of Magents. He figured no one would miss them, and that Faust would take the fall for my actions. He figured wrong."

sections.title: Part 10: Heroes
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Swamp
Location: Inside a fallen hollow tree trunk north of mission hub and southeast of Corrupted Leshy's battlefield.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " Constantine found allies in Kaznia... a young hero called Voivode... and my sister. Esperanza. One of the Blue Lanterns... the ones powered by Hope. They tracked me down and cornered me, like a rabid animal."

sections.title: Part 11: Voivode
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Swamp
Location: Inside a fallen hollow tree trunk west of the rally point at the island with purple crystals.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " I could've surrendered, defied Neron, walked away from it all... but I didn't. I killed that girl. Voivode. She was trying to protect people, trying to stop me... and I killed her for it."

sections.title: Part 12: Indigo Tribe
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Black Lantern incursion area
Location: Southwest by the Black Lantern Breach.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " Esperanza and her friends stopped me. I was given a chance to make amends for all of the terrible things I did. I became a member of the Indigo Tribe... the lanterns of Compassion."

sections.title: Part 13: Redemption
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Black Lantern incursion area
Location: By the rock wall southeast of the Black Lantern Breach.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " For a while... I felt like a hero again. Helping instead of harming... healing instead of hurting. But like I said... nothing lasts forever. It all came crashing down on me here... on Mogo."

sections.title: Part 14: Gray
items: Zone: Mournful Mogo
Region: Black Lantern incursion area
Location: Northwest of the entrance to Nekron's Lair of Darkness, by a tree stump.

Investigation: Luzia Cavalera: " The fear witch Lyssa Drak killed my sister, and I couldn't save her, even with my power ring. And when Esperanza died... part of me died too. From that moment on, all I knew, all I felt... was gray."

title: Mera - Queen of Atlantis (Investigations)
summary: Mera - Queen of Atlantis is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone open world zone, the second part of the Stemming the Tide challenge and the Starro: Spindrift Station raid, featured as part of the Deluge episode. The investigation comprises of five parts.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mera - Queen of Atlantis is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone open world zone, the second part of the Stemming the Tide challenge and the Starro: Spindrift Station raid, featured as part of the Deluge episode. The investigation comprises of five parts.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Private moments with the Queen of the Sea."

sections.title: Part 1: Xebel-Born
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: On the rooftop of the scyscraper next to the hero safezone between two air outlets.
Investigation: Mera: " My first taste of Atlantis was as an outsider, a princess, and a spy. My loyalty then was to the throne of Xebel, but it was Arthur that changed all that."

sections.title: Part 2: Family
items: Instance: Stemming the Tide
Location: At the start of the Ninth Tride Outpost stage at a wall to the left

Investigation: Mera: " Atlantis became my home and Arthur, my king and husband. We were happy then and together we had an heir; a beautiful boy who I could find no fault in. Then that all ended when Arthur's enemy, Black Manta, took him from us."

sections.title: Part 3: Lost
items: Instance: Starro: Spindrift Station
Location: In the large hall where you fight Black Manta on the first floor to the right behind a lamp

Investigation: Mera: " I was distraught, my mind still fighting the Xebel magics at work. I blamed Arthur's land dwelling heritage and faulted him for our child not being able to recover from the poison Manta used. For the only time in my life, I felt weak and out of control. I retreated to Xebel and lost myself."

sections.title: Part 4: Found
items: Instance: Starro: Spindrift Station
Location: On the far side of the first room with the large central waterspout behind a column

Investigation: Mera: " Years passed and Poseidon brought me back to Atlantis and to Arthur. The wounds had closed but not healed. However together, we made peace once more. We found strength from our unit and with that strength happiness. Our goal, to share that happiness with all of Atlantis and the surface world."

sections.title: Part 5: Home
items: Instance: Starro: Spindrift Station
Location: In the room after the underwater puzzle with the two valves behind the far left column

Investigation: Mera: " While Arthur may be King of Atlantis, I am more than just his Queen. I am a woman, a wife, a mother, a warrior, and an Atlantean. Although my homeland is Xebel, my heart and blood resides here in Atlantis."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Aquaman or Ocean Master, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Mera's journey to Atlantis was wrought with obstacles, yet she overcame each one of them to become their greatest Queen. Our shared loss was deep, but together, we survived. And together, we guide Atlantis toward a better future."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Listening to Mera go on and on about my half-brother boils my blood. He's a fool for believing her lies. She is not what she seems."

sections.title: Item
items: This investigation rewards the player with the Atlantean Shield base item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Aquaman and Mera were first introduced in DCUO in classic game, during Hearts of Darkness: Episode 4, and the little information provided about them by then was based on the New Earth continuity: Mera was native of Dimension Aqua, she and Aquaman got married and had a baby together who was killed by Black Manta and drove them apart; the couple reunited years later after the events of the original Blackest Night. Their story was rebooted Post-Flashpoint, and the Deluge episode was adapted from the storyline introduced as part of the DC Rebirth, a initiative that still respected their reboot: Mera and Arthur were yet to get married and had no children; Mera was princess of the Kingdom of Xebel and was sent to Aquaman by her father to kill Arthur before falling for him. This investigations collection conciliates both continuities while clarifying which changes made in the comics are valid in DCUO lore.
This collection of investigations is named after the limited series Mera: Queen of Atlantis (2018) by Dan Abnett and Lan Medina.

items: Mogo Berry

Mogo Facts is a global investigation that can be found on Mogo's surface. There are eight parts that comprise this investigation. It is part of the Fearful Day chapter of the Light and Rain story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The sentient planet and stalwart Green Lantern discusses points of interest about himself and his role in the Green Lantern Corps.

sections.title: Part 1: Bolphunga
items: Zone: Mogo
Region: Refugee Camp
Location: From the stump near Kilowog, INSIDE another stump across the water.

Investigation: Mogo: " The bounty hunter Bolphunga the Unrelenting spent some time roaming my surface in search of a feared and mysterious Green Lantern... only to discover that the planet he stood upon was also the being he sought."

sections.title: Part 2: Mogo Doesn't Socialize
items: Zone: Mogo
Region: Green Lantern Outpost Alpha
Location: Behind the giant tree southwest of Outpost Alpha.

Investigation: Mogo:" It has been said that "Mogo doesn't socialize," and this is partially correct. I rarely visit other worlds due to the gravimetric issues that can occur. There are easier - and less disruptive - ways for me to communicate with others."

sections.title: Part 3: Mogo DOES Socialize!
items: Zone: Mogo
Location: From Mogo's Power Core entrance, following the pathway to the East until the lower level. The node is inside the big stump ahead.

Investigation: Mogo:" I have become more sociable over the years. I once served as the headquarters of the Green Lantern Corps, and have hosted a number of off-worlders upon my surface - even the space dolphin companions of Lobo."

sections.title: Part 4: Mogo-forming
items: Zone: Mogo
Location: West of Mogo's Power Core entrance, on the rock formation that connects to the border of the map.

Investigation: Mogo:" I have control over my weather, my soil, my plant life, even my gravity. The most common expression of these powers is a green belt at my equator that features the symbol of the Green Lantern Corps."

sections.title: Part 5: Construct Proxies
items: Zone: Mogo
Region: Green Lantern Outpost Beta
Location: On the giant rock above the river east of Outpost Beta.

Investigation: Mogo:" I often communicate with other sentient life forms by sending energy constructs generated by my power ring. I tend to fashion these constructs into forms that are inoffensive to those I wish to communicate with."

sections.title: Part 6: Power Rings
items: Zone: Mogo
Region: Amon Corps Encampment
Location: From the roots that cover a path at the southeast corner of the Encampment, to southwest behind the large rock surrounded by plants.

Investigation: Mogo:" One of my duties as a member of the Green Lantern Corps is to guide power rings to potential recruits to replace a fallen Lantern. Though I lament the passing of any Lantern, I also find joy in the arrival of a new sentient being to my beloved Corps."

sections.title: Part 7: Black Lanterns
items: Zone: Mogo
Region: Amon Corps Encampment
Location: North of the Amon Corps Encampment, inside a stump behind a rock.

Investigation: Mogo:" Once I was compelled to follow a standing order from the Guardians - to purge an infestation from Oa by any means necessary. I did so by using my gravity field to draw the Black Lanterns into my planetary core, there to remain... forever."

sections.title: Part 8: The Prophecy
items: Zone: Mogo
Region: Amon Corps Encampment
Location: On the rocks northwest from the Yellow Lantern Device near the Encampment.

Investigation: Mogo:" There is a prophecy that describes the end of the Corps. In it, the last Lantern - myself - is destroyed when the sentient city Ranx detonates a blink bomb in my core. Our enemies attempted to fulfill the prophecy - it pleases me to say they failed."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Mogo, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " As part of my continuing effort to be a better citizen of the galaxy, I have released this data for public consumption. I hope it proves to be enlightening."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with a Essential Willpower catalyst.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Parts 1 and 2 refer to the events of the story in which Mogo and Bolphunga first appeared: Tales of the Green Lantern Corps: Mogo Doesn't Socialize, originally published at Green Lantern Vol 2 #188 in 1985. The tale was one of the stories adapted in the 2011 animated movie Green Lantern: Emerald Knights.

Part 3:; Mogo became the headquarters for the Green Lantern Corp when Oa was destroyed by the villain Relic during the Green Lantern: Lights Out event (2013); The story of how the space dolphins ended up on Mogo is told in Mister Miracle Vol 2 #13 and Mister Miracle Vol 2 #14 (1990).
Part 7 refers to the events of Blackest Night (2009-2010).

Part 8 refers to the following events:; The Sinestro Corps War storyline, part of the War of Light event (2008-2009); The events of the Assault and Battery raid in the War of the Light Part I, which is heavily inspired by "Sinestro Corps War".

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Journal entries from Hope Cavalera.

sections.title: Part 1: The Pod
items: File:Briefings - Notes of Hope Part 1.jpg
Zone: Kryb's Lab
Region: Passageways
Instance: SoA: Kryb's Lab
Location: On a ledge overlooking the second Resin Door.

Briefing: Hope Cavalera: " I still can't get out of this stupid pod! I hate it. It's cramped, and dark, and... stinky. So gross! I think Kryb keeps it like this to mess with me... make me scared. She is a Yellow Lantern, after all, and they're all about fear. But she's gonna lose, I know it. I just have to stay alive... that's all."

sections.title: Part 2: The Vision
items: File:Briefings - Notes of Hope Part 2.jpg
Zone: Sunstone Refinery
Region: Corridors
Instance: SoA:Sunstone Refinery / SoA:Sunstone Refinery Alert
Location: Just past the door opened by the first security terminal, take the first right after the door (off Krypto's path) to a small room.

Briefing: Hope Cavalera: " Something crazy happened. I was freaking out and... I wanted help. I felt something out there... someone. I thought it was my mom... but it was someone else. She wears Mom's ring now.. and she's family. My aunt.. her name's Luzia. I don't know how but I talked to her... in my mind. I... I think I have super powers now!"

sections.title: Part 3: Not On Mogo Anymore
items: File:Briefings - Notes of Hope Part 3.jpg
Zone: Sunken Argo City
Region: Trench Next
Location: On a high ledge overlooking the long corridor that leads from the Trench Next to the entrance to Kryb's Lab.

Briefing: Hope Cavalera: " Kryb's taken me somewhere.. we're definitely not on Mogo any more. I can't tell for sure, but I saw something on a building when they moved my pod in here. It's the big S that Superman wears on his shirt. I thought Krypton blew up, but here we are."

sections.title: Part 4: Atlantis?!
items: File:Briefings - Notes of Hope Part 4.jpg
Zone: Kryb's Lab
Region: Pod Room
Instance: SoA: Kryb's Lab
Location: North wall of Pod Room, behind the 2nd pod from the right.

Briefing: Hope Cavalera: " "Kryb's been experimenting on new people. I heard a couple of them talking in their pods last night - they're from Atlantis. I think... I think we're on Earth now, underwater. If we're in Atlantis, maybe Aquaman will save us from Kryb and her monsters!"

sections.title: Part 5: Mean Cat
items: File:Briefings - Notes of Hope Part 5.jpg
Zone: Sunstone Refinery
Region: Sunstone Processing Plant

sections.title: Trivia
items: In Roman numerals, M=1,000, D=500, C=100, L=50, X=10, V=5, and I=1. The same letter can only be repeated 3 times (3=III, 4=IV). If the value of a letter is lower than the one that comes next, subtract that value from the highest number (IX = 10-1 = 9). If the value if a letter is equal or higher than the one that comes next, add both values (LX=60). For your convenience:
MCMXCVIII = 1998
CCCLXIX = 369
MCMXCIV = 1994. That's the year of publication of the storyline Emerald Twilight, in which Hal Jordan became Parallax, the Green Lantern Corps was dissolved, and Kyle Rayner became the Green Lantern.
"CDXLXX" has a typo. C-D = 500-100 = 400, X-L = 50-10 = 40, but the last two X don't make sense. It is possible that they were meant to be IX = 9 — if so, then the number is 449.
IX = 9
CDXLVIII = 448

MMDCCLI = 2751. The Sector 2751 was the jurisdiction of Green Lantern M'Dahna, a survivor of one of the earliest encounters with the dreaded lord of the dead Nekron, the entity that represents the Black Lantern Corps.

This is the first reference to other Lantern Corps besides Green and Yellow.; The Red Lanterns were added with the episode Fight for the Light.; The Blue Lanterns were added with the episode War of the Light Part I.; The Violet and Orange Lanterns were added with the episode War of the Light Part II.; The Indigo and Black Lanterns were added with Episode 15.
In the comics, only the Book of Oa and the Book of Parallax exist. The book connected to the Black Lanterns is the Book of the Black.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The Huntress launched a crusade to find the ones responsible for her family's death. Her search led her to the Don of the Cassamento family. These surveillance recordings may shine light on her personal quest.

Briefing: The Huntress: " Ever been to Sicily, Vic? That's where my uncle sent me after my family was murdered. They were killed by order of a hit... by the Don of the Cassamento family."

Briefing: The Huntress: " For many nights I couldn't sleep, I saw them in my dreams... Heard them scream. It consumed me, and made me vow for revenge. In Sicily, I learned how to take my vengeance."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "A brief history of a man who would take the throne of Atlantis by force."

sections.title: Part 1: Ninth Tride
items: Zone: Atlantean Research Outpost
Instance: Starro: The Threat Below
Location: In the hall where you start on the left wall on a pile of rubble

Investigation: Corum Rath: "From my first memory, the people of the Ninth Tride were as proud as they were loyal. They were hearty, unashamed, and resourceful people who were unappreciated by the other Houses. I was never ashamed of my birthright. "

sections.title: Part 2: Hadalins
items: Zone: Spindrift Station
Instance: Starro: Spindrift Station
Location: In a niche at the wall behind the first shark basin

Investigation: Corum Rath: "I remember the pride my father took in calling himself a 'hadalin', an Atlantean word for those that dwell in the midnight zone of the deep sea floor. For me, it was a term of comraderie and patriotism that set us apart. That was until I learned what the other Houses called us. "

sections.title: Part 3: Unfit King
items: Zone: Spindrift Station
Instance: Starro: Spindrift Station
Location: In a niche at the wall behind the second shark basin

Investigation: Corum Rath: "Bottom feeders. The true meaning of the word "hadalin". The dredges that feed off the fodder of those above them. The forsaken. Yet how can this be when our "king" is not even a full blooded Atlantean! How can Arthur Curry reside over the entire kingdom of Atlantis when he cares more for the trash that dwells above the waves! "

sections.title: Part 4: Call to Action
items: Zone: Spindrift Station
Instance: Starro: Spindrift Station
Location: On the left side behind the podium at the rear of the room where you fight Morgwar

Investigation: Corum Rath: "So, I have called out to the loyal, the hearty, the unashamed of the Ninth Tride. I have set a call to action, a wave in motion, and that wave has grown! It is violent and all consuming. It is the Deluge of legend and it will swallow the land, and the entire House of Atlan before I am through! And when the seas find peace again...the House of Rath will rise. "

Briefing: Princess Diana: " Reflections, Chapter 10: Steve Trevor. He was so many things to me. A reason to leave home, a guide to a new world, a thoughtful coworker, a good friend, and so much more. items: Punchline: Episode I is an Episode Briefing That can be found in the Otisburg district of Gotham. There are six parts that comprise this briefing, all of which can be found in Amusement Mile; this briefing is part of the Punchline story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Harley and Robin fight for sidekick supremacy at Amusement Mile!"

sections.title: Part 1: Punchline I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Otisburg
Location: 'Amusement Mile', next to the water's edge and Two-Face, southeast from race starting point, near the roller coaster. *

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " Welcome to Gotham Now! with Vicki Vale. Harley Quinn, the clown princess of crime, the Joker's madcat mistress of mayhem. Gotham Now! has learned that her true name is Dr. Harleen Quinzel and that she was formerly the Joker's therapist at Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane. Dr. Jeremiah Arkham, head of the asylum, declined to comment."

sections.title: Part 2: Punchline I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Otisburg
Location: 'Amusement Mile', gazebo north of the Funhouse entrance.*

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " I'm Vicki Vale and this is JLA watch on one of the dreamy teen members of the international hero group: Robin, the sidekick half of the dynamic duo. This brash young acrobat is a street-smart brawler who has put the most hardened criminals behind bars. With Batman, or on his own, Robin is a force to be reckoned with on the streets of Gotham."

sections.title: Part 3: Punchline I: Sergeant Carlin
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Otisburg
Location: 'Amusement Mile', On the East docks at the end behind the Storage Containers. East of the roller coaster and Funhouse.*

Briefing: Sergeant Carlin: " Dispatch, dispatch, this is Sergeant Carlin at the Amusement Mile theme park. The Joker's clowns are using some kind of new Joker toxin. It's - DONE something to them! They're totally deranged! We need backup! Repeat, we need backu-"

sections.title: Part 4: Punchline I: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Otisburg
Location: 'Amusement Mile', At the front of the boat in the docks, behind the wall at the point.*

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " This is Jack Ryder and you are wrong! Why? Because you think all the Joker's weapons do is go boom! But he's got new weapons friend, and they go boom alright, in your mind! If you think he'll be happy with just killing a few of us you're as deluded as he is friend, in fact, you are wrong."

sections.title: Part 5: Punchline I: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Burnley
Location: 'Amusement Mile', water tower next to the roller coaster and water. On the platform.*

Briefing: Joker: " What's more fun than a bomb? A giant bomb filled with Joker toxin of course! Especially this new stuff I've been whipping up. Use it on your friends, use it on the GCPD, use it on Batman and Robin! More than just a party favor, in fact, it's a blast."

sections.title: Part 6: Punchline I: Batman
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Otisburg

Location: On the patio level (first level up from the ground) next to the door nearest the waterfront. Building north of the entrance to Amusement Mile, last building before Amusement Mile, next to the water, west of the gazebo.*

Briefing: Batman: " This is Batman to the GCPD. My analysis of the new Joker toxin shows it has definite mutanigenic qualities. Joker has delivered a killer punchline, but this sort of tech is beyond him. He can't be developing it alone. For now get emergency medical personnel ready, you'll be needing them."
{*}Thank you Kryces for information on these locations.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Sergeant Carlin was possibly named after comic book writer Mike Carlin (1958). He first joined DC Comics as a high school intern in 1974, then was hired by Marvel Comics in 1980. Carlin returned to DC Comics in 1986 as the group editor of the Superman titles, overseeing the Death of Superman storyline. He served as an executive editor from 1996 to 2002, then became DC Entertainment's Creative Director of Animation by 2011.

items: "Batman and Joker go toe-to-toe in the Regal Hotel!"

sections.title: Part 1: Punchline II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: East End
Location:

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Gotham Now! and I'm Vicki Vale. Today the GCPD launched a Special Crimes Unit to specifically combat super-powered crime. Commissioner Jim Gordon dismissed concerns that Gotham's notoriously corrupt police force are not up to the task. His reason? The SCU will not only employ Gotham's finest, but partner with WayneTech to explore ways that Exobyte data can be used to fight crime."

sections.title: Part 2: Punchline II: Uncle Jingles
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: East End
Location:

Briefing: Uncle Jingles: " A poem, in honor of the new Special Crimes Unit! *clears throat; begins to recite* There once was a crook made of clay / Who was caught by the cops just today! / He hits like a train! / He loves causing pain! / So - when we set him loose - better pray! *laughs maniacally*"

sections.title: Part 3: Punchline II: Commissioner Gordon
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: East End
Location:

Briefing: Commissioner Gordon: " This is Commissioner Gordon to all forces. The Joker's not going to take the formation of this Special Crimes Unit with a smile. But if he gets you with his toxin, you'll be laughing all the way to the grave. I want all attendees at the Regal Hotel fully armed and forces on standby alert for Harley Quinn, the Joker's clowns, or any other craziness. Gordon out."

sections.title: Part 4: Punchline II: Lucius Fox

Our readings indicate these Exobyte canisters contain concentrated information from Gotham's criminals. Please - handle these canisters with caution! Any escaping Exobytes will immediately seek to download their information onto their nearest target. "

items: Zone: Gotham

items: "Batman and Joker race to unlock the riddlesome mysteries of the Riddler!"

sections.title: Part 1: Punchline III: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Burnley
Location:

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale for Gotham Now! The Riddler, aka Edward Nigma, is best known for leaving riddle clues that dare the authorities to find him. Although Nygma claims to have renounced crime to work as a private eye, Gotham Now! has evidence that he and the Joker are working together at Ace Chemicals. Is this the return of the clue-obsessed mastermind? We'll keep you posted here at Gotham Now!"

sections.title: Part 2: Punchline III: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Otisburg
Location:

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " Vicki Vale with Gotham Now! and the latest information on the world's deadliest assassin, Deathstroke! With a reputation even more terrifying than his martial skills, Deathstroke is famed for always completing any contracted hit. Now reports place him in Gotham. Who is his latest target? And who could possibly afford his fee? Stay tuned to Gotham Now!"

sections.title: Part 3: Punchline III: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Burnley
Location:

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " This is Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because you think the Joker isn't a man with a plan! Sure he's a crazy pathological mass murderer. Sure he's a menace to every normal rational order-lovin' human being. That doesn't mean he doesn't have friends - friends with the technology to turn us all into crazed freaks! Think Batman and the new heroes can keep us safe? Hate to say it, friend, but YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Punchline III: Lucius Fox
items: Zone: Gotham
Region: Otisburg
Location: Out back behind the Pawn Shop.

Briefing: Lucius Fox: " This is Lucius Fox at WayneTech on our secure connection to the Special Crimes Unit. We received an urgent call asking us to analyze the Joker's new J1N1 robots. A remote scan shows they're linked to power cores located in nearby vans. Whoever designed the Joker's robots apparently couldn't fit in both insanity *and* a large enough battery. Take out the robots and the cores should short out."

Region: Burnley

Briefing: Batman: " This is Batman to Commissioner Gordon. The Joker's adding some suspicious new weapons to his arsenal. His new toxin is...far too chemically complex for some one as...unfocused as The Joker. Have your men armed with an antidote if you can. Batman out."

sections.title: Part 6: Punchline III: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham

Briefing: "BRAINIAC: Source data package digitized. Data now expendable. / BATMAN: *slowed down, sped up, obviously Brainiac — ized* Without discipline, all is chaos. Criminals are cowardly, superstitious, weak. I will disguise my terror, and strike it into their hearts instead. I will never kill. I will never take away the possibility of a better future. Just look at the pathetic notions of order and sanity… at the random pointlessness of human existence… at a world utterly off the hook! So why join 'em when you can beat 'em? Going crazy is the only sane response. Madness is just a single step over the edge… then gravity takes over… and then when you laugh, the world laughs with you! *laughs*"

title: Rise of the House of Rath (Investigations)
summary: Rise of the House of Rath is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across Atlantis: Royal Palace, Atlantis open world, Atlantis: The Silent School, Atlantis: Crown of Thorns and Atlantis: The Throne. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Rise of the House of Rath is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across Atlantis: Royal Palace, Atlantis open world, Atlantis: The Silent School, Atlantis: Crown of Thorns and Atlantis: The Throne. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: A personal diary of the insurgent, anarchist and sovereign King of Atlantis, Corum Rath. Some might say it is a diary of a madman.

sections.title: Part 1: An End to the Deluge
items: Zone: Atlantean Royal Palace
Instance: Atlantis: Royal Palace
Location: South of where you enter the instance, next to the south end of the pillar.

Investigation: Corum Rath: " At last, my Deluge have succeeded in winning over the simple-minded "Hadalin" of the Ninth Tride. The attack on Spindrift Station has sown the seeds of dissension among the Royal Council and Arthur's surface dwelling allies alike. Soon the Atlantean people will see me as a patriot and Arthur as the blood traitor he is.'"

images.label: Rise of the House of Rath - An End to the Deluge

sections.title: Part 2: King-Slayer
items: Zone: Atlantean Royal Palace
Instance: Atlantis: Royal Palace
Location: In the room of the final fight, in the window just east of where Mera and Ocean Master are holding back the Crown of Thorns.

Investigation: Corum Rath: " It is done! Arthur, the false king is dead! The Silent School and the Elders have backed my claim to the throne and appointed me King of Atlantis. My first act as King was to unleash the ancient artifact known as the Crown of Thorns to isolate Atlantis from the outside world and begin a new era for our culture. Today begins my ascension into the pages of history.'"

images.label: Rise of the House of Rath - King-Slayer

sections.title: Part 3: The Undercurrent
items: Zone: Atlantis

Location: Eastern half of the map, near the Drift Camp (one of the areas for the Loss of Leadership mission), the one by the Atlantis Statue - Tribute. The node is located among the buildings south from the statue, floating near the ground.

Investigation: Corum Rath: " The last of the House of Atlan have teamed with Arthur's surface-dwelling companions and the taint-blooded King Shark to oppose my reign. How pitiful this "Undercurrent" must feel. They possess no magic that can breach the Crown and their former king is dead by my order. My Deluge forces are now official Captains of the Drift and hunt Orm and Mera like the traitors they are. Nothing can stop me and no one will stand in my way.'"

images.label: Rise of the House of Rath - The Undercurrent

sections.title: Part 4: Forbidden Magics
items: Zone: Silent School
Instance: Atlantis: The Silent School
Location: In the last of the center rooms - the one with the artifacts -, to the side at a table with books.

Investigation: Corum Rath: " I have found it! I now possess the power I need to assure my reign for all time. The forbidden power of the Abyssal Dark has shown me the way. Our nation was built on ancient magics, yet no king has had the courage to wield it. The Crown of Thorns is only the beginning! My Silent School acolytes comb the crypts to bring me the forbidden magic I desire. With it, I will become the most powerful king Atlantis has ever known!'"

images.label: Rise of the House of Rath - Forbidden Magics

sections.title: Part 5: The King's Law
items: Zone: Crown of Thorns
Instance: Atlantis: Crown of Thorns
Location: In the hall with King Shark in an compartment on the far left side.

Investigation: Corum Rath: " Why did I not see the truth sooner? Why did I allow the fools of the court to restrain my desire for greatness? Who are they to tell King Corum Rath what I may or may not do? They are petulant children watching the birth of a god! And so some flee to join the Undercurrent, while others whisper that the news of Arthur's demise may be false. Be it Arthur's ghost or the high council, they are all subject to the King's Law!'"

images.label: Rise of the House of Rath - The King's Law

sections.title: Part 6: Into the Abyss
items: Zone: Atlantis Risen
Instance: Atlantis: The Throne
Location: Just in front of the stairs in a niche on the right side.

Investigation: Corum Rath: " I was foolish to trust the Silent School and the Elders. None of them had the vision the Dark magic grants me! Their short-sighted ignorance insults me. They are unworthy to serve me, so I have bestowed a "merciful" death upon them. All that remains to be done is to use the combined powers of the Zodiac stones and the Abyssal Dark to eradicate my enemies, starting with the " Aquaman"."

images.label: Rise of the House of Rath - Into the Abyss

Dissertation Notes: Falcon-headed god of the West, Qebehsenuef, ensures the safety of the dead on their journey back from beyond.
Dissertation Notes: The god of the sky, Horus has the authority to return a soul from beyond death.
Dissertation Notes: The consent of Anubis is required for any travel from beyond the afterlife.
Dissertation Notes: The Jackal-headed god of the East, Duamutef escorts the dead to heaven.
Dissertation Notes: The goddess of motherhood and magic, and the protector of the dead, the breath of Isis pushes the penitent past the veil.

Villains:

rows: " I didn't always have the best luck with families, and sometimes the one I have now can get a little annoying, but I know they always have my back. Just like I know you always got my back. That's why I say you're part of the family, if you want to join us. Keep this to remember us by!"
