items: Signs of the Beast is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Tomorrow District of Metropolis, near quest objectives for the story arc Hearts of Darkness. There are six parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Circe's magical creation were once mortal men. Recover Beastimorph artifacts to aid in their recovery, or earn Circe's good will by keeping them from prying mages.

sections.title: Part 1: Carved Minotaur Horns
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the sidewalk in front of a destroyed Big Belly Burger kiosk.
Investigation: Preserver's Journal: " The carving of this horn is likely self-inflicted."

sections.title: Part 2: Engraved Boar Tusks
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the corner a building three blocks north of STAR Labs and southwest of Big Belly Corporate HQ, patio level. Southeast of Lieutenant Lethantos.
Investigation: Preserver's Journal: " It is not uncommon for them to engrave symbols of their conquest onto tusks and fangs."

sections.title: Part 3: Imbued Lion Fang
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: New Troy Central Station, east of Metro Station Building, by the fountain.
Investigation: Preserver's Journal: " This fang could aid the Sentinel of Magic's restorative incantations."

sections.title: Part 4: Hewn Wolf's Claw
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Instance: Metro Station Building (Walk-In)
Location: In the room where you face General Tethytus, by the stairs to the south.
Investigation: Preserver's Journal: " This claw did not come from a quadrupedal wolf."

sections.title: Part 5: Inscribed Rhino Horn
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Instance: Metro Station Building (Walk-In)
Location: In the hallway after A. Station and the trainwreckage.
Investigation: Preserver's Journal: " Hopefully, each recovered artifact will aid in reversing Circe's hex."

sections.title: Part 6: Etched Snake's Scale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Instance: Metro Station Building (Walk-In)
Location: In the boss room, next to a column to the south.
Investigation: Preserver's Journal: " The incantation on this scale is dark magic indeed."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Zatanna or Circe, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Wonder Woman asked me to pass on her thanks. These Bestiamorph relics you gathered will be a big help trying to figure out Circe's hex. She put quite a whammy on those guys. Hopefully we'll get them out of the animal suits soon."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Everyone of them deserved it. Those pigs. Or rhinos, or wolves. Hah! Your goddess acknowledges your aid. I am so pleased these Beastiamorph objects you gathered are out of the hands of Wonder Woman's magical allies. My thanks."

title: Sins of the Father: Episode I (Briefings)
summary: Sins of the Father: Episode I is an episode briefing that can be found in the Chinatown district of Metropolis. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Sins of the Father: Episode I is an episode briefing that can be found in the Chinatown district of Metropolis. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The Sentinels of Magic battle Brother Blood in Chinatown!"

sections.title: Part 1: Sins I: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Location: Rooftop across from (south of) Parking lot. South of Mannheim's Theater.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. The Department of Metahuman Affairs today announced that the " Sentinels of Magic" will be combating villainous magic here in Gotham and beyond. The Sentinels are led by master sorcerer Doctor Fate and the Justice League's star magician, Zatanna. Look for their magical wards and spells throughout the city."

sections.title: Part 2: Sins I: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Location: Rooftop/patio (with benches) southeast of Theater's southeast corner. It is under the red tiled awning.

Briefing: Vicki Vale" Vicki Vale and "JLA Watch"! Today, the enigmatic Doctor Fate. A long-time member of the Justice Society, Doctor Fate is actually a lord of order tasked with maintaining the balance of good and evil on our plane. Who's behind the mask? That's still a mystery. What is clear is that Doctor Fate's Sentinels of Magic are cutting through chaos wherever they appear."

sections.title: Part 3: Sins I: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Location: Two buildings north from villains night club, green building east of Big Belly Burger.

Briefing: Jack Ryder" I am Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because hell on earth is coming, friend! You think the Cult of Blood is a harmless little club? Ha! They worship the demon Trigon, an interdimensional baddie who spawns sin like garbage breeds flies. Demons are already rampaging in Metropolis! Trigon is coming! You don't believe it? YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Sins I: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Location: South Side area of Theater's Rooftop.

Briefing: Jack Ryder" I am Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because the goddess Circe is on the scene - the queen of mean, the mistress of malevolent magic, the dishy grande dame of deceit! This is the lady who battles even Wonder Woman for the power of the gods! Think she won't lie, cheat, and steal to gain every mite of magic for herself? YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 5: Sins I: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Location: Rooftop South of Chinatown P.D. and West of Mannheim's Theater

Briefing: Circe" Doctor Fate, the goddess Circe speaks! You fear Trigon's power? Perhaps you think him too strong! Coward. You and your sad little Sentinels don't stand a chance. The balance is tipping, Fate - watch your step."

sections.title: Part 6: Sins I: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Chinatown
Location: On the Ground, next to the water at Shen Li Po Gardens. SouthWest of Theater, opposite side of Booster Gold Kiosk. Big Belly Burger, between two generators.

Briefing: Wonder Woman" This is Wonder Woman, and I speak to you as one who knows Circe's lies. She will claim your magic gives you the right to rule. Reject her evil, and bring the fight instead - to Brainiac!"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Lois Lane, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Daily Planet News Brief: MPD officers continue to comb the Chinatown district for any of Brother Blood’s followers tonight, after a violent altercation between Blood's cultists and the Sentinels of Magic. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards players with the Mana-Twisted Back back item (style: Plant).

title: Sins of the Father: Episode II (Briefings)
summary: Sins of the Father: Episode II is an episode briefing that can be found in the northern part of the Tomorrow District in Metropolis. It is part of the Sins of the Father story arc and the Sins of the Father briefings. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Sins of the Father: Episode II is an episode briefing that can be found in the northern part of the Tomorrow District in Metropolis. It is part of the Sins of the Father story arc and the Sins of the Father briefings. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Raven and the MPD battles Trigon's demonic hordes in the Tomorrow District!"

sections.title: Part 1: Sins II: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the rooftop garden of a skyscraper at Avenue of Tomorrow, one block northeast and one block east of the 8th Precinct Metropolis Science Police HQ.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live. The Amazon warrior for peace, Wonder Woman, is leading the new generation of heroic-magic users against the goddess Circe's forces. On Wonder Woman's side, Zatanna and the Sentinels of Magic. On Circe's, dark cults ruled by Felix Faust and Brother Blood. Will Wonder Woman's warriors for freedom defeat Circe's new magical order? More soon on Daily Planet Live."

images.label: Sins of the Father II - Lois Lane

sections.title: Part 2: Sins II: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: Avenue of Tomorrow, on the skyscraper east of 8th Precinct Metropolis Science Police HQ, facing the Rail Whale tracks.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch on one of our most popular teams: the Titans! Originally formed by sidekicks, now the Titans are all grown up and battling evil on their own. From technology whiz Cyborg, to alien princess Starfire, to mystic spellcaster Raven - not to mention Nightwing and Beast Boy - the Titans often go where even the JLA fears to tread."

images.label: Sins of the Father II - Vicki Vale

sections.title: Part 3: Sins II: Maggie Sawyer
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: On the building southeast of the 8th Precinct Metropolis Science Police HQ.

Briefing: Maggie Sawyer:" This is Captain Sawyer to all MPD Science Police Units. We've got a 10-19! I repeat, 10-19. This is the real thing, an invasion from a demonic realm! This is why Metropolis formed the Science Police in the first place, people - to take out threats the regular cops can't handle! So show'em what the Science Police can do. Sawyer out."

images.label: Sins of the Father II - Maggie Sawyer

sections.title: Part 4: Sins II: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: At 8th Precinct Metropolis Science Police HQ, in the corner of the prison yard.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I am Jack Ryder and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because you think evil only lives on one dimension. Hello people, Brainiac? But he's not the only threat! Somewhere beyond your imagination lives the demon Trigon, and he's got four eyes and pointed teeth and crazy horns and he's coming here to turn the Earth plane into hell. And he's gonna use his daughter Raven to do it! Think I'm crazy? YOU ARE WRONG!"

images.label: Sins of the Father II - Jack Ryder

sections.title: Part 5: Sins II: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: Avenue of Tomorrow, on the helipad of a skyscraper 2 blocks east of the 8th Precinct Metropolis Science Police HQ.
Briefing: Circe:" Circe speaks! The witch Raven must be punished! The brat refuses to release Trigon's great power into our plane. Does she deserve our mercy? I think you know my answer."

images.label: Sins of the Father II - Circe

sections.title: Part 6: Sins II: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Tomorrow District
Location: Two blocks south of Simon Municipal Bridge, on a ledge of the building facing the entrance to Chinatown.

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" This is Wonder Woman. I leave this Orb of Athena as a token of compassion for the enchantress Raven. Even now, she sacrifices herself to stop the evil of her father, Trigon. That is bravery - and the mark of a true hero."

images.label: Sins of the Father II - Wonder Woman

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Lois Lane, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Daily Planet News Brief: Captain Maggie Sawyer spoke to the MPD tonight, giving a decidedly mixed report in the aftermath of a demonic invasion of the Tomorrow District. The missing and corrupted are still being accounted for. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

title: Sins of the Father: Episode III (Briefings)
summary: Sins of the Father: Episode III is an episode briefing that can be found in the northern part of the Midtown district in Metropolis. It is part of the Sins of the Father story arc and the Sins of the Father briefings. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Sins of the Father: Episode III is an episode briefing that can be found in the northern part of the Midtown district in Metropolis. It is part of the Sins of the Father story arc and the Sins of the Father briefings. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Trigon and the Titans go toe-to-toe in Midtown Metropolis!"

sections.title: Part 1: Sins III: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: Southwest of Ellsworth Memorial Hospital, on a rooftop behind Mario's Meats billboard.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live. Brother Blood called today for all Metropolis citizens to, quote, "fall on their knees and worship Trigon." Trigon, a vicious interdimensional demon, has attempted to invade our Earth plane before. Now the Cult of Blood believes that a Trigonic hell on Earth will rise at last. The Sentinels of Magic have mobilized to combat the threat."

sections.title: Part 2: Sins III: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: Southwest of Superman Memorial Statue at Centennial Park, ground level between two small apartment buildings.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I am Jack Ryder and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because greed, envy, wrath and all the rest of the seven deadliest are out walking the streets, people! Think that's an ordinary day in Metropolis? Just wait until Brother Blood raises Trigon the red-faced rein-of-hell himself! Think you'll escape your sins then? Well my friend, YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 3: Sins III: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: On Ellsworth Memorial Hospital, below the hospital sign facing the Science Spire at northwest. Next to the Metropolis Midtown Adept Aerial Movement Challenge.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" I'm Vicki Vale with a JLA Watch on the Justice League's magical heroes, the Sentinels of Magic! Led by the enigmatic Lord of Order called Doctor Fate and the stunning spellmistress, Zatanna, their ranks include the powerful empath, Raven, daughter of the demon lord Trigon. Together, the Sentinels fight magical foes on this Earthly plane - and beyond!"

sections.title: Part 4: Sins III: Booster Gold
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown

Location: Patio level of the building with a Sun Doller Coffee sign north of Ellsworth Memorial Hospital. Look for the pedestrian bridge; it's on the south-side patio, right up against the building under an overhang.

Briefing: Booster Gold:" Hey kids! This is Booster Gold. We all have inner demons that want us to be greedy, lazy and selfish. I know - "Not YOU, Booster!" Yes, even me. But I resist those impulses, mostly, and you can too! Booster says, stay Gold! Don't let your inner demons get you down!"
Announcer: This message brought to you by the Martha Wayne Foundation.

sections.title: Part 5: Sins III: Circe
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown

Location: Patiolevel (one up from ground) of the Gallery building across the street to the Centennial Park entrance sign (on the map, this entrance is marked with a white dot named "Centennial Park").

Briefing: Circe:" Citizens of Metropolis, hear your goddess! The demon Trigon is rising, to flood this dimension with unknown power! Do not resist! Give in! Only those part of Earth's transformation will survive to see the rise of the true order of magic over mortal!"

images.label: Sins of the father ep3 p5

sections.title: Part 6: Sins III: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Midtown
Location: Two blocks north of the Cain Street Mall complex, on the top of a tall, layered building.

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" This is Wonder Woman! All who hear me, fight! Brother Blood seeks to enslave you with the weakness in our souls. Stand fast! Do not let him reduce us to our demons. Show Blood and Circe we will face them - and prevail!"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Vicki Vale, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " JLA Watch News Brief: Raven and the Titans withdrew with considerable less fanfaire than normally marks their departures after a stunning attack on Midtown's Ellsworth General Hospital earlier today. Sources close to the group indicate though they succeeded today, it came at a heavy cost. I'm Vicki Vale."

This briefing rewards the female player character with the Trigonic Trooper's Belt waist style item (style: Tech Sniper).

title: Sins of the Father: Episode IV (Briefings)
summary: Sins of the Father: Episode IV is an episode briefing that can be found in and around Robinson Park in Gotham City. It is part of the Sins of the Father story arc and the Sins of the Father briefings. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Sins of the Father: Episode IV is an episode briefing that can be found in and around Robinson Park in Gotham City. It is part of the Sins of the Father story arc and the Sins of the Father briefings. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Brother Blood attempts a final bid to raise Trigon in the depths of Gotham!

sections.title: Part 1: Sins IV: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Location: On the top of Club 539, between the water tank and antennae facing Robinson Park.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale and JLA Watch! on the superhero team the Titans. More than a group, their bond is like family. The technical powers of Cyborg and the street smarts of Nightwing form a perfect complement to Raven's magic, Starfire's alien skills, Beast Boy's shapeshifting prowess. Need to know more? Their rallying cry says it all - "Titans Together!""

images.label: Sins of the Father IV - Vicki Vale (1)

sections.title: Part 2: Sins IV: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Diamond District
Location: Rooftop level of the tall building south of the Diamond District Police Station, facing Robinson Park.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale with Gotham Now! Gotham's reputation of sitting on cursed ground was certainly in evidence today, as demons spreading greed, gluttony, envy, wrath, and other deadly sins launched attacks across the city. The Cult of Blood has claimed responsibility for the attack, demanding Gotham's immediate obedience and worship. Stay tuned to Gotham Now!"

images.label: Sins of the Father IV - Vicki Vale (2)

sections.title: Part 3: Sins IV: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Robinson Park
Location: At the Pillars of Hades, on top of the largest pillar.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" This is Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because you think raising the demon Trigon here on Earth is easy?! Think you place an interdimensional call and he hops in his demon car and zooms right over? Sorry, friend, he requires massive energy - not just of sins, but of PURITY CORRUPTED. And if you think he won't drain every hero in Gotham to get it, well, friend, YOU ARE WRONG!"

images.label: Sins of the Father IV - Jack Ryder

sections.title: Part 4: Sins IV: Commissioner Gordon
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Diamond District
Location: Ground level of the tall building south of the Diamond District Police Station, inside a planter behind a pillar facing Robinson Park.

Briefing: Commissioner Gordon:" Commissioner Gordon to all Special Crimes Units. Keep an eye out for Cult of Blood members in Gotham, especially their leader, Brother Blood. They worship the Demon Trigon, who brings out humanity's deadly sins. This is not a sanctioned religious organization by any means, so if you see them, shut them down! Gordon out.

images.label: Sins of the Father IV - Commissioner Gordon

sections.title: Part 5: Sins IV: Circe
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Robinson Park
Location: At the Reservoir-side Gazebo, next to the bottled Robinson Park Reservoir.

Briefing: Circe:" Circe speaks...*seductively* to you alone, for you, of all my allies, are my favorite. Brother Blood thinks to claim my place... but we know better, hm...? Bring Trigon's dark energies to this plane to exploit... for I am saving a special place for you, by my side, when we add his power to my own."

images.label: Sins of the Father IV - Circe

sections.title: Part 6: Sins IV: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Robinson Park
Location: At the Pillars of Hades, under the concrete rubble on petrified lava - south of the point where the dirt invades the street.

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" I am Wonder Woman. If you have claimed this orb, I know you are not yet Circe's slave. Nor Trigon's - though this is what they plan. My lasso reveals the truth, and know this - when Circe promises you power, she lies."

images.label: Sins of the Father IV - Wonder Woman

sections.title: Part 7: Sins IV: Joker
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Robinson Park
Location: Beneath the archway west of A Shadow of Hell.
Briefing: Joker:" BOO! *laughs* Scared yet? You should be - because dead men tell no tales, but live men can always spill their guts! *laughs maniacally*"

title: Smallville (Briefings)
summary: Smallville is a global briefing comprised in 6 parts.

sections.title: Overview
items: Smallville is a global briefing comprised in 6 parts.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Lex Luthor is using Doomsday's DNA to conduct experiments on Smallville's citizens!

sections.title: Part 1: Smallville: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Smallville
Region: Midtown Smallville
Location: West of the Midtown Smallville area, on the top of a ruined building Northwest from the first LexCorp's Remote Analysis Unit.

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" This is Amanda Waller with a top security alert. Lex Luthor has targeted the Kansas town of Smallville for an illegal genetics experiment using Doomsday's DNA. Yes, your heard correctly. Suicide Squad, suit up! If the Justice League or Society can handle this, you're going in. Waller out."

sections.title: Part 2: Smallville: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Smallville
Region: Rural area
Location: In the middle of the lake South from The Kent Farm.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live, with new information on the Doomsday threat in Smallville. Our sources confirm that a clandestine LexCorp research arm is using Smallville to test unproven Exobyte-derived DNA technology. Although Exobyte research is still in its infancy, LexCorp continues to push the limits, often illegally, in its quest to extract information from future Brainiac's weapons."

sections.title: Part 3: Smallville: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Smallville
Region: Downtown Smallville
Location: On the ruins of the building in same block of the station where you fight Lady Doombringer. The node is at a window.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live. Residents of Metropolis may recall the horror of Doomsday's arrival on Earth to murder Earth's greatest hero, Superman. Now reports indicate that version of Doomsday have been unleashed in the quiet town of Smallville, Kansas. LexCorp involvement is suspected, but not confirmed, at this time."

sections.title: Part 4: Smallville: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Smallville
Region: Smallville High School
Location: Next to the Smallville High School sign.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I'm Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because Lex Luthor is obsessed with metahuman genes, people, and your DNA is his playground! Think you're safe out there in your farms, your small towns, your country retreats? Think Lex just performs his experiments in labs somewhere far away? Hate to tell you, friend, but YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 5: Smallville: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Smallville
Region: Rural area
Location: At the house North from The Kent Farm, under the satellite dish.

Briefing: Lex Luthor:" Luthor to LexCorp's Doomsday Research Dissemination team. Congratulations, you have successfully laid the groundwork for our experiments. Unfortunately, for you, you are now expendable - please, refer to subsection to 27 subparagraph b of your contract. If you have any questions, by all means contact HR when the experiment is over. Luthor out."

sections.title: Part 6: Smallville: Superman
items: Zone: Smallville
Region: Midtown Smallville
Location: East of the Midtown Smallville area, on the roof of the building behind the Newsstand.

Briefing: Superman:" Citizens of Smallville, this is Superman. Your town has been attacked by an Exobyte virus and the entire area has been quarantine. Please do not panic. Help is on the way. We are working to reverse the effects of the virus and restore order to your town. Please know I am personally looking into what caused this event. And rest assured, I will see to it this never..happens...again."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Amanda Waller, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Coded Transmission Follows: Science is always a dangerous game. I would never have authorized Luthor's experiment if I'd known about it in advance. Now that the 'cat' is out of the bag, though, we've got to clean up the town. Nice work in there. Waller out."

title: Spectrum Analysis (Briefings)
summary: Spectrum Analysis is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Alerts introduced in the episode Fight for the Light. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Spectrum Analysis is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Alerts introduced in the episode Fight for the Light. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The emotional spectrum is out of balance and the various Lantern Corps must act quickly to restore equilibrium."

sections.title: Part 1: For the Light: Lois Lane
items: Zone: STAR Labs Research Facility
Region: STAR Labs Lobby
Instance: S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility (Alert)
Location: At the highest level, above the huge sphere of light.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane with breaking news on Metropolis' own STAR Labs, where research on emotions was hijacked by Brainiac to create rifts into the emotional spectrum itself. Both the Green Lantern Corps and the Sinestro Corps have called a cease-fire while they attempt to get the Brainiac technology under control."

sections.title: Part 2: For the Light: Sarah Charles
items: Zone: STAR Labs Research Facility
Region: Level 3 Reactor Corridor
Instance: S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility (Alert)
Location: Take the West path, then follow the corridor until you reach the penultimate console. The node is behind it.

Briefing: Sarah Charles: " Professor Scott? It's Doctor Charles from STAR Labs. We've looked at your theoretical schematics for the enhanced weapon procedures and well, let me just say, we're impressed. I'm certain we can provide a more ethical environment for weapons testing than Cadmus or LexCorp. Additionally we can provide much more focused research than Ferris on the micro pulse arrays. We look forward to working with you."

sections.title: Part 3: For the Light: Kilowog
items: Zone: STAR Labs Research Facility
Region: Extraterrestrial Biosphere
Instance: S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility (Alert)
Location: The the West path until you reach the Biosphere where you fight the Scion of Fear. It's across the room on the outside, next to the window at Southeast.

Briefing: Kilowog: " STAR Labs? This is Kilowog. Our rings are pickin' up some big-time shifts in the emotional spectrum. Could be related to whatever's messin' up our rings. I'm not sure what kinda crazy brew you've got goin on in those test tubes, but we're on our way. Some of the new deputies have been dispatched in the sector, so if ya see any of the rookies they're authorized to lend a hand. Kilowog out."

sections.title: Part 4: For the Light: Sinestro
items: Zone: STAR Labs Research Facility
Instance: S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility (Alert)

Location: Take the East path until you reach the room between the Particle Collider Room and the Ocean Observation Hall. The node is behind the semi-opened door partially blocked by a fallen structure on the stairs.

Briefing: Sinestro:" Attention, Earth! This is Sinestro. My Corps and I are descending on Metropolis. Do NOT interfere with our plans. While your fear of Brainiac is invigorating, we cannot allow his tampering with the Emotional Spectrum. I warn you again, disturb us and you will face the greatest fear in the universe."

sections.title: Part 5: For the Light: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Coast City • STAR Labs Research Facility
Region: Park • Ocean Observation Hall
Instance: Coast City (Alert) • S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility (Alert)

Location: Coast City:: In the initial area, southeast from the Green Lantern Corps monument. S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility: Follow East path. The node is in the room after the point where you find Hal Jordan, above a closed door.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale and JLA Watch! With a special edition on the emotional spectrum! You've heard of the Green Lanterns and the Sinestro Corps, but did you know there's an intergalactic Corps for every color in the rainbow? Each color is associated with an emotion, from the Rage-filled Red Lanterns to the Violet Star Sapphires who champion Love. These cosmic warriors use their power rings to become masters of a given wavelength of the emotional spectrum, but only the Green Lanterns of Earth currently serve with the Justice League."

sections.title: Part 6: For the Light: Hal Jordan
items: Zone: Coast City • STAR Labs Research Facility
Region: Converted S.T.A.R. Labs facility • East Wing
Instance: Coast City (Alert) • S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility (Alert)

Location: Coast City:: Turn right as soon as you enter the facility, the node is right in the corner. S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility: Follow the East path and stop before entering the room where you fight the Scion of Will. There's a tunnel right above the entrance. Enter this tunnel using the ladder to the West. The node is at the end of the tunnel.

Briefing: HAL: " Captain Hal Jordan to Ferris Tower. She's flying a little rough- having a hard time keeping her nose up- nothing I can't handle though." TOWER: " Jordan - we're getting some alarming readings down here as well, you should bring her in." HAL: " Sounds good, I'll bring her around- *loud noise and an alarm*" TOWER: " Jordan! Hal! Pop the hatch, get out of there!" HAL: " No no, I got it. *struggling grunt*" TOWER: " Hal, eject!" HAL: " *alarm and noises stop* Hahaha. There we go...settled her down and bringing her in." TOWER: " Jordan...you're unbelievable, *SIGH* *exasperated*"

sections.title: Part 7: For the Light: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Coast City
Region: Ferris Aircraft
Instance: Coast City (Alert)
Location: At the obstructed road leading to Ferris Aircraft, next to the debris.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with a breaking story from Coast City. The "City Without Fear" has experienced a number of devastating tragedies in recent history, but the resilient citizens refuse to give in. Even amid reports of nearby Sinestro Corps and alien activity they will not abandon their city. When father of two was asked why his family would not leave he responded with "The Jordans don't run. We believe in the new heroes, and we believe in Green Lantern." We'll have more as the situation develops. Lois Lane, Daily Planet Live."

sections.title: Part 8: For the Light: Martin Jordan
items: Zone: Coast City
Region: Ferris Aircraft
Instance: Coast City (Alert)
Location: In the first room, at the northwestern corner.

Briefing: Martin Jordan:" Captain Martin Jordan to Ferris Tower. Left turbine tightened up on that last pass. I know we want to push her pretty hard, but the investors won't be impressed if I blow both her engines. *pauses, listening* Copy that. I'll keep her in the sky *Sudden alarms, plane in distress sounds*."

sections.title: Part 9: For the Light: Lyssa Drak
items: Zone: Oa
Region: Oan Sciencells
Instance: Oan Sciencells (Alert)
Location: Behind the East Sciencell.

Briefing: GL CORP MALE:" Sciencell inquest record. Prisoner Lyssa Drak." LYSSA DRAK: " Interrogators? What a wonderful opportunity for me to share a foreboding tale. Sector 0000. This is a story of imminent terror. An uprising so great that its very recount will inspire boundless fear in ALL who hear it. It will happen soon...and when I recover the Book of Parallax I will burn it into its pages with your palpable FEAR! Hahaha!"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Lois Lane, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Daily Planet New Brief: STAR Labs scientists continue to monitor the situations in Metropolis and Coast City tonight after the resolution of an interdimensional incident. Details are sketchy, but the involvement of Green Lanterns and the Sinestro Corps seems to be at the heart of the story. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with the Gardner-style Vest chest item (style: Gardner-style).

sections.title: Trivia
items: The "father of two" mentioned by Lois Lane in Part 7 is probably Jim Jordan, Hal's younger brother. He married the reporter Sue Williams, and their two children are Howard and Jane Jordan.
Martin Jordan was Hal's father, a military test pilot who lost his life in the accident registered in Part 8.

Survival of the Fittest: Episode 1 is a Episode Briefing That can be found in the Little Bohemia district of Metropolis. There are six parts that comprise this briefing, all of which can be found south and east of the Little Bohemia Police Department; this briefing is part of the Survival of the Fittest Story Arc.

references.label: Survival of the Fittest Story Arc

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Grodd and Flash face off on the Little Bohemia Boardwalk!"

Gorilla Grodd's army of intelligent apes has launched an invasion of Metropolis' Little Bohemia district. They are utilizing advanced devolution and mind-control technologies in order to turn citizens into gorillas, powerless to resist Grodd's mental commands. While S.T.A.R. Labs scrambles to find the means of overcoming these transformations, the Flash has discovered and infiltrated Grodd's hidden base, though contact with the speedster has since been lost.

sections.title: Part 1: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Street level, at the base of the ruined Queensland Boardwalk Ferris Wheel

Briefing: Lois Lane: " Lois Lane and Daily Planet Live: Breaking News. The Metropolis waterfront is under attack by the hyper-intelligent ape, Gorilla Grodd, and his army. Experts say Grodd's devolution technology can control unsuspecting minds, turning humans into primitive slaves. Grodd's long-time nemesis, the Flash, is on the scene with the Metropolis Police Department. More as it comes."

sections.title: Part 2: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia

Location: Roof level, two blocks from the Little Bohemia Police Station, two blocks east of Lieutenant Harlin. Look for a low rise building with trees and sky lights on the roof, surrounded by two tall buildings with Stacy's posters.

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane and Daily Planet Live, with an update on Earth's greatest defender, Superman. Called the Man of Steel, Superman came to Earth after his own planet, Krypton, was destroyed. He uses his amazing powers to champion truth and justice, and now, to mentor our new heroes alongside Batman and Wonder Woman."

sections.title: Part 3: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Street level, in a plaza one block east of Lieutenant Harlin

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vickie Vale with a special JLA Watch on The Flash, the Fastest Man Alive. He's usually found speeding through Keystone and Central City, but with the rise of the new heroes and villains he's breaking the sound barrier in Gotham, Metropolis, and anywhere else his super speed can take him. Wherever there's trouble, he'll be there in a flash."

sections.title: Part 4: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia
Location: Roof level, three blocks east and one block south of Lieutenant Harlin or four blocks south of Little Bohemia Police Station.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I'm Jack Ryder, and you are wrong. Why? Because deep inside you lives a primal, savage beast, and Gorilla Grodd is going to set it free. He has mind control. He has an entire army of intelligent apes. He's going to use his advanced devolution technology to turn us into them. If you think you can break the laws of the jungle, you are sadly deluded, friend. In fact, you are wrong."

sections.title: Part 5: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia

Location: Street level, two blocks south and two blocks west of Lieutenant Harlin. Travel west from Harlin along the water, the token is in the area of a white and golden building with grassy surroundings (underneath one of Grodd's floating platforms).

Briefing: Lex Luthor: " Grodd, this is Luthor. Don't expect the Society to get involved in your little schemes, unless you can show any possible benefit to us. I own Metropolis! So, make all the apes you like; just remember who's boss."

sections.title: Part 6: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Little Bohemia

Location: Roof level, five blocks south from Little Bohemia Police Station, one block south from Prince Ulgo's location. Look for high rise next to the beach and Grodd's platforms, with view to a Soder Cola building, Gorilla Grodd's Lab, and the Metropolis Fire Department Engine Co 128.

Briefing: Superman: " Superman to the Metropolis Police Department. The Flash is tracking down Grodd, backed by our new heroes. All citizens are at risk from Grodd's devolution and mind-control technology, so clear the area if you can."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Stories of Heroic Adventure in a bygone age."

sections.title: Part 1: Cry of the Brawling Banshee!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Lake
Location: Behind the twisted the trees by The Reckoning's Hideout.

Briefing: The Laughing Hound: " The trap was a success! At long last, the Brawling Banshee has been brought to justice! [*short burst of laughter*] That being said, I believe my hearing shan't recover for at least a fortnight. What a dreadfully loud wail that woman has!"

images.label: Tales of the Laughing Hound - Cry of the Brawling Banshee

sections.title: Part 2: Master of the Necropolis!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Necropolis
Location: Near the southeastern corner of the cemetery.

Briefing: The Laughing Hound: " I tracked a kidnapper to his lair in the Necropolis. Dreadful fellow - called himself Monsieur Mort. He planned on turning those he abducted into ghouls, but I thwarted that terrible scheme in the nick of time! [*laughter*]"

images.label: Tales of the Laughing Hound - Master of the Necropolis

sections.title: Part 3: The Traveler of Time!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Village
Location: At the house just some meters west of the Laughing Hound Pub.

Briefing: The Laughing Hound: " Tonight, I encountered a strangely-garbed fellow called " Booster Gold." He claimed to be from the distant future, on the trail of a scoundrel called "Chronos." Upon informing him that I'd seen no such villain about, he vanished into thin air! How peculiar!"

images.label: Tales of the Laughing Hound - The Traveler of Time

sections.title: Part 4: A Villain Returns!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Town
Location: At the southern inner city wall (the wall around the castle).

Briefing: The Laughing Hound: " I thought I'd seen the last of Monsieur Mort when he met his final justice at the gallows. Unfortunately, the dreadful fellow escaped the Reaper's embrace and returned to terrorize the city once more. I must put a stop to that vile ghoul - post haste!"

images.label: Tales of the Laughing Hound - A Villain Returns

sections.title: Part 5: Terror of the Mausoleum
items: Zone: DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum
Region: Desecrated Mausoleum
Location:

Briefing: The Laughing Hound: " My arch for Monsieur Mort has joined forces with the servants of the Hell itself - demons! Thankfully, Lady Kaznia and I were able to defeat the nefarious rogue and his dread compatriots before they could complete their devilish ritual in the Mausoleum!"

images.label: Tales of the Laughing Hound - Terror of the Mausoleum

sections.title: Part 6: Shadow of the Bat-Man!
items: Zone: DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum
Region: Desecrated Mausoleum
Location:

Briefing: The Laughing Hound: " Another encounter with a time-traveler - this time, a grim fellow called " The Bat-Man." We foiled a gruesome villain's attempt to steal the Crown Jewel of Kaznia from our beloved Queen's boudoir. I daresay this " Joker" will think twice about crossing the Dark Knight and the Laughing Hound again! [*laughter*]"

images.label: Tales of the Laughing Hound - Shadow of the Bat-Man

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The soothsayers of Atlantis have been recording prophecies and detailing history for thousands of years. The invading Atlanteans have brought a number of their most important tomes with them. Delving into the history of these people might well unveil some of their undersea secrets.

The building is surrounded by a parking lot to the West, a building with a Metro Mass Transit System billboard to the South, constructions sites to the East, and a building with the signs Bar, Urgent Care Center, and Pharmacy to the North.
Investigation: Atlantean Soothsayer: " And the Darkworld chain to Atlantis was severed, burying the city beneath the waves."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Fight through security to the Batcave's door!"

sections.title: Part 1: Batcave I: Batman
items: Zone: Batcave
Region: Batcave: Outer Caverns
Location:

Investigation: Batman: "Batman recording X-X-1. It's impossible to not have doubts. Where does the man end and the mask begin? At what point does order become zealotry? Passion become insanity? I hope I never find out."

sections.title: Part 2: Batcave I: Batman
items: Zone: Batcave
Region: Batcave: Outer Caverns
Location:

Investigation: Batman: "Batman recording X-XI-5. I made a choice: I don't kill. I fight for order, for control. That makes me better than the criminals I fight. But I also see the thin line between them, and me. If the devil is in the details, what do my motivations make me?"

sections.title: Part 3: Batcave I: Batman
items: Zone: Batcave
Region: Batcave: Outer Caverns
Location:
Investigation: Batman: "Batman recording X-V-1. The Joker feeds on chaos in a symbiotic way. He doesn't just spread chaos, he *is* chaos. It is a disease. And I'm the cure."

sections.title: Part 4: Batcave I: Robin
items: Zone: Batcave
Region: Batcave: Outer Caverns

Investigation: Robin: "Batcave item catalogue #43423: Disabled OMAC nanotechnologies. These are the nanobots that trap you in an OMAC shell, I guess. That'd be that mohawk-and-cyclops look, I guess. *beat* Iiiiii don't think I could pull that off."

title: The Black Tide (Investigations)
summary: The Black Tide is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone open world zone, the Stemming the Tide challenge and the Starro: The Threat Below and Starro: Spindrift Station raids, featured as part of the Deluge episode. It comprises of five parts.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Black Tide is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone open world zone, the Stemming the Tide challenge and the Starro: The Threat Below and Starro: Spindrift Station raids, featured as part of the Deluge episode. It comprises of five parts.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Insights into the truly twisted mind of the sea devil known as Black Manta."

sections.title: Part 1: Arrogance
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: At the left front of the 7 News building right next to where the Starro the Conqueror bounty takes place.

Investigation: Black Manta: " Arthur Curry. The Aquaman. Ruler of Atlantis and King of its underwater kingdom. This man sees himself as the protector of the oceans and regards himself, without irony, as monarch and caretaker of two-thirds of the globe. Confidence to be admired or the highest form of arrogance?"

sections.title: Part 2: Ego
items: Zone: Central City Police Station
Instance: Stemming the Tide
Location: In the hallway to the Meta Containment Wing in a niche behind a Starro hatchery

Investigation: Black Manta: " Aquaman would have both his homes, above and below the water, live in unity. But the Atlanteans have lived for centuries in isolation for a reason. And all too often, Atlantis is at odds with the surface. Spindrift Station, an embassy intended to foster relations between both worlds, is his crowning achievement. But whom does it serve? Atlantis or Arthur's ego?"

sections.title: Part 3: Rogue Monarchy
items: Zone: Atlantean Research Outpost
Instance: Starro: The Threat Below
Location: In the large hall with the pools and Starro hatcheries where you fight Controlled Aquaman at the far right side at the wall

Investigation: Black Manta: " To many, Arthur is a menace. The King of an alien race that hides below our seas. A rogue monarchy unwilling to bend or negotiate. Despite his heroics and association with the Justice League, he is mocked and minimized. "The man that spoke to fish" will be his epitaph. He is man of two worlds, beloved by neither. So then why does he persist, you ask? I will tell you..."

sections.title: Part 4: Weakness
items: Zone: Ninth Tride Outpost
Instance: Stemming the Tide
Location: Around the corner from the entrance at the left wall

Investigation: Black Manta: " Mera, his wife and Queen is the pillar of his strength. Without her, he would sink under the weight of two worlds and the sea he cares so much for, would drown him. He is a noble man, a man of peace, a king to an unaccepting nation, and most importantly a husband. And I will take all of that from him..."

sections.title: Part 5: Vengeance
items: Zone: Spindrift Station
Instance: Starro: Spindrift Station
Location: In the hall where you fight Black Manta to the right on the stairs

Investigation: Black Manta: " I will destroy Spindrift Station, his monument to peace. I will tear the last shred of confidence both land and sea possess in him. I will rob him of hope and love, and force him to witness his precious Queen's final breath. And then, I will finish him and complete my life's purpose. Because no matter what Arthur Curry pretends to be, Aquaman is a murderer! And my father's death will be avenged!"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Black Manta, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " We have never crossed paths before, so I warn you now. Stand between me and Aquaman, and it will be your end. Stay out of my way, and I will ignore your antics."

items: This investigation rewards the player with the Atlantean Oxygen Tank base item.

title: The Brawling Blondie Who Became a Blackhawk (Investigations)
summary: The Brawling Blondie Who Became a Blackhawk is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across the War-Torn Village in the Age of Justice episode. There are 4 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Brawling Blondie Who Became a Blackhawk is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across the War-Torn Village in the Age of Justice episode. There are 4 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Zinda Blake, aka Lady Blackhawk, tells of how she not only joined the legendary Blackhawks but became their leader.

sections.title: Part 1: Blackhawk Bombshell
items: Zone: War-Torn Village
Location:

Investigation: Lady Blackhawk: " I know what you must be thinking, "How'd this blonde with the great gams end up in a war ravaged village in the middle of WW eye eye?" First of all, get your eyes up here or I'll sock ya' one, and second...it wasn't an easy trip, but I'm right where I belong. I'm called Lady Blackhawk, but my real name is Zinda Blake. A bunch of years ago I made it my sole purpose to be the first female member of the legendary fighter squadron, The Blackhawks. And by golly, I did just that! I taught myself how to fly, how to fight, and how to be the fiercest broad this side of the Rhine. As luck would have it, I got my chance to prove myself by actually rescuing the Blackhawks from danger not once, but twice. After that, they pretty much had to let me join."

sections.title: Part 2: Of Ghosts and Guns
items: Zone: War-Torn Village
Location:

Investigation: Lady Blackhawk: " I had a chance to shoot the breeze with Franklin and Jeb the other day. Jeb was letting Sgt. Rock and Easy Company hitch a ride to Belgium, and we were talking about all the crazy stuff this war seems to have brought about. While in Africa, Jeb and his tank crew had heard stories of a battalion of jack-booted fascists looking for everything from the Ark of the Covenant to the Spear of Destiny! Apparently their fearless leader is obsessed with the occult, like a nut for the subject. Rock laughed if off, but I gotta' tell ya', after working with the JSA lately, there ain't much I won't believe anymore."

sections.title: Part 3: Savages of War
items: Zone: War-Torn Village
Location:

Investigation: Lady Blackhawk: " War is hell and the people of this poor village have had it worse than most. Even before the war started, the town was a safe haven for refugees pouring in from Eastern Europe. They thought the medieval walls and that great stone keep would make them safe. And it sure did for a while. Then Baron Von Savage and his shock troopers arrived, wanting the village for their own in order to control the mountain pass that lies behind it."

sections.title: Part 4: War-Torn Walls
items: Zone: War-Torn Village
Location:

Investigation: Lady Blackhawk: " Baron Von Savage clobbered the townsfolk but good and was ruling with an iron fist until General Patton realized his tanks needed that mountain pass and sent a group of us in to kick Baron Von Suck-An-Egg out. With the aid of the Blackhawks and the JSA, the Allies just barely managed to take the city back, but it's been a never ending battle ever since. But these troops are tough as nails and we'll lick ole' Von Savage and his futuristic fascists yet."

Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " No matter the time, the place, or time-torn place, Lady Blackhawk is one of a kind."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Hmmm, yes, the "Lady" Blackhawk. I find her...quaint. Although, I suppose we share a time displaced kinship. To be honest, I had all but forgotten about her."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The forces of the multiverse cannot be outrun.

sections.title: Part 1: Zoom's Secrets
items: Zone: Flashpoint Gotham City
Location: At the east side of a building two blocks east from the Iceberg Lounge, behind a column.

Investigation: Flashpoint Cyborg: " There was something else I found on Professor Zoom. Nobody else could see it, so I... I got scared, and kept it hidden. At the time it seemed mundane, and unrelated to what we were supposed to be doing, but now that we have some breathing space, on my grave this thing frightens me... This... door knob with scratches on it. I have to get rid of it."

images.label: The Cosmic Speed Force - Zoom's Secrets

sections.title: Part 2: Zoom's Anguish
items: Zone: New Themyscira Temple
Region: Temple
Instance: FP: The Royal War

Location: In the left upper part of the two hallways leading to the final confrontation directly behind the part filled rubble. This node can only be reached by taking the lower right hallway and then backtrack in the upper hallway.
Investigation: Professor Zoom: " You caused this, Flash! I was only ever an observer! When you changed history, The Speed Force responded."

images.label: The Cosmic Speed Force - Zoom's Anguish

sections.title: Part 3: A Motorcycle?!
items: Zone: Flash to the Future
Instance: FP: Flash to the Future
Location: At the end of the hall where Kid Flash was being kept, at the right side at a pillar.

Investigation: The Flash: " Not going to lie, I'm a little jealous of getting to ride on a Cosmic Motorcycle rather than run along a treadmill. I guess not everything's worse in Flashpoint, right? That was a joke. I'm just not ready to say goodbye to my mom."

images.label: The Cosmic Speed Force - A Motorcycle

sections.title: Part 4: Source of the Paradox
items: Zone: Flashpoint Gotham City
Region: Iceberg Lounge
Location: At the backside of the Iceberg Lounge dome.

Investigation: Doctor Sarah Charles: " The Source Wall is only partially repaired, and I have grave concerns over what this Flashpoint paradox might mean for the stability of Multiverse itself. I don't know how solving the paradox will resolve itself, and that scares me. I guess sometimes you just have to hope."

images.label: The Cosmic Speed Force - Source of the Paradox

sections.title: Part 5: Booster Gold and Paradoxes
items: Zone: Flashpoint Gotham City
Region: Subject Doomsday's Invasion Site
Location: At a tree in the far left corner of the area where you fight Subject Doomsday.

Investigation: Booster Gold: " As a fellow time traveler, of course I know exactly what is going wrong and how to fix it. Unfortunately, I'm too busy keeping Doomsday from destroying everything, so I'll have to outsource this one. Ummm... have you tried looking for time anomalies? That's what I usually do whenever I'm trying to track down Rip Hunter."

images.label: The Cosmic Speed Force - Booster Gold and Paradoxes

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Oracle, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " All this paradox stuff from the Flashpoint world, all the stuff that's happened to the Source Wall... it can't be good for the Multiverse. And on top of that, I get the feeling like something's trying to reach out to me? I don't know, maybe nothing will come of it. But I think you might want this in case it proves useful in the future."

sections.title: Trivia
items: Part 1: The door knob mentioned by FP Cyborg is the Cosmic Doorknob, a round golden doorknob with the symbol of Doom scraped on it made from fragments of the Totality. Lex Luthor would use it to unlock Doom, setting up the events for the Legion of Doom episode. It was created by Scott Snyder and Jim Cheung, first appearing in Justice League Vol 4 #1 (2018).

sections.title: Synopsis
items: GCPD Homicide Reports on the murders committed by the " Exobyte Killer" on the streets of Gotham.

sections.title: Part 1: GCPD File PV-614
items: Zone: Apokoliptic Gotham City
Region: Warzone
Location: On the ground level, Southwest from Harley Quinn.

Briefing: Commissioner Gordon:" Bullock found another vic tonight, a block away from Crime Alley. Third this week - exobyte-enhanced like the others. Looks like we've got a super-powered serial killer on the streets."

images.label: The Exobyte Killer - GCPD File PV-614

sections.title: Part 2: GCPD File PV-615
items: Zone: Apokoliptic Gotham City
Region: Warzone
Location: East of Gotham Docks, on a column of the first gazebo near the waterfront.
Briefing: Commissioner Gordon:" Another Exobyte killing - this time in the Diamond District. Rookie hero, went by "Captain Gotham"... all that was left was a pile of dust and a tattered cape."

images.label: The Exobyte Killer - GCPD File PV-615

sections.title: Part 3: GCPD File PV-616
items: Zone: Apokoliptic Gotham City
Region: Lava Pool Generator
Location: On the stairs of the building where The Huntress is located.

Briefing: Commissioner Gordon:" The press got wind of the killings and ran with it. They're calling the perp the " Exobyte Killer" now... wonderful. Even an alien invasion can't stop a new supervillain from raising hell in Gotham."

images.label: The Exobyte Killer - GCPD File PV-616

sections.title: Part 4: GCPD File PV-617
items: Zone: Apokoliptic Gotham City
Region: Gotham Tech District
Location: By the entrance of the building Northwest of Nightwing's location.

images.label: The Exobyte Killer - GCPD File PV-617

sections.title: Part 5: GCPD File PV-618

Region: Gotham Tech District

images.label: The Exobyte Killer - GCPD File PV-618

rows: " Sure, we've worked with villains before, but now this cosmic being dragging us all together? It's a weird sort of reminder that sometimes the scale of things is beyond our scope, and we have to swallow our pride and focus an what really needs to be done. Take this, you'll need it."

The Hunt for Kryb is a Global Investigation that can be found in Sunken Argo City. There are eight parts that comprise this investigation. It is part of the Shadows Over Argo chapter in the Children of Krypton story arc.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Notes from Supergirl about her hunt for Kryb.

sections.title: Part 1: The Hunt Is On!
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City
Location: in the center of the map, little bit south of rally point on ground level

Investigation: Supergirl: " I got a call from Guy Gardner of all people! Seems a Yellow Lantern named Kryb is up to no good out in space, and he wants my help tracking her down. I was a little dubious about it until I read up on this Kryb... and she's a monster. Whatever she's up to needs to be stopped, and fast."

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P1

sections.title: Part 2: Lobo
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City
Location: south-east, by two overlapping circles at the bottom of map

Investigation: Supergirl: " Guy and I ran into Lobo in deep space. There's a bounty on Kryb's head after all of the stuff she did on Mogo. Guess a bunch of the survivors pooled their money to put a price on her head. Unfortunately, Kryb gave Lobo the slip - and that's not easy. Finding her could be harder than I thought."

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P2

sections.title: Part 3: The Hawks
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City
Location: east side, vertically in the middle of map, it's next to rally point on building

Investigation: Supergirl: " Followed a lead on Kryb to Thanagar, but the trail went cold there. We met with the Hawks and that was... interesting. Pretty clear they're not big fans of Guy... didn't help that he had to run his mouth about Green Arrow being cooler than Hawkman. Yikes. Kendra and I calmed things down, But we're back to square one when it comes to Kryb."

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P3

sections.title: Part 4: Atrocitus
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City

Location: from large opened space with rally points in north-west follow the giant crystal cannon from it's back, down the stairs to the east, between high towers there is one tower with tunnel-like looking ally, exclamation mark is in front of the tunnel on the ground

Investigation: Supergirl: " Guy heard from Bleez - guess things aren't all peachy for the Red Lanterns these days. Stuff went down on Mogo, and a lot of them think Atrocitus has went into business for himself... and Kryb. Leave it to Atrocitus to piss off hundreds of bad guys powered by rage, but if he's in league with Kryb, things could be rough once we find her."

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P4

sections.title: Part 5: Apokolips Not
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City
Location: find top left rally point, go little bit north-east from that, you'll find invest. mark by stairs to giant crystal cannon

Investigation: Supergirl: " We met with Mister Miracle and Big Barda to follow a lead on Kryb going to Apokolips - another bust. Can't imagine anyone wanting a team-up with Darkseid, but Guy assures me Kryb's that kind of crazy. Probably for the best they didn't join forces - not up for a brawl with Parademons and all of the jerks in Darkseid's posse."

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P5

sections.title: Part 6: The Best Boy
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City
Location: north-west sector, ground level, from the most top left rally point go a bit to the west, it's in the middle of big stairs

Investigation: Supergirl: " Guy got called back to Oa on official Green Lantern business. That leaves the hunt for Kryb up to me, but I won't be alone. Getting some help tracking her from the best boy ever - Krypto! Only a matter of time before that super-nose of his gets the scent - and then, Kryb's in big trouble."

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P6

sections.title: Part 7: The Blue Light
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City
Location: north-west, in front of corridor expanding outside of map, higher ground level above stairs

Investigation: Supergirl: " Got in touch with a Blue Lantern - Luzia Cavalera. Turns out her niece is being held prisoner by Kryb... and that's not good. I've read the Justice League files on Luzia - she's had a rough road, but if Leaguers like John Stewart and The Atom vouche for her that's good enough for me. Time for a team-up!"

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P7

sections.title: Part 8: Argo City
items: Zone: Sunken Argo City
Location: total north west, end of corridor, in front of Kryb's lab entrance

Investigation: Supergirl: " Heard from Aquaman - there's been activity in the ruins of Argo City, still down at the bottom of the Atlantic. Arthur's scouts spotted an alien matching the description of Kryb there, and since it's going down in a Kryptonian place they want a "local" to help out... so to speak. Since Argo's my hometown, I'm in. Kryb just made this personal."

images.label: Investigations - The Hunt for Kryb P8

title: The Lost Crystals of Power (Briefings)
summary: The Lost Crystals of Power is a global briefing that can be found in various episode locations. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Atlantis episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Lost Crystals of Power is a global briefing that can be found in various episode locations. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Atlantis episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " These legendary stones of power from the First Age of Atlantis have been sought after by would be kings and tyrants alike."

sections.title: Part 1: Calculha and Majistra
items: Zone: Silent School
Instance: Atlantis: The Silent School
Location: In the center hall where you fight the Crown of Thorns Golem on the upper floor on the left side at a lamp

Briefing: Mera: " The Silent School hides many secrets in their walls, in some cases for our own protection. The Zodiac Crystals are one such secret. Created millennia ago by powerful mages, Calculha and Majistra, these Crystals were designed to harness the latent magical energies of the Earth."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - Calculha and Majistra

sections.title: Part 2: A New Age
items: Zone: Silent School
Instance: Atlantis: The Silent School
Location: In the fourth hall and before you move on to the center hall on the left side behind a bookshelf

Briefing: Mera: " The crystals represent each of the twelve signs of the Zodiac which include Fire, Water, Earth and Air domains. Together these crystals brought Atlantis into a new age of magical enlightenment."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - A New Age

sections.title: Part 3: Temptation
items: Zone: Silent School
Instance: Atlantis: The Silent School
Location: In the second hall to the left side behind a bookshelf

Briefing: Mera: " As with all things brilliant and undreamt of the temptation of power becomes irresistible. The mages, now husband and wife, turned on one another. Majistra embraced the Black arts, summoning forth the Abyssal Dark and all the evil that dwelled within it."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - Temptation

sections.title: Part 4: A Lord of Order
items: Zone: Atlantis
Region: (open world)

Location: On the norht of the Western half of the map, look for a Atlantis Statue - Victory on the roofs. Its trident points to a Silent School camp with a Atlantis Statue - Standing Nobility at the center - south of this statue, you'll see a group of building with 3 major towers. The node is behind the middle tower.

Briefing: Mera: " Calculha remained a servant of the Light and fought valiantly to keep the Crystals from his wife. Their struggle continued on with their children Arion and Garn Daanuth. Arion would become the greatest wizard Atlantis would ever know and protected the crystals from misuse."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - A Lord of Order

sections.title: Part 5: Heritage
items: Zone: Crown of Thorns
Instance: Atlantis: Crown of Thorns
Location: In the first room after the King Shark fight at the far right wall.

Briefing: Mera: " The Crystals were eventually separated, hidden, and lost to the ages, until my brother in law, Ocean Master, learned of their heritage and sought to reunite all twelve Zodiac Crystals as a sign of his worthiness to sit upon the throne of Atlantis."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - Heritage

sections.title: Part 6: A Battle for the Ages
items: Zone: Crown of Thorns
Instance: Atlantis: Crown of Thorns
Location: In the hallway between the first room and second room after the King Shark fight, at the first corner behind some thorns.

Briefing: Ocean Master: " With only six of the twelves Zodiac crystals in my possession, I possessed unimaginable power. Not even my insipid brother could stop me. If not for the interference of Arion himself, and Arthur's cursed Trident, I would now sit upon the throne!"

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - A Battle for the Ages

sections.title: Part 7: Exile
items: Zone: Crown of Thorns
Instance: Atlantis: Crown of Thorns
Location: In the second room after the King Shark fight at the far left wall (as seen from the entrance).

Briefing: Ocean Master: " Defeated I was robbed of the six Crystals I possessed, I was sent into exile a broken man. The Crystals were again separated and hidden where even my skills could not seer. The other six remained lost to the ages, until now."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - Exile

sections.title: Part 8: The Lost Crystals
items: Zone: Crown of Thorns
Instance: Atlantis: Crown of Thorns
Location: At the right side of the first part of the last hallway leading to the hall of the final fight.

Briefing: Mera: " Corum Rath, the usurper king has uncovered the lost Zodiac Crystals deep within the catacombs beneath the Silent School. Combined with the power of Dark Abyssal magic and the Dead King's Scepter, he has the power of a god."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - The Lost Crystals

sections.title: Part 9: Betrayal
items: Zone: Atlantis Risen
Instance: Atlantis: The Throne
Location: Behind the entrance portal at the right side at a pillar

Briefing: Ocean Master: " The magical power that Rath wields is an abomination that no Hadalin of the Ninth Tride should be permitted. So I have conceded to cooperate with my detested brother's wife to stop Rath and expel him from the throne. Once that is done, I will reclaim the Crystals and take what is rightfully mine."

images.label: The Lost Crystals of Power - Betrayal

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Aquaman or Ocean Master, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " The Zodiac Crystals are far too powerful to ever be reunited. Thank you for recovering these recordings detailing their history and locations."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " These Zodiac Crystals are the key to the throne of Atlantis. Long have I searched for them, but they still elude me. How fortunate that the Silent School has uncovered them for me."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with the Drift Guard Shoulderguards shoulders item (Style: Drift Guard).

sections.title: Trivia
items: In Part 2:; Fire is the element of the signs Leo (♌︎), Aries (♈︎), and Sagittarius (♐︎); Water is the element of the signs Cancer (♋︎), Scorpio (♏︎), and Pisces (♓︎); Earth is the element of the signs Taurus (♉︎), Virgo (♍︎), and Capricorn (♑︎); Air is the element of the signs Gemini (♊︎), Libra (♎︎), and Aquarius (♒︎).

Regarding Parts 1, 3, and 4, there are two versions of the story of Calculha, Majistra, Arion, and Garn Daanuth.; They were created as part of the New Earth continuity by Doug Moench and Jan Duursema for the Sword and Sorcery series Arion Lord of Atlantis as a back-up for the Warlord title, debuting in 1982 in Warlord #55 through #62 before getting its own title, which ran from 1982 to 1985. That is the most fleshed-out version of the characters, and it is said they are Zatanna's ancestors.; In the Prime Earth continuity, Calculha and Majistra were reintroduced by Bryan Hitch during the Timeless storyline in 2017. Arion, however, first appeared in that continuity in the previous year in Secret Six #8. Garn Daanuth was first mentioned in Wonder Woman Vol. 5 #51 (2018), effectively appearing in New History of the DC Universe #1 in 2025. In this version, they're Aquaman's ancestors, and only Arion was properly developed by the release of the Atlantis episode in November 2018. No significant change was made to the characters' lore, which makes the overall events of Arion Lord of Atlantis still relevant to date.

Parts 5, 6, and 7 refer to the events of the 1986 Aquaman limited series:; In the original story, the six crystals Ocean Master retrieved were Aries, Gemini, Leo, Capricornus, Aquarius, and Pisces. In Part 7, it's stated that Corum Rath finds the location of the other 6 crystals; however, during the final battle in Atlantis: The Throne, he uses the crystals of Sagittarius, Scorpio, Taurus, Virgo, Cancer and, yet again, Aries. Whether the developers had mistaken the illustrations in the comics or not, one must presume that, in the DCUO version of the storyline, Ocean Master used the Libra Crystal instead of the Aries Crystal.; Its storyline introduced Thierna Na Oge, the underwater city where the Orichalcum metal is native.

The Zodiac Crystals first appeared in the New Earth continuity in Arion Lord of Atlantis #4 (1983), created by Doug Moench and Jan Duursema. The Crystals' first appearance in the Prime Earth continuity was in Justice League Vol. 3 #2 (2016) during the Extinction Machines storyline by Bryan Hitch.

sections.title: Part 2: For Queen and Colony
items: Zone: Titans Island
Location: South of Cyborg's Workshop near the beach behind a large rock formation

Investigation: H.I.V.E. Master: " I was enamored by her alien qualities; her looks...her charm...her hypno-pollen. But over time, she began to trust me, without my leash. She saw me as an asset, her confidant and even her lover."

images.label: The Rebirth of H.I.V.E. - For Queen and Colony

sections.title: Part 3: Superior Rulership
items: Zone: Titans Island
Location: East of Titans Tower within the second rocky mountain wall

Investigation: H.I.V.E. Master: " Soon it was Zazzala who adored me...And when we married...I became her "house bee" feeding her ego and sharing her throne. I was her mate. Her King Bee. But what she failed to see was...I was not her equal. I was her superior."

images.label: The Rebirth of H.I.V.E. - Superior Rulership

sections.title: Part 4: Bitter Honey
items: Zone: Titans Island
Location: In the bushes at the Northern cliff near Starfire's Garden

Investigation: H.I.V.E. Master: " She underestimated my own abilities to manipulate H.I.V.E. against her. As her machinations failed over and over at the hands of the cursed Titans...I planted the seeds of rebellion in her honey and fed it to her followers."

images.label: The Rebirth of H.I.V.E. - Bitter Honey

sections.title: Part 5: Queen Bee No More
items: Zone: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Region: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Location: At the left end of the bridge in the entrance hall in front of a stack of destroyable crates

Investigation: H.I.V.E. Master: " Soon, thanks to my direction, the worker drones saw her for what she truly was...an alien intruder in our colony. A foreign entity spreading discord from within our H.I.V.E. By the time Zazzala saw what was happening, I was waiting to ensure her demise."

images.label: The Rebirth of H.I.V.E. - Queen Bee No More

sections.title: Part 6: H.I.V.E. Reborn
items: Zone: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Region: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Location: In the middle of the passage after you took a right turn after the first hall in the left niche

Investigation: H.I.V.E. Master: " With the Queen gone, I have brought order and purpose to H.I.V.E. No longer will alien forces dictate out goals. I have garnered the faith of my following on the promise of greatness. A promise hinged on the death of our greatest enemies! A promise of revenge!"

images.label: The Rebirth of H.I.V.E. - H.I.V.E. Reborn

sections.title: Part 7: The Judas Contract
items: Zone: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn

images.label: The Rebirth of H.I.V.E. - The Judas Contract

title: The Starro Report (Investigations)
summary: The Starro Report is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone open world zone and the Stemming the Tide challenge, featured as part of the Deluge episode. It comprises of 6 parts.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Starro Report is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone open world zone and the Stemming the Tide challenge, featured as part of the Deluge episode. It comprises of 6 parts.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "Breaking reports from the scene of the Starro Event with Iris West Allen."

sections.title: Part 1: Starro Attacks!
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: On top of the 7 News building behind the large 7 News sign

Investigation: Iris West Allen: "This is Iris Allen, reporting live for Central City Picture News. I am on the scene of a massive alien attack by the parasitic space entity, Starro. Local CCPD police and emergency services are currently slammed with record amounts of response calls. To make matters worse, the alien invader seem to be targeting our superhuman and mundane population in an attempt to increase its numbers! More from the scene in fifteen!"

sections.title: Part 2: Alien Hatcheries!
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: On top of the building north of the open place left of the Flash Museum near the satellite dish

Investigation: Iris West Allen: "Iris Allen for CC Picture News here. I'm reporting from a disturbing scene near Central City's riverside district, where Starro hatcheries are being brought ashore by what appear to be Atlantean soldiers. Unlike the previous Starro attack, these Atlanteans do not seem to be under alien influence and lack the tell tale " Starfish Face". Although completely unthinkanle, the question stands... Could this be an Atlantean terrorist attack? More from the scene in fifteen."

sections.title: Part 3: Super-Powered Starro!
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: On the rooftop of the building west of the large open green in front of the Flash Museum

Investigation: Iris West Allen: "Iris Allen here, reporting for Central City Picture News. I am receiving a huge number of reports of Central City's most beloved heroes and villains being overtaken by the Starro menace. Aurora from Danville claims to have seen Doctor Fate with a starfish on his face... Really Aurora? Rob from Brookfield Heights just spotted Starro'd Black Lightning outside his building. And John, visiting us from Gotham just saw a possessed... Kid... Flash... on his way to the Flash Museum... Um, more from the scene in fifteen. Cut... Cut the feed, Charlie... I need a second."

sections.title: Part 4: Atlanteans Responsible?
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: On the rooftop of the building left behind (north of) the Flash Museum, the one with one antenna and two satellite dishes

Investigation: Iris West Allen: "Iris Allen back from break, as the claims of Atlantean ties to the Starro attack are gaining traction in Washington. My co-correspondent, Lana Lang had the opportunity to interview General Lane who called the attack "...a sucker punch to the American people and a true act of aggression."."

sections.title: Part 5: The Spindrift Question
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: On the rooftop of the building right behind (north of) the Flash Museum, behind the satellite dish

Investigation: Iris West Allen: "Iris Allen for CC Picture News reporting on the public outcry concerning the Starro menace and its ties to Atlantis. Spindrift Station, the dry land embassy purported to nurture peace between the surface world and Atlantis, has announced a gala event to address concerns. Neither Aquaman or Mera, his wife and ambassador, were available for comment. More from the scene in fifteen..."

images.label: The Starro Report - The Spindrift Question

sections.title: Part 6: Atlantean Insurgents!
items: Instance: Stemming the Tide

Location: For this node to appear you need to finish the first part of the challenge, the one in the Central City Police Station. The node will appear next to a red sign on the wall after Mera/Ocean Master appears and you need to visit it before you go on through the portal.

Investigation: Iris West Allen: "Iris Allen here with an important update... Central City's scarlet speedster, The Flash was seen foiling a combined attack by Starro and Atlantean insurgents on the CCPD's 1st precinct house with another unidentified super. The Flash, a long time friend and teammate to the Atlantean royal family, was quoted as saying, " Mera and Arthur are sparing no effort in their personal investigation into who is behind the Starro attacks. They have assured me that the Atlantean Empire is in no way responsible..."."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Iris Allen, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I see you've been listening to my reports about the Starro Invasion. People want to blame the Atlanteans -- I mean it's not a big jump from giant Starfish to sea people. But I don't think that's the case. At least, that's what Mera and Aquaman asure us. And my reporter's instincts tells me to believe them."

items: This investigation rewards the player with the Atlantean Valve base item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The parts of this investigations collection interconnects with the Starro Crossed Lovers briefings collection.
Part 2 references the events of the Stemming the Tide (Part 1) mission.

Part 3:; Black Lightning and Kid Flash are part of the Fallen Stars mission. One of Kid Flash's spawning points the roof of the Flash Museum.; Danville and Brookfield Heights are districts in Central City.

Part 4:; By the time the Deluge episode was released, Lana Lang became Superwoman in the comics and was working for the Daily Star conglomerate. It is unclear whether this part infers that Lana works for Picture News, or if the Daily Star owns Picture News, or if Iris and Lana are merely covering the events of the invasion together for their respective papers - the latter is the most probable.; General Lane is Lois Lane's father.
Part 5 summarizes the events of the Stemming the Tide solo instance.
