summary: The Tenets of Crime is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Diamond District of the city of Gotham, inside quest locations for the story arc Gotham's Gang War's Episode 3. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Tenets of Crime is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Diamond District of the city of Gotham, inside quest locations for the story arc Gotham's Gang War's Episode 3. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Intergang and its cultists believe that the Crime Bible prophesizes their conquest of the world through Gotham. Learning more about its heretical tenets could help cripple their takeover attempts.

sections.title: Part 1: Chapter 8 Verse 23
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: East End
Instance: Intergang Penthouse
Location: On the lower floor, by the stairs to the recreational area.
Investigation: Whisper A'Daire: " The Book of Blood. Chapter 8 Verse 23. By Deceit ye have freed yourself from the illusion of truth, and thus do I name the First Lesson of Blood."

sections.title: Part 2: Chapter 40 Verse 37
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Instance: Mysterious Warehouse
Location: In the first room, at the northeastern corner.

Investigation: Whisper A'Daire: " The Book of Blood. Chapter 40 Verse 37. Lilith raised Him up, and setting His hands upon her, spoke with breath hot on his neck. What ye name virtue, I call weakness, for ye Lust heartily, but have not strength nor courage enough to slake it."

sections.title: Part 3: Chapter 19 Verse 12
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Instance: Mysterious Warehouse
Location: In the final room, between the shelves by the conveyor belt under the window.

Investigation: Whisper A'Daire: " The Book of Blood. Chapter 19 Verse 12. To your gates I came thirsty, and with water would have left contented; but ye have shown me Greed, and this I shall name the Third Lesson."

sections.title: Part 4: Chapter 3 Verse 10
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Instance: Temple of Crime
Location: By the pillar southwest of the altar.

Investigation: Whisper A'Daire: " The Book of Blood. Chapter 3 Verse 10. Thus do I mark thee, that ye might practice Murder and take that of which the weak have no need, and so earn the right to live."

sections.title: Part 5: Blood Ritual Excerpt
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: Burnley
Instance: Temple of Crime
Location: Downstairs after the second room, behind a metal crate to the west.

Investigation: Whisper A'Daire: " ...So that ye might Learn the truths that are hidden. That ye might pull secrets hidden from the very Hearts that hide them...And so see my kingdom rise anew upon the Earth. In Cain's name."

sections.title: Mail Messages

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " This Crime Bible calls for Batwoman's death. I won't stop digging until I get some answers! Thanks for your help in the Diamond District... I don't want to think about what could have happened."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Intergang's precious guide to crime. Bully for you. Obviously crime comes to you naturally, so I'm sure you wont be needing it. Take your cut, and I'll take mine. Be seeing you."

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Tenets of of Crime are known as the "Four Lessons of Blood", which are the Religion of Crime's equivalent to the "Ten Commandments" for Jews and Christians.

Four of the passages is are excerpts (with errors) from issues of the Crime Bible: Five Lessons of Blood limited series, a follow-up to the Questions storyline from the 52 series on which Gotham's Gang War, Episode 3 was based:

The First Book of Blood is from Crime Bible: Five Lessons of Blood #1. The comic reproduces Verses 16-27 of Chapter 8. The original Verse 23 goes " Then the First did reveal His palm to the Caitiff and all his followers; and showing in it the Stain, spake thus, saying, By Deceit ye have freed yourself from the illusion of truth, and thus do I name this the First Lesson of Blood."

The Second Book of Blood is from Crime Bible: Five Lessons of Blood #2. The comic reproduces Verses 31-40 of Chapter 40. The investigation actually reveals Verses 37-38. The original verses go " Then it was Lilith raised Him up, and setting His hands upon her, spake with breath hot on His neck. / What ye name virtue, I call weakness, for ye Lust heartily, but have not strength nor courage enough to slake it ; if thou canst not take what ye want, then ye shall ne'er command it."

The Third Book of Blood is from Crime Bible: Five Lessons of Blood #3. The comic reproduces Verses 4-13 of Chapter 19. The original Verse 12 goes "To your gates I came thirsty, and with water would have left contented; but ye have shown me Greed, and this I shall name the Third Lesson ; and ye have shown me the sign that thou art its slave, and not its master."

The Fourth Book of Blood is from Crime Bible: Five Lessons of Blood #4. The comic reproduces Verses 1-12 of Chapter 3. The investigation actually reveals Verse 11, not 10. The original Verse 11 goes "Thus do I mark thee, that ye might practice Murder and take that of which the weak have no need, and so earn thy right to live."

The ritual is for a human sacrifice performed by Whisper A'Daire in 52 #47. The original words are " ...So that ye might learn the truths which are hidden ... That ye might pull secrets hidden from the very hearts that hide them...And so see my kingdom rise anew upon the Earth. In Cain's name."

In the mail, The Question refers to the Diamond District, which was the original location for the Intergang Penthouse - the entrance was temporarily moved to the East End with Hotfix 23/11/22 to prevent a client crash. As of 2026, the entrance has not been moved back.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Beast Boy took time out of his busy schedule to answer his fans' hard-hitting questions.

sections.title: Part 1: The Beast Common Denominator
items: Zone: Titans Island
Region: Titans Island
Location: At a small rock formation at the Northwest of the island with Cyborg's workshop on it

Investigation: Beast Boy: " OK so...Sometimes people ask me..."Beast Boy, what's it like being a young, eligible, single hero, working on a team like the Titans...?" to which I respond...FREAKIN' AWESOME! I mean come on? I'm lean, I'm green, I get to hang out with super-babes. What more can a green skinned guy ask for?"

images.label: The World According to Gar - The Beast Common Denominator

sections.title: Part 2: International Beast of Mystery
items: Zone: Titans Targeted!
Region: Titans Tower
Location:

Investigation: Beast Boy: " If you had one wish...Like one...And you didn't choose to be a Titan, you'd be the dumbest person on the planet. Action, excitement, travel, and lets not forget FOOD, are all a daily part of life. I mean come on, we've got our own fan club!"

images.label: The World According to Gar - International Beast of Mystery

sections.title: Part 3: Wild Boy
items: Zone: Titans Island
Region: Titans Tower
Location: At the Southeast corner of the Titans Tower on a lower ledge

Investigation: Beast Boy: " OK, so I won't lie. Sometimes, it's not all K-Pop and video games. Sometimes living with five or even seven other people is a little inconvenient. Like, what if I spontaneously decide to bust out some rad dance moves after coming out of the shower and surprise! Terra happens to be standing in the hall? Uh, awkward..."

images.label: The World According to Gar - Wild Boy

sections.title: Part 4: Beauty and the Beast Boy
items: Zone: Titans Island
Region: Titans Island
Location: In the Southwest corner of the island, on top of the cliff face

Investigation: Beast Boy: " Ok. So that last thing I mentioned never actually happened...More than like three times. But the truth is, it's hard being on a team. Especially when you happen to have unrequited feelings for a fellow teammate, who has unwillingly seen you naked. I will take a naked moonwalk to humiliating rejection any day of the week."

images.label: The World According to Gar - Beauty and the Beast Boy

sections.title: Part 5: Beast of Burden
items: Zone: Titans Island
Region: Titans Tower

Investigation: Beast Boy: " So if I had to be totally honest, my life isn't always wooing the ladies and beating up the bad guys. Sometimes I need to be the life of the party so I don't breakdown crying. But even so dude, it's nothing a few good friends and humungoid piece of cake can't fix." DONNA TROY: " Who ate the last of my chocolate cake? Gaaaarth!"

images.label: The World According to Gar - Beast of Burden

sections.title: Part 6: Beast Boy Fan Club
items: Zone: Titans Island
Region: Titans Tower

title: Time, Time, Time... (Briefings)
summary: Time, Time, Time... is a global briefing that can be found in the Time-Torn Area 51. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Age of Justice episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Time, Time, Time... is a global briefing that can be found in the Time-Torn Area 51. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Age of Justice episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Rip Hunter. Vandal Savage, Per Degaton and Baron Von Savage share their "musings" on the nature of time and what it means to not be bound by it."

sections.title: Part 1: RIPples in Time
items: Zone: Time-Torn Area 51
Location:

Briefing: Rip Hunter:" Time is relative - Albert Einstein. "Time is a pain in my arse." Me, Rip Hunter. Something big is about to happen, or has happened, and I'm just now fining out about it. My sensors in the Time Sphere started going crazy which lead me here to Area 51. Next thing I know, World War Two era stormtroopers start pouring out of the tears in time. Paradox energy is off the charts, and it looks like the entire space time continuum is starting to collapse in on itself. I have had a day."

sections.title: Part 2: Butterfly Effects
items: Zone: Time-Torn Area 51
Location:

Briefing: Older Vandal Savage:" Time is a tool, like a hammer, or a wrench, or from when I was a much younger man, a rock. But it can also be a weapon, like a sword or spear for those with the still, foresight, and cunning to wield it. Being immortal has its advantages as well. Playing with time does funny things to the memory of one who is a constant throughout it. I am not sure what my past self is doing, the recollection has become a haze, but I have a feeling a weapon has been drawn, a shot fired, a spear thrown, that will alter my current reality in ways yet unimagined. This will not stand. If I must forge an uneasy alliance with those who normally attempt to thwart my plans...then so be it."

sections.title: Part 3: Time Tyrant
items: Zone: Time-Torn Area 51
Location:

Briefing: Per Degaton:" Time is power. Power to shape events to one's choosing. All that is needed is the proper circumstances --ripe with potential to alter the future permanently. A moment in time whose reverberations are felt for hundreds of years to come. I, Per Degaton, shall be at the epicenter of that moment. Crushing the troublesome JSA will be an added bonus. Watching them fall to failure and defeat will be a sight I will relish for all eternity."

sections.title: Part 4: Fire Watcher
items: Zone: Time-Torn Area 51
Location:

Briefing: Younger Vandal Savage:" Time is endless. Ever marching forward. Inexorable with its consistency and mediocrity. I have walked this planet for centuries and I am...bored. If this is the conflict that will truly bring the world to its knees, I wish to wield the sword. I no longer care for plans of the future. of what *may* come. I shall take the carrot offered by Per Degaton, to rob the future, to pay the past, and if I am cunning, and just a little bit lucky, I can stab in the eye with the sharpened tip of that carrot and rule over the world as I watch it burn."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Rip Hunter or Vandal Savage, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Well, these certainly are... interesting. They would have been useful weeks ago. If only I could go back in time... oh, wait... no. Hello, Hunter, nothing ever good comes from that."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Hmm, I find this fscinating. Getting a glimpse into not only the minds of allies and enemies, but also into your former self is... informative."

sections.title: Trivia
items: The title is probably a reference to the opening lyrics of the song " A Hazy Shade of Winter."

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Raven's Trigonic eruption has released the sins of the Titans from their mortal shells. These soul manifestations are powerful...and valuable. Retrieve them to aid, or hinder, the Titans for your allies.

table.caption: Collectibles
rows: It snarls and snaps with the inner turmoil Beast Boy feels as a result of his animalistic powers.
Next to the tree on the east side of the bridge across the river from The Forum of the 12 Ceasars.
A raging inferno of power, representing ; Starfire's birth at the hand of malevolent aliens.
In the Gazebo in the Southeast corner of Robinson Park near The Forum of the 12 Ceasars.
Dark mists of sadness and pain swirl within this soulshard, a representation of Nightwing's tragic youth.
Flickering and shot through with the green traces of circuitry, representing Cyborg's constant war between his cybernetic parts and his humanity.
Dim and pulsing like the embers of a dying star, representing Donna Troy's sometimes-crippling isolation as a wanderer of the multiverse.
Rippling and pulsing with an unhealthy glow, this soulshard was the 'cork' on the deep well of Trigonic energy Raven keeps dormant.
From the Forum of the 12 Caesars, head west past the brigde. Do the round path until you see it behind a tree.

items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Village
Location: At the north end of the street between the two small villages

Investigation: Voivode: " It's time. I didn't get these powers to sit around and play video games. I need to make a difference, help people. Batman does this every night, and he doesn't even have powers, soo... no more excuses. It's time for Voivode to hit the streets."

images.label: Voivode's Crime Journal - Let's Do This

sections.title: Part 2: My First Bust!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Village
Location: On the upper outer walkway of one of the houses in the southwestern block of the middle village (northwest of the Laughing Hound pub).

Investigation: Voivode: " I finally fought some crime tonight! A couple of goons were about to mug an old lady - not on my watch! BOOM! Note to self: need to work on pulling my punches. The muggers'll live, but they'll be eating their meals through a straw for a while. Ouch."

images.label: Voivode's Crime Journal - My First Bust

sections.title: Part 3: Magical Cultists?!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Village
Location: At the southeastern-most house of the small village (near to the Necropolis) to the east .

Investigation: Voivode: " Stopped a couple of weirdos in robes trying to stuff a girl into a van last night. I tried to interrogate 'em, but all they'd say is "We are agents of the real power in this city!" Kinda thinking goons in wizard costumes don't work for the Royal Family, sooo... looks like I got a mystery to solve. Cool."

sections.title: Part 4: Magents Again. WTH?!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Necropolis
Location: In a small crypt in the center of the Necropolis.

Investigation: Voivode: " Dude, seriously, these #$%^& Magents are getting on my last nerve! Caught 'em doing some sort of creepy magic ritual near the cemetery. I keep telling the cops about these guys, and - big surprise! - they aren't doing squat about it. Losers."

images.label: Voivode's Crime Journal - Magents Again. WTH

sections.title: Part 5: Where's D-F3NZ?!
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Town
Location: In the northeastern corner within the city wall, between the house and the city wall.

Investigation: Voivode: " No one's seen Petey - sorry, "D-F3NZ" - in like, three days. Not the local heroes, not the cops, no one. Got a bad feeling about this. We might have a serious supervillain to deal with now instead of the local idiots in funny outfits."

sections.title: Part 6: What Doodle Saw
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Location: Pretty much in the middle between the frozen lake and the cemetery at a tree.

Investigation: Voivode: " Okay, so - Doodle and her partner Crawler were on patrol last night. They found a buncha Magents face-down in an alley. Doodle was checking for pulses when Crawler heard a scream and went to check it out. Then Doodle heard him scream. When she got there all that was left of Crawler was a pile of dust. What. The. #$%^."

images.label: Voivode's Crime Journal - What Doodle Saw

sections.title: Part 7: They Got Doodle
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Lake
Location: At the south end of the frozen lake.

Investigation: Voivode: " Purple Pixie found that goofy ladybug backpack of Doodle's down by the docks... and a pile of dust nearby. Dammit, I told Doodle not to patrol by herself, but she wanted payback for what happened to Crawler. This #$%^ is serious. We need help, while there's still a we to talk about."

images.label: Voivode's Crime Journal - They Got Doodle

sections.title: Part 8: Trenchcoat Dude
items: Zone: Kaznia City
Region: Town
Location: On the terrace of the eastern most house at the southern city wall.

Investigation: Voivode: " Some British dude's been askin' questions about the killings. Jack says he's some kinda magic hero, maybe even Justice League-level. We might be getting some help with this #$%^ after all. P.S. - He's seriously got that "Hot Uncle" vibe, even though he wears that nasty-ass trenchcoat all the time. Dude, dry cleaners are a thing. Seriously."

items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Voivode, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Yeah, so... now you know a bit more about me and my life as a hero in Kaznia City. It's rough sometimes, but being able to help people makes it worth it."

title: Gotham City Organized Crime Family
summary: The Gotham City Organized Crime Family is a collection of criminal syndicates that operate within Gotham City.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Gotham City Organized Crime Family is a collection of criminal syndicates that operate within Gotham City.

As part of the Gotham Underground, the syndicates are a loose association of criminal groups. The larger of which share a common organizational structure and code of conduct. Each group claims sovereignty over a territory in which they operate their rackets.

While generally divided between the Italian, Sicilian and Russian mafias, the Gotham Families generally keep to their own territories and businesses within the city, very rarely resorting to anything beyond negotiation to settle public conflicts; although secret assassinations are also quite common. The Families also share business with groups such as the Triads, Yakuza and the Irish mob, who also operate within Gotham. At some points in the Gotham Underground's history, the entirety of the Families, mobs, groups and gangs were controlled by a single boss, known as Carmine "The Roman" Falcone.

sections.title: Involvement
items: Intent on inciting a city-wide gang war, the Joker sends various members of his streetgang to heckle both the members of the Gotham City Organized Crime Family and the Gotham City Police Department while also inciting their own chaos through the use of new robots designed by T.O. Morrow.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Matches Malone is an undercover identity used by the Batman to freely walk amongst Gotham City's underworld. He created Malone during his first year in Gotham, basing him on a real criminal and his brother, Carver Malone, who he believed were dead. However, Batman later learned the truth that Carver's death had actually been a suicide prompted by his guilt over a fire that he and Matches had started that resulted in the death of a homeless man resting in the building they had torched. Matches had made his brother look like a murder victim because he was ashamed of his brother's suicide. Subsequently deciding to fake his death to escape the Batman, Matches used the homeless man's body to stand in for his own. Batman, being so eager to establish his criminal alias, never took the time to confirm the body's identity. Returning to Gotham after hearing reports of 'his' activities, Matches was shot by Scarface, surviving long enough to confess his role in events to Batman and Nightwing before dying. Fulfilling Matches' last request to bury his body next to his brother's, Batman hunted down and destroyed Scarface in revenge for Matches' death. Batman later commented to Nightwing that he continued using Matches' identity after his death because, in the years he had spent playing Matches, he had come to recognize that Matches wasn't an evil man, but had done some bad things he never had the chance to make up for. Batman regards his use of Matches' name as a way to give Matches some absolution.

summary: Alkylating Agents is a collectible belonging to the " Chemo's Legacy" item collection.

sections.title: Overview
items: Alkylating Agents is a collectible belonging to the " Chemo's Legacy" item collection.

sections.title: Background
items: Alkylation is a chemical reaction effected by alkylating agents that entails the transfer of an alkyl group. The types of agents are:
Nitrogen mustard HN3 is used in chemotherapy.
Derivatives of Aziridine (C2H5N), a C2H5 highly flammable and toxic compound.
Epoxides are types of highly reactive cyclic ethers, most of them being highly toxic.
Alkyl sulfonates are esters (derived from an acid), some of them (e.g., Busulfan) are used in chemotherapy.
Alkylating agents were found in Blüdhaven after the Secret Society of Super-Villains detonated Chemo, a sentient being made of chemical compounds, in the city.

sections.title: Overview
items: DNA Crosslinkers is a collectible belonging to the " Chemo's Legacy" item collection.

sections.title: Background
items: DNA crosslinkers are chemical agents that react with two nucleotides of DNA, forming a covalent linkage between them. That linkage interferes with cellular processes such as DNA replication and transcription, killing the cell, but they can be used in cancer treatments by targeting cancerous cells. Crosslink is reversible with proper treatment.
DNA crosslinkers were found in Blüdhaven after the Secret Society of Super-Villains detonated Chemo, a sentient being made of chemical compounds, in the city.

sections.title: Background
items: Hydroxylamine (NH20H) is an inorganic compound which presents itself in the form of colorless crystals. Hydroxylamine was found in Blüdhaven after the Secret Society of Super-Villains detonated Chemo, a sentient being made of chemical compounds, in the city.

title: Ionizing Materials
summary: Ionizing Materials is a collectible belonging to the " Chemo's Legacy" item collection.

sections.title: Overview
items: Ionizing Materials is a collectible belonging to the " Chemo's Legacy" item collection.

sections.title: Background
items: Ionizing materials are materials that generate radiation through nuclear reaction or decay, very high temperature, or acceleration of charged particles in electromagnetic fields. In real life, adverse effects of radiation exposure include death or malfunction of cells, mutations and cancer. In the super-hero genre, radiation is also known for grating superpowers - radiation from yellow stars grants powers to Kryptonians, a nuclear accident allowed anti-nuclear activist Ronnie Raymond and physicist Martin Stein to fuse together and become the "nuclear man" Firestorm, Nathaniel Adam participated in an experiment that involved radiation and became Captain Atom.
Ionizing materials were found in Blüdhaven after the Secret Society of Super-Villains detonated Chemo, a sentient being made of chemical compounds, in the city.

items: North Gotham Demonz Gang Patch is a collectible belonging to the " No Man's Land" item collection. It can be looted from the Collection nodes found throughout Gotham City.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Possibly basing their looks off of Nicholas Scratch, a pivotol supporter of the NML edict, during the year Gotham City was declared a "No Man's Land" by the U.S. Government, the Demonz occupied the northern Gotham districts before Batman established himself within the anarchiac city and conquered their territory to create his own.
In the comics, the Street Demonz actually occupied a small fiefdom in South Gotham. Constantly feuding with the Lo Boyz gang the two groups were eventually conquered by the GCPD.

sections.title: Background
items: Oxidative molecules are the products of aerobic metabolism of the body of an aerobic organism. Reactive Oxygen Species (highly reactive chemicals formed from diatomic oxygen, water, and hydrogen peroxide) in excessive amounts can cause oxidative damage, and that oxidation can lead to mutations and cancer.
Oxidative molecules were found in Blüdhaven after the Secret Society of Super-Villains detonated Chemo, a sentient being made of chemical compounds, in the city.

title: Starro Crossed Lovers (Briefings)
summary: Starro Crossed Lovers is a briefing that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone and the Stemming the Tide challenge of the Deluge epsiode. There are 6 parts to this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Starro Crossed Lovers is a briefing that can be found in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone and the Stemming the Tide challenge of the Deluge epsiode. There are 6 parts to this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: A collection of phone messages that pose a question, "Can love really conquer all? Even Starro the Conqueror?"

sections.title: Part 1: Missed Call (1)
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: At the tall building next to the S.T.A.R. Labs outpost, on the street leading to the Combines Arena.

Briefing: Iris West Allen:" Barry? It's Iris. It's happening again... Those starfish are back in the city. I'm working from the scene today but I want to make sure you and Bart are OK out there. Now would be a good time to get Clark and the rest of the gang together. It looks bad out here."

sections.title: Part 2: Missed Call (2)
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Region: Flash Museum
Location: At the bottom of the eastern stairs.

Briefing: Barry Allen:" Iris, it's Barry. I'm a little tied up here at the moment, dear. What are the odds of another Starro attack, huh? Unfortunately, the Justice League is still dealing with the fallout from the Anti-Monitor attack and our trip to that other Earth. I'll keep an eye on Bart. You go win a Pulitzer. Love ya."

sections.title: Part 3: Missed Call (3)
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Location: Under the tallest building next to the LexCorp outpost, on the side facing the market.

Briefing: Iris West Allen:" Barry, it's me again, I missed your call. I know you're busy and all, but you are the fastest man alive. Maybe run by the S.T.A.R. Labs research post? I could use a quote and a "Flash Fact" to make me feel better about a Starro/ Atlantean invasion. Have you spoken to Arthur about it? It's not looking great for him and Mera. Love you, speedy."

sections.title: Part 4: Missed Call (4)
items: Zone: Central City Police Station
Region: Evidence Room
Instance: Stemming the Tide
Location:

Briefing: Barry Allen:" Hey Iris, things are hitting the fan at superspeed out here. Arthur is missing, the JSA aren't responding to distress calls, Starro is attacking CCPD, and I haven't heard from Bart in hours. And the way that kid sends texts, it might be as well be years. Don't worry your beautiful head about it. I'm on the case and I'm watching your broadcast as I speak. Love you much."

sections.title: Part 5: Missed Call (5)
items: Zone: Central City Police Station
Region: Holding Cells
Instance: Stemming the Tide

Location: For this node to appear you need to finish the first part of the challenge. The node will appear in the farthest cell after Mera/Ocean Master appears and you need to visit it before you go on through the portal.
Briefing: Iris West Allen:" Barry? Thank goodness I finally got in touch with you! We just got a report that Bart's been possessed! You have to help him! Barry? Are you listening to me?! Barry?"
Controlled Flash:" YOU CANNOT STOP ME. I AM LEGION..."
Iris West Allen:" Aiiieee!"

sections.title: Part 6: Missed Call (6)
items: Zone: Central City Starro Deluge Zone
Region: Riverside District
Location: Under the Lounge/Hotel west of Mera's dome. Southwest corner of the building.

Briefing: Barry Allen:" Iris, it's Barry. I'm OK. We stopped Starro at the police station, but not before whoever was behind this charade stuck a starfish on my face and freed half the Rogues Gallery. I'm fine now though, thanks to my new partner. Hopefully this is a regular thing... I want to make Ollie and Hal jealous. I'm going after Bart now...I love you and I won't let him down."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from The Flash or Professor Zoom, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Boy, am I glad you intercepted these messages between these completely random people... It breaks my heart to see the folks of Central City suffer like this!"

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I don't know if you're enjoying Central City's suffering at the hands of Starfish and Atlanteans as much as I am. I'll relish Iris Allen's pain for as long as I can."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with the Tentacled Barnacles (Ceiling) base item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Part 2 refers to the content released prior to the Deluge episode in March 2018:; The Justice League traveled to Earth 3 in the Earth 3 episode, released in November 2017.; In January 2018, the Anti-Monitor invasion event was in its second year, featuring a new mission called A World Past Hope And Fear, serving as a followup to the Earth 3 episode.; Part of the content for Deluge was originally from the Starro the Conqueror event, which had ran only once a year prior to the release of the episode. This infers that even if the Starro event doesn't exist anymore, its existence remains canon in the DCUO lore.
Part 3: Iris is most likely referring to the research outpost that serves as the main mission hub for heroes in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone.

Part 4:; The Justice Society got possessed by Starro; they're bosses in the Starro: Invasion! alert in the JSA Headquarters zone.; Iris' broadcastings are part of the The Starro Report investigations collections.

Part 5:; This call takes place during the first boss fight in the Stemming the Tide solo instance.; Iris got the report about Bart in The Starro Report: Part 3. He can be found in some spots in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone, including on the roof of the Flash Museum, as part of the Fallen Stars mission.

Part 6: Oliver Queen and Hal Jordan became an iconic duo during their partnership after Oliver lost his wealth and went through an identity crisis. Green Arrow became co-protagonist in the Green Lantern comics by issue #76 (1970), a partnership that would grant them the title of "Hard Travelling Heroes." The duo was dissolved in issue #122 (1979) for editorial reasons.; In DCUO, the friendship between Hal and Oliver was first mentioned in the classic game during Hearts of Darkness: Episode 5.
Although Flash mails the heroes acting like he's not Barry Allen, the player's character should have been aware of his secret identity since the events of the Lightning Strikes episode.

title: Gods of Old (Briefings)
summary: Gods of Old is a Global Briefing that can be found while doing the instance Necropolis: Relics of Urgrund. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Halls of Power Part I episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Gods of Old is a Global Briefing that can be found while doing the instance Necropolis: Relics of Urgrund. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Halls of Power Part I episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Powerful warriors of a long-dead civilization, the Dreggs are all that remain of the Old Gods. Kalibak has been tasked to assess their strengths and weaknesses.

sections.title: Part 1: Gods of Old: Kalibak Report #1
items: Location:

Briefing: Kalibak: When the Third World was torn apart, some of the Old Gods were deemed unworthy by the Source and left behind. Those humiliated warriors are now cursed to wander the Necropolis as the Dreggs, eternally seeking personal glory.

sections.title: Part 2: Gods of Old: Kalibak Report #2
items: Location:
Briefing: Kalibak: Deep inside the ruins of Urgrund, the Dreggs are locked in eternal battle. Even if they fall in battle, they rise again, never having the honor of truly fulfilling personal combat.

sections.title: Part 3: Gods of Old: Kalibak Report #3
items: Location:

Briefing: Kalibak: When Darkseid learned that relics of the Old Gods were discovered in the Necropolis, he acted immediately. He unleashed his greatest warrior, Kalibak, to recover them. Oh...and Mantis too. These artifacts could unlock limitless power! I am sure Father will know what to do with them.

sections.title: Part 4: Gods of Old: Kalibak Report #4
items: Location:

Briefing: Kalibak: The Old Gods are mere echos of their former glory, but still not as weak as mortals. They do however present an entertaining challenge to Kalibak, the son of Darkseid and the mightiest of Apokolips!

title: Meet the New Gods (Investigations)
summary: Meet the New Gods is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across locations in the On Duty instances that are part the Halls of Power Part I episode. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Meet the New Gods is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across locations in the On Duty instances that are part the Halls of Power Part I episode. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: A cosmic community divided by an interstellar war between good and evil, the New Gods have come to Earth seeking allies.

sections.title: Part 1: Mister Miracle's Dossier
items: Zone: League Hall
Region: Entrance Hall
Instance: Artifacts from the Past
Location: By a wall in the teleporters area.

Investigation: Big Barda: " They say nobody escapes from Apokolips, but "they" are fools or liars. Scott Free was tortured like the rest of us, trained to become a mindless soldier, but he never gave in. With my help, he escaped that mad world and came to Earth, where he took up the mantle of Mister Miracle, the World's Greatest Escape Artist. It wasn't long before I followed him to Earth and joined his act."

sections.title: Part 2: Big Barda Dossier
items: Zone: League Hall
Region: Storage Facility
Instance: League Hall: Security Breach
Location: By the doorway to the west.

Investigation: Big Barda: " I am Big Barda, former elite officer of Apokolips, trained by Granny Goodness to lead the Female Furies. Until I met Scott Free, I indulged in that life of pain and struggle. From Scott, I learned what Granny could never teach me...how to have hope."

sections.title: Part 3: Mother Box Dossier
items: Zone: Necropolis
Region: First boss arena
Instance: Necropolis: Relics of Urgrund
Location: In the area where you fight Fierce Hjorgunnr, on a metallic structure to the south.

Investigation: Big Barda: " It is difficult to describe a Mother Box to outsiders, but I will try. They are living miniature supercomputers used by us New Gods. They have many purposes, including opening Boom Tubes for instant travel across cosmic distances, healing the injured, manipulating energy, and rearranging matter. It is not unlike your planet's... smartphone? Just a whole lot better."

sections.title: Part 4: Kalibak Dossier
items: Zone: League Hall
Instance: League Hall: Lockdown
Location: In front of the statues in front of the entrance to the Central Hub

Investigation: Big Barda: " "Kalibak The Cruel," as he calls himself, is the disappointing son of Darkseid and his second-in-command. While I cannot disparage his voracity in battle, I challenge his wit. Does he really believe he will ever truly please his father? Or will he continue to swing his Beta-Club wildly at his foes, like an unloved child of Apokolips?"

sections.title: Part 5: Mantis Dossier
items: Zone: League Hall
Region: Entrance Hall
Instance: League Hall: Security Breach
Location: In the staircase to the North leading to the Observation Room

Investigation: Big Barda: " Once the Prime One of the Insect Empire on New Genesis, Mantis abandoned his people and traded his loyalty to Darkseid in exchange for great power. He's an energy vampire, which means he can absorb energy and use it against his foes. But I don't mind. I'd rather just pound him with my Mega-Rod anyway."

sections.title: Part 6: Chang Tzu Dossier
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Chang Tzu's Personal Lab
Instance: Intergang Crime Wave
Location: Inside a tower on the roof of the building.

Investigation: Big Barda: " Chang Tzu is the rotten result of Apokoliptian technology. That hard-boiled hack has been a menace to the people of Earth for decades! His scientists on Oolong Island create weapons that could rival even the New Gods, and he's putting them in the hands of Intergang. Boy, I'd love to fry THAT egg."

title: Mister Miracle's History of Urgrund (Briefings)
summary: Mister Miracle's History of Urgrund is a Global Briefing that can be found while doing the instances Intergang Crime Wave, League Hall: Security Breach, Artifacts from the Past and League Hall: Lockdown. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Halls of Power Part I episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mister Miracle's History of Urgrund is a Global Briefing that can be found while doing the instances Intergang Crime Wave, League Hall: Security Breach, Artifacts from the Past and League Hall: Lockdown. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Halls of Power Part I episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Eons ago, Urgrund was home to the Old Gods. Mister Miracle will reveal their ultimate fate and the fate of their world.

sections.title: Part 1: The First World
items: Zone: Metropolis
Region: Underground Vault
Instance: Intergang Crime Wave
Location: Up above the entrance

Briefing: Mister Miracle: When the universe was born, the First World, Urgrund came shortly after. Cosmically speaking. This world developed not far from the Source Wall, and would be greatly affected by its cosmic neighbor.

sections.title: Part 2: The Second World
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Oolong Beach
Instance: Intergang Crime Wave
Location: On top of the tower of the main building at the harbor

Briefing: Mister Miracle: Once sentient beings began to walk upon its soil, the Second World had begun. Exposed to the power of the Source, these beings grew in strength and intelligence, and became the forefathers of the Old Gods.

sections.title: Part 3: Ragnarok
items: Zone: League Hall
Region: Command Center
Instance: League Hall: Security Breach
Location:

sections.title: Part 1: Science Island's Multiversal Warning
items: Zone: Patchwork Themyscira

Investigation: Unknown: " This message comes to you from a Themyscira that hasn't merged with yours. The breaking of the Source Wall has turned our Multiverse Mass Spectrometer into more of a kaleidoscope toy than a scientific tool. Sadly, our calculations show that by the time our Science Island merges with the main bulk of Themysciras, any assistance we could lend would be too little too late. sections.title: Overview
items: A House Divided is a global briefing that can be found in the two stages of the Brainiac's Bottle Ship operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Episode 23.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Kandor is within Zod's grasp and Superman wants to stop him. This puts Supergirl in the middle, what will she do?"

sections.title: Part 1: Zod's Promise
items: Zone: The Science Spire
Instance: Brainiac's Bottle Ship
Location: In the safezone, behind one of the statis chambers.

Briefing: General Zod: " If this earthling, Lois Lane, thinks she can keep Kandor's location a secret from me, then she is gravely mistaken. This so called "Science Spire" houses a devastating weapon and I am prepared to use it to secure the release of my people from Brainiac's clutches."

sections.title: Part 2: Coexistence
items: Zone: The Science Spire
Instance: Brainiac's Bottle Ship
Location: Upper floor, behind the pillar to the northern wall.

Briefing: Superman: " Personal Log: I know Zod wants to bring back Krypton. While that desire is hard to resist, there are just too many unknowns. I want the other Kryptonians to love Earth as much as I do and live in harmony here. But I know Zod, and his intentions are never to exist peacefully with the people of Earth."

sections.title: Part 3: Remembering Kandor
items: Zone: Brainiac's Bottle Ship
Instance: Brainiac Bottle Ship
Location:

Briefing: Supergirl: " As suggested by Kal, I'm creating my own log. Here it goes... Kandor was a beautiful and inspiring city. It is said that it was so famous that other planets named their great cities "Kandor" as well. I used to remember it clearly, but after each day passes, it becomes more hazy. Every fiber of my being wants to find Kandor in that Brainiac ship...but Kal says it's dangerous. I mean, duh, Kal! I have to save it!"

sections.title: Part 4: Spirit of Krypton
items: Zone: Brainiac's Bottle Ship
Instance: Brainiac Bottle Ship
Location:

Briefing: Supergirl: " Do you remember Kandor, Kal? It was a beautiful city, the pride of Krypton. It was my home. I know you've made Earth your home, but sometimes I still feel like an outsider. I mean, maybe Zod isn't totally wrong. Maybe we could restore Krypton's spirit by restoring it's capital, Kandor. Kal...my parents are in there...'"

sections.title: Part 5: Acquiring an Asset
items: Zone: Brainiac's Bottle Ship
Instance: Brainiac Bottle Ship
Location:

Briefing: General Zod: " Long before Brainiac attacked Earth, he took Kandor from Krypton. He is the only thing that stands in the way of our plan to restore Krypton's legacy on Earth. Brainiac is formidable, however, and we need to enlist help. Hm, I knew Alura Zor-El quite well in Krypton, perhaps I can use that to persuade her daughter, Kara."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Supergirl, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " How did these get left behind? Thanks for retrieving them. These only show a glimpse of the struggle Kal and I face, but we will always do what's right for our people, and what is right for the people of Earth."

sections.title: Item
items: This collection rewards the player with the Kryptonian Militia Belt waist item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Zod referres to Alura as "Alura Zor-El", but her name in the comics is Alura In-Ze. Zor-El is her husband's name.; Children of Krypton's Shadows Over Argo chapter refer to Alura as Alura In-Ze.

Supergirl's birthplace is Argo City, not Kandor as the briefings seem to imply. That change seem to have been made in order to simplify a few aspects of Superman: Brainiac, the story adapted into the storyline that consists of the On Duty missions Phantom Zone, Science Spire, Brainiac's Bottle Ship, and Kandor Central Tower.; This aspect was "soft rebooted" with the Children of Krypton story arc.

summary: Ace Chemicals is a global briefing comprised in six parts accessible during the Ace Chemicals alert.

sections.title: Overview
items: Ace Chemicals is a global briefing comprised in six parts accessible during the Ace Chemicals alert.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: T.O. Morrow has gone mad with power and chemicals in the depths of Ace Chemicals!

sections.title: Part 1: Ace Chemicals: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Ace Chemicals
Region: Ace Chemical Processing Plant
Instance: Ace Chemicals
Location: In the area right after the safezone, in a corner behind a pipe and some crates.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale at Gotham Now!, on one of Gotham's most notorious landmarks - Ace Chemicals. Long ago declared toxic and marked for demolition, Ace Chemicals still stands due to a lack of funds in the city budget. Here at Gotham Now!, we've heard rumors that the Joker has mysterious connections to these contaminated grounds - but what, exactly, has never come to light."

sections.title: Part 2: Ace Chemicals: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Ace Chemicals
Region: Process Control Room
Instance: Ace Chemicals
Location: On the ventilation pipes above the Storage Unit door.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale at Gotham Now! The notorious mad scientist T.O. Morrow is reportedly at large in Gotham, based on an anonymous phone call placed to the GCPD. Commissioner Gordon declined to comment, but sources hint that the caller was the Joker - claiming that Morrow had hijacked his property. Crank call, or call for help? More as it comes on Gotham Now!"

sections.title: Part 3: Ace Chemicals: Batman
items: Zone: Ace Chemicals
Region: Batch Reactor Unit
Instance: Ace Chemicals
Location: On the top of a Small Reactor Lab Vat, right before the Sludge Disposal.

Briefing: Batman:" This is Batman. If you can hear me, take care. Morrow is still inside Ace Chemicals for a reason. His new toxin must be distilling into yet another form. Try to sabotage the process, if you can."

sections.title: Part 4: Ace Chemicals: Joker
items: Zone: Ace Chemicals
Region: Ace Chemical Processing Plant
Instance: Ace Chemicals
Location: Under the pipes under the stairs leading to the Storage Unit.
Briefing: Joker:" Morrow, you foul beast! This isn't funny! Get out of my lab! If you've ruined the ass groove in my favorite chair, you are a DEAD MAN!"

sections.title: Part 5: Ace Chemicals: Batman
items: Zone: Ace Chemicals
Region: Distillation Unit
Instance: Ace Chemicals
Location: Downstairs, next to the Short Reactor Lab Vat on the upper level.

Briefing: Batman:" This is Batman. Readings indicate a high level of chemo-centric radiation. Morrow must have obtained some of the chemoid material from Bludhaven. That means some of his toxin will actually be sentient - almost alive. It MUST be destroyed."

sections.title: Part 6: Ace Chemicals: Joker
items: Zone: Ace Chemicals
Region: Storage Unit
Instance: Ace Chemicals
Location: Behind the largest Short Reactor Lab Vat in the hallway.

Briefing: Joker:" Morrow, you better hope the chemical key you created to keep me out works - because if you're still in there when I get in, I'M EATING YOUR LIVER RAW WITH FAVA BEANS! Do you hear me?!"

Briefing: Batwoman:" A.R.G.U.S. recently came into possession of the Crime Bible and they're holding it at their HQ. items: Zone: Chaos Gotham

Briefing: Batwoman:" I don't know what could be so dire to Batman that he thinks it's a bigger threat than an elder god floating over Gotham; Whatever he's off investigating, he's not sharing any info with the rest of us. I hope it's worth it."

Briefing: Batwoman:" The Lords of Order think they have all the answers to Gotham's magic problem, but what they have to remember is that Gotham's never been a beacon of Order. I hope for all our sakes they're not as smug as they seem."

items: Behind the Wall is a collection of Investigations that can be found within the Alert Stryker's Island Penitentiary. There are 8 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The villainous inhabitants of Stryker's Island are some of the most dangerous, malicious threats the world has ever known. Information on past and present offenders might shed light on the daily operations of the prison.

sections.title: Part 1: Prisoner File on Barbara Minerva
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location:
Investigation: Announcer: "Inmate File - Barbara Minerva: Extreme violence and speed, should always be restrained using metagenetic-dampening leg cuffs and isolated from male pop."

sections.title: Part 2: Prisoner File on Winslow Schott
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location:
Investigation: Announcer: "Inmate File - Winslow Schott: Allowed access to prison library. Physical media only, no computer access."

sections.title: Part 3: Prisoner File on Rudy Jones
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location:
Investigation: Announcer: "Inmate File - Rudy Jones: All staff members are required to wear energy-reflective suits when interacting with this prisoner."

sections.title: Part 4: Prisoner File on Mark Mardon
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location:
Investigation: Announcer: "Inmate File - Mark Mardon: Disallow conductive material within 50 yards of the prisoner and ensure proper drainage is enabled for cell block."

sections.title: Part 5: Prisoner File on Evan McCulloh
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location:
Investigation: Announcer: "Inmate File - Evan McCulloh: Low-risk prisoner. Restricted materials: Reflective surfaces, prisms."

sections.title: Part 6: Prisoner File on Leonard Snart
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location:

sections.title: Part 7: Prisoner File on Mick Rory
items: Zone: Metropolis

Location:

sections.title: Part 8: Prisoner File on John Corben

title: Bludhaven (Briefings)
summary: Briefing: Bludhaven is a collection of Briefings that can be found scattered across the chemically torn Blüdhaven Alert Zone, accessible from a player's On Duty Menu upon achieving level 23.

sections.title: Overview
items: Briefing: Bludhaven is a collection of Briefings that can be found scattered across the chemically torn Blüdhaven Alert Zone, accessible from a player's On Duty Menu upon achieving level 23.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The remains of Chemo must be salvaged from the smoking ruin of Bludhaven!

sections.title: Bludhaven: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Blüdhaven
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane and Daily Planet Live with breaking news. The Secret Society has detonated the massive nuclear chemical life form Chemo in Bludhaven! Chemo, a sentient mass of radioactive acid, was brought to life in a misguided attempt to create a biomass growth that could feed the world. Now a walking vessel of death, Chemo itself remains at large in Bludhaven."

sections.title: Bludhaven: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Blüdhaven
Location:

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" Waller to Sarge Steel. I'm sending in Major Force for the Suicide Squad. We can't leave a weapon like Chemo in the Society's hands unchallenged. Especially now that he's, ah, reproducing himself. We need samples - for the public safety. I'm sure you don't disagree. Waller out."

sections.title: Bludhaven: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Blüdhaven
Location:

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" This is Amanda Waller to Major Force. Contact me immediately with results or face the consequences. Don't forget, we have all your files. We know everything about you. Failure to gain the Chemoid samples is not acceptable - it's called the Suicide Squad for a reason. Waller out."

sections.title: Bludhaven: Booster Gold
items: Zone: Blüdhaven
Location:

Briefing: Booster Gold:" Hi, I'm Booster Gold, and when I'm not out encouraging people to drink Soder Cola, I like to spend my time in beautiful Bludhaven! Walk along the scenic beaches; visit the historic whaling port; and take part in the festive nightlife all while you bask in the mysterious glow! Take it from Booster Gold, there's nowhere else like it anywhere on Earth."

sections.title: Bludhaven: Joker
items: Zone: Blüdhaven
Location:

Briefing: Joker:" Hello? Hello? This is the Joker talking! Say something!... Why, it seems that I've been disconnected! *mock-innocently* Could something... bad have happened in Bludhaven? I don't supposed the Society decided to destroy an entire city and not invite me?! Harley - call Talia -- what? The Suicide Squad? -- you don't saaaay. Goodbye, I have to kill someone, hanging up now..."

sections.title: Bludhaven: Batman
items: Zone: Blüdhaven
Location:

Briefing: Batman:" This is Batman. I've hacked the discarded Bludhaven Police frequency. If you're receiving this signal, be on your guard. We know the Secret Society detonated Chemo on the city - but we're seeing activity from the Suicide Squad. That means Amanda Waller and her agenda are involved. And that's not good... for anyone."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Amanda Waller accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Coded Transmission Follows: Always frustrating when a good asset turns on you. You don't want to find out what I do to good assets that go bad. Waller out."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with the Ace Chemicals Hoodie chest style item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This briefing refers to the city as Bludhaven instead of Blüdhaven.

title: Call Me Kaldur (Investigations)
summary: Call Me Kaldur is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across the Atlantis open world, Atlantis: The Silent School Alert, and Atlantis: The Throne Raid as part of the Atlantis episode. There are 7 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Call Me Kaldur is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across the Atlantis open world, Atlantis: The Silent School Alert, and Atlantis: The Throne Raid as part of the Atlantis episode. There are 7 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The Teen Titans' newest recruit is learning the ropes the hard way. These Titan confessionals paint a clearer picture of the current Aqualad.

sections.title: Part 1: Titan Confessional 1
items: Zone: Atlantis
Region: (open world)

Location: Western half of the map, at the roof of a tower-like building located where The Drift keeps the Ninth Tride Atlanteans in cages ( Catch of the Day mission area). Look for a statue of Poseidon on the roofs near the southeast corner of the map; the tower is located after the 2 two bridges in front of it.

Investigation: Aqualad: " So where do I start? My name is Jackson. Jackson Hyde. I was recruited for the Teen Titans about a week ago; right after Cyborg got the call to join the Justice League. I've never done one of these confessionals before but Starfire said that they help get things off our chest. To be honest, I wasn't even a superhero a couple of weeks ago. I was just a kid living in the most boring, driest place in America."

sections.title: Part 2: Titan Confessional 2
items: Zone: Atlantis
Region: Drift Camp

Location: Eastern half of the map, by one of the areas for the Loss of Leadership mission, the one by the Atlantis Statue - Tribute. Follow the bridge in front of the statue to the other side, and you should see the node on one of the domes.

Investigation: Aqualad: " As far as my family goes, I never really knew my father. He was gone long before I can remember. It's always just been me and my mom. Mom told me once that we moved around a lot before we settled down in Silver City, New Mexico. Talk about vague, huh? I guess you could say that most of my past is one big mystery to me."

sections.title: Part 3: Titan Confessional 3
items: Zone: Atlantis
Region: (open world)

Location: Go to the Eastern portion of the map and look for the Atlantis Statue - Tribute on the roofs. Follow the direction in which its back is turned to until you get to a bridge; the node is at the edge ahead.

Alternatively, follow the instructions: from King Shark, follow the path to East until you get to the Ninth Tride area (the one with the kill-nets). Turn left and follow the path until you find the first bridge outside of the Ninth. The node is on the edge of that bridge.

Investigation: Aqualad: " So my mom and I are pretty tight. She's always been there for me. This makes it even harder when she isn't in my corner about something. I was straight up afraid today when I told her about having superpowers and joining the Titans. [laugh] Believe it or not, she wasn't even a little bit surprised. I wish I could say the same when I told her I had a boyfriend."

sections.title: Part 4: Titan Confessional 4
items: Zone: Silent School
Instance: Atlantis: The Silent School
Location: In the first hall to the right at a bookshelf.

Investigation: Aqualad: " OK. Things just got real over here. I get a call from my mom at the Tower saying that she needs to talk. When we meet up, she blows my mind. Turns out, she isn't even from here! Neither am I! I'm an Atlantean and an Aquamancer."

sections.title: Part 5: Titan Confessional 5
items: Zone: Atlantis
Region: (open world)

Location: Follow the instructions from Part 2, then stop above the yellow dome. Turn left and swim above the 2 water domes and past the tower after them (always going southeast). The node is on the bridge connected to the building with the yellow dome ahead.

Investigation: Aqualad: " Mom has been filling me in with details this past week. I found out I was born in a penal colony of Atlantis called Xebel. My real name is Kaldur and she's been hiding me from my dad for years. Turns out, my father is the villain Black Manta. So this is me, still trying to process that mic drop, while my mom leads me to my first visit to Atlantis! [laughs]"

sections.title: Part 6: Titan Confessional 6
items: Zone: Atlantis
Region: King Shark's Turf

Location: Step on the teleporter to the Royal Hideout, then turn towards the Sea-Touched Atlanteans - beyond them there are a small and a large tower, both with water domes. The node is between the two on the ground.

Investigation: Aqualad: " It's amazing knowing Atlantis is my home. This trip there, my mom introduced me to Queen Mera and King Orin. You know, Aquaman?! Can you believe Mera is from Xebel and she's an Aquamancer, too. I get the feeling neither of them is fond of my dad, though."

sections.title: Part 7: Titan Confessional 7
items: Zone: Atlantis Throne Room
Instance: Atlantis: The Throne
Location: In the first little hall on the way to the first boss fight, on the back of the first middle wall between two plant beds

Investigation: Aqualad: " I just received an emergency message from Mera asking me to come to Atlantis immediately. She says that the Elders turned on Aquaman. That they took away his throne and gave it to some tyrant named Rath. My heart dropped when Mera said Aquaman was dead. That Murk killed him as they tried to escape the palace. I've got to go... Aqualad out."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Robin, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Thank you for collecting these private confessionals. This Aqualad is a formidable addition to the Titans roster, though I question his ties to sovereign nations such as Atlantis."

sections.title: Item
items: This collection rewards the player with the Crown of Thorns Visage face style item (style: Crown of Thorns).

sections.title: Trivia
items: Part 1 refers to the events of the Teen Titans: The Judas Contract episode.
Part 5: Aqualad's full name is Kaldur'ahm.
Part 7 refers to the events of the Atlantis: Royal Palace challenge.

title: Conversion (Briefings)
summary: Conversion is an episode briefing that can be found in South Gotham open world locations, the Gotham Hospital, Riverfront Center and Riverside Hotel duos as well as the South Gotham Courthouse alert. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the The Battle for Earth episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Conversion is an episode briefing that can be found in South Gotham open world locations, the Gotham Hospital, Riverfront Center and Riverside Hotel duos as well as the South Gotham Courthouse alert. There are nine parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the The Battle for Earth episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The increased Brainiac activity in South Gotham has greatly altered the historic locale and its people. Perhaps there is more to the story; collect any information you can find in the area.

sections.title: Part 1: Conversion: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Location: On the north-east rooftop corner of the bottled Gotham Hospital.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale on location in South Gotham for a special edition of Gotham Now. I am standing near what was once a premier shopping strip. Exquisite jewelry, custom-made furniture and high fashion used to line these store fronts. Today these venues are encased inside massive forcefields or, as the locals call them, bottles. Excuse me, sir. May I ask you what keeps you in the area? -- All will become one with Brainiac. -- What? Wait? Where are you taking me? Ahh..."

sections.title: Part 2: Conversion: Batman/Oracle
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Location: On the roof of an unbottled three-storey building east of Gotham Hospital and north of Gotham City Hall between to larger air outlets.

Briefing: Batman/ Oracle:" Batman to Oracle -- Go for Oracle -- I have been tracking some of these converted citizens in South Gotham. It seems Brainiac's Union is some kind of workforce, building Sub-Avatars with the intend to attack the rest of the city. I'm gonna need backup."

sections.title: Part 3: Conversion: Seismologist
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Location: Just south of Gotham City Hall in a trench on the street.

Briefing: Seismologist Dr. Archer:" Seismic Investigation Log - Entry 22B. This is Doctor Archer. We've been conducting various geophysical scans of the surface and sub-surface in South Gotham. The university sent our team here to investigate recent seismic activity reported by regional seismometers. My assistant has been running magnetotelluric scans, but the imaging data can't possibly be correct. There's no way those kinds of electromagnetic readings could be found beneath Gotham. I can only guess it has something to do with Brainiac."

sections.title: Part 4: Conversion: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Location: At the south-west corner of the bottled Gotham Hospital in a trench near a Sub-Avatar building point.

Briefing: Lex Luthor:" No, you listen to me, Commissioner! This is a free country. You can't keep me from doing business in your little cesspool of a city! Besides I think Wayne Enterprises could use a little... philanthropic assistance in the wake of the Brainiac Attacks. Have you *seen* South Gotham lately?"

sections.title: Part 5: Conversion: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Instance: Riverfront Center
Location: On the building to the West, up on a roof level ledge to the South.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane with an emergency report on location at the site of Brainiac's latest attacks. The activity in South Gotham is unlike any we've seen before. When my colleagues and I were trapped inside the Daily Planet, Brainiac's forces wanted information. However, it seems these Brainiac invaders are targeting the populace. They're abducting civilians and bringing them inside the bottles... and I swear some of them... almost look like people..."

sections.title: Part 6: Conversion: Brainiac
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Instance: Gotham Hospital
Location: At the Northeast corner of the cathedral-like building, mid-level.

Briefing: Brainiac:" Attention drones. You serve Brainiac well. Go. Convert more to the will of Brainiac. Scan all citizens for Exobyte data and mark these targets as priority one. Return them to me for Exobyte extraction. It is unfortunate that extraction will render their biological matter useless for complete conversion. Dispose of the remainder."

sections.title: Part 7: Conversion: Vicki Vale/Batman
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Instance: Riverside Hotel
Location: At the east side of the map - left of the entrance - under some Coluan cables.

Briefing: Vicki Vale/ Batman:" This is Vicki Vale... from inside one of the bottles... They've put me in some kind of... holding cell. I think they're planning to convert us into - oh god... here they come. Let go of me! Where are you taking me? You're going to make me one of you, aren't you!? This may be my last sign off... -- Get way from her! -- Batman! Help! -- That should slow them down. Let's get out of here! -- Wait! Let me get my recorder!"

sections.title: Part 8: Conversion: Prosecutor
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Instance: South Gotham Courthouse
Location: On the east side of the building near the wall where the stairs lead to.

Briefing: The Prosecutor:" If anyone outside gets this message, there's still quite few of us trapped inside the Courthouse. It's been a rough few days, but the Judge is trying to keep order. I'm sure well be fine if you can get to us soon."

sections.title: Part 9: Conversion: Prosecutor/Supreme Justice
items: Zone: Gotham City
Region: South Gotham
Instance: South Gotham Courthouse
Location: On top of the courthouse dome (east side) near a Coluan cable.

Briefing: The Prosecutor/ The Supreme Justice:" Oh god... Is there anyone out there? Anyone?! Please, please get these messages! Everything's out of control! The judge has lost his mind!. I don't know how much longer we can.. -- Guilty on all charges! -- Nooo! Your honor! -- All will become one with Brainiac or face the charges!"

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Batman or Lex Luthor, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " This information about the Brainiac conversion activity in South Gotham will help me analyze the situation. You did well bringing it to my attention."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Excellent. This information about the conversion activity in South Gotham will prove useful for my research. All academic of course. Good work."

sections.title: Item
items: This briefing rewards the player with the Classic Duster chest item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The South Gotham Courthouse alert briefings are available in the Legends PvP instance too.

title: Darkseid, Terror of the Universe (Investigations)
summary: Darkseid, Terror of the Universe is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across the Darkseid's War Factory raid. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Darkseid, Terror of the Universe is a collection of Investigations that can be found scattered across the Darkseid's War Factory raid. There are 6 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Darkseid's plan to tap into the Source is all but complete. These logs detail his power, and the cautious alliance that must be formed to stop him.

sections.title: Part 1: Lord of Apokolips
items: Zone: ( Apokolips)
Region: Darkseid's War Factory
Location: In the room of the first fight on top of the central pillar

Investigation: Superman: " Darkseid is a threat to every living being in the universe. He rules his world of Apokolips with an iron first, and has destroyed countless other worlds. He seeks to enslave all living things, and destroy the ones with strength to resist. Darkseid is one of the greatest enemies I have ever faced, both physically and mentally."

images.label: Darkseid -Terror of the Universe - Lord of Apokolips

sections.title: Part 2: Power of the Source
items: Zone: ( Apokolips)
Region: Darkseid's War Factory
Location: After the room with the first two bosses, at the beginning of the hallway

Investigation: Lex Luthor: " The Source is believed to have created the "New Gods". Some even say it is the reason why we have superhumans on Earth. There are those that believe it even created all life. I believe in science, and that the Source is hoarding infinite power and knowledge. Unfortunately, that power is blocked off by the Source Wall; an impenetrable force that imprisons any who dare touch it. Perhaps I can convince someone to touch it for me..."

images.label: Darkseid -Terror of the Universe - Power of the Source

sections.title: Part 3: The Anti-Life Equation
items: Zone: ( Apokolips)
Region: Darkseid's War Factory
Location: In the third room at the far wall to the right

Investigation: Lex Luthor: " While researching the Source, I came across another tool of extreme power: the Anti-Life Equation. Learning that equation is the primary goal of Darkseid, and he believes it lives in the sunconcious of humans. The Anti-Life Equation would allow Darkseid to dominate the free will of any living being... I can't let power like that end up in the hands of some alien."

images.label: Darkseid -Terror of the Universe - The Anti-Life Equation

sections.title: Part 4: Darkseid's Endgame
items: Zone: ( Apokolips)
Region: Darkseid's War Factory
Location: At the entrance to the hallway between the third and fourth room in a corner

Investigation: Superman: " Ever since Darkseid started another war against New Genesis, we've been trying to stop him from stealing Old God artifacts. We've fought hard, but it hasn't been enough. Now Darkseid has what he wants, and I'm afraid he is even closer to learning the Anti-Life Equation. Right now he's in his war factory. We have to stop him before it's too late."

images.label: Darkseid -Terror of the Universe - Darkseid's Endgame

sections.title: Part 5: Reluctant Allies
items: Zone: ( Apokolips)
Region: Darkseid's War Factory
Location: At the exit of the hallway between the third and fourth room

Investigation: Lex Luthor/ Superman: " Honestly, Superman, if I had a dollar earning compound interest for every time you came asking for my help, I could close LexCorp and retire on a beach in Tahiti. -- Lex, in this fight we are on the same side. I know you care about Earth as much as I do. We need to work together now, so we can finally take Darkseid down! Besides, your head would get sunburned in Taihiti."

images.label: Darkseid -Terror of the Universe - Reluctant Allies

sections.title: Part 6: Enemy of my Enemy
items: Zone: ( Apokolips)
Region: Darkseid's War Factory
Location: At the left end of the surrounding hallway of the fourth room

Investigation: Lex Luthor/ Superman: " So, now you're a comedian? Between you and Oracle's bad jokes, I can see why so many people are willing to work for the bad guys. As for Darkseid, you can believe I'm with you on destroying him. Just don't stand in my way. -- See you at the Apokolips, Luthor."

images.label: Darkseid -Terror of the Universe - Enemy of my Enemy

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Superman or Lex Luthor, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes
Villains

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I hope by listening to these you know how important it is to team up with Luthor. We can trust Lex to defend Earth from Darkseid, but not for much else."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Don't let these logs misrepresent my stance on Superman. He is nothing more than another alien that needs to be removed from my planet."

sections.title: Item
items: This investigation rewards the player with the Mobius Chair base item.

sections.title: Trivia
items: One of the messages includes Lex Luthor wishing to relax in Tahiti, and Superman saying he'd burn there, possibly a reference to Lex being a redhead prior to going bald and redheads burn in the sun easily.

sections.title: Overview
items: Meta Clinic ID

Deal with DeSaad is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across locations in Dakota City, the Shock: Meta-Therapy Clinic alert and the Shock: The Terrorium raid, as part of the Shock to the System episode. There are 8 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: The Pact is sealed.

sections.title: Part 1: Terrorium's Touch
items: Zone: Shock: The Terrorium
Region: The Terrorium
Location: In the far right corner of the cube you start out in.
Investigation: DeSaad: " The Terrorium draws on surface fears, but I can always apply a personal touch. Let us explore every element of your fear. Oh, Mother Box..."

sections.title: Part 2: Catalogue of Pain
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: In the center block of the park south of the highway, to the east at a tree.
Investigation: DeSaad: " Now that is an interesting power combination. Tell me, is it painful? Mmm, let us start a catalogue."

images.label: Deal with DeSaad - Catalogue of Pain

sections.title: Part 3: Unique Suffering
items: Zone: Shock: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Region: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Location: In the last room to the northeast facing the elevators before you go down the shaft.
Investigation: DeSaad: " Such unique and exquisite suffering. How pleasing... for Darkseid, of course."

sections.title: Part 4: Body of Data Horror
items: Zone: Shock: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Region: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Location: After you head down the elevator shaft in the last cell all the way at the end of the hall to the south.
Investigation: DeSaad: " I will set the metrics in flesh, wring the data from blood, and tally the results in bones!"

images.label: Deal with DeSaad - Body of Data Horror

sections.title: Part 5: Residual Horrors
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: In the tunnel north of the area where you fight the Fearsome Five.
Investigation: DeSaad: " Note to self: The site that created the Bang Babies still has some fascinating residual energy. What new horrors can I create from its manipulation? We shall see..."

sections.title: Part 6: Ebon's Guarantees
items: Zone: Shock: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Region: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Location: Southeast wall of the office room after passing through the first block of cells.
Investigation: Ebon: " Yo, Major Force, I know every shadow of Dakota. So as long as I see those zeroes hit my account, you got my word on no escapes."

sections.title: Part 7: Bean Counting
items: Zone: Shock: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Region: Meta-Therapy Clinic
Location: North of the exit to the zone after defeating Major Force.
Investigation: Major Force: " Let the bean-counters handle the money DeSaad; I just want those freaks to suffer!"

sections.title: Part 8: Do the Job
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: In the small fenced park west of the football field where Jinx appears, behind a tree.
Investigation: Psimon: " Are you certain about taking this job, Doctor Light? That alien makes even my skin crawl."

images.label: Deal with DeSaad - Do the Job

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from DeSaad, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I can definitely understand wanting to collect and learn about such unique experiences. Perhaps you are drawn to the sound of my voice? I know I am drawn to your unique physiology. lt would be fascinating to study in a private session. Until then, I hope this will suffice."

sections.title: Item
items: This collection rewards the player with a Pandemonium Confluence catalyst.
