title: Dr. Arkham's Observation Journal (Investigations)
summary: Dr. Arkham's Observation Journal is a collection of Investigations that can be found within Arkham Asylum. There are 8 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Dr. Arkham's Observation Journal is a collection of Investigations that can be found within Arkham Asylum. There are 8 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Gotham City has long since come to terms with the grim spectre of Arkham Island. Perched on the water like a contemplative gargoyle, this aging structure is the city's only barrier against pure insanity. The only person to truly understand the misanthropes and mad men that inhabit Arkham Asylum is it's head clinic: Dr. Jeremiah Arkham. Arkham's observation journal would be priceless in the right hands.

sections.title: Part 1: Observations on Harvey Dent
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Lobby
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: Behind the reception counter at the Lobby.
Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - Harvey Dent: Classic split personality. A coin with two scratched faces is my next planned experiment."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 2: Observations on Edward Nygma
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Experimental Procedures Workshop
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: In the Lobby, follow the path with gas canisters (to the West) until you arrive at the Experimental Procedures Workshop. It's next to a desk on the upper level.
Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - Edward Nygma: Obsessive-compulsive riddle solving. Have had several books of unsolvable puzzles printed up to push the depths of his mania."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 3: Observations on Jervis Tetch
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Therapy Fulfillment Center
Instance: Arkham Asylum

Location: In the Lobby, follow the path with gas canisters (to the West) until you arrive at the Therapy Fulfillment Center, then go through the door to the ELECTROSHOCK section. It's next to a Large Lab Pill Dispenser to the North.

Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - Jervis Tetch: Intense fixation on a fictional reality allows him the luxury of an internal retreat from reality. Attempting to 'ground' patient by locking him in with the prisoners from Block A."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 4: Observations on Dr. Johnathan Crane
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Amadeus Memorial Theater
Instance: Arkham Asylum

Location: In the Lobby, follow the path with gas canisters (to the West) until you arrive at the Amadeus Memorial Theater (where you fight Scarecrow). It's near the exit to the teleporter to the Lobby.

Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - Doctor Jonathan Crane: Intense intellect and psychiatric training makes him an extremely troublesome patient. Have begun severe fear-reaction based therapies based on Crane's own notes."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 5: Observations on Dr. Harleen Quinzel
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Cell Block 6: Maximum Security
Instance: Arkham Asylum

Location: In the Lobby, follow the frozen path until you arrive at the Cell Block 6: Maximum Security. Keep going until you find the last boiler on the lower level - the node is behind the pillar next to it, in the middle of the ice.

Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - Doctor Harleen Quinzel: Personality fixation complex makes her difficult to approach. Trying to force patient Pamela Isley to adjust her fixational matrix, but it's slow going."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 6: Observations on Victor Fries
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: The Boiler Room
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: In the Lobby, follow the frozen path until you arrive at The Boiler Room (where you fight Mister Freeze). It's behind the pillar in the back of the room.

Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - Victor Fries: Intense issues with loss and maladjustment are the core causes for his condition. Manipulating patient with intense couples therapy counseling using his wife as a catalyst."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 7: Observations on Pamela Isley
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: The Courtyard of Serenity
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: In the Lobby, follow the path with plants until you arrive at The Courtyard of Serenity (where you fight Poison Ivy). It's at the Southwest corner, across the room from the entrance.

Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - Pamela Isley: Doctor Isley's biochemistry mandates therapy via glass wall and comm system. Attempting soil chemical tweaks within her cell to forcibly control mood."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

sections.title: Part 8: Observations on "The Joker"
items: Zone: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane
Region: Hall of Records
Instance: Arkham Asylum
Location: In the Lobby, follow the path with plants until you arrive at Hall of Records. It's at the Northwest End above the wall in between some Warehouse File Cabinets.
Investigation: Dr. Arkham: "Patient - " The Joker": A most intense and challenging patient. I've restricted access again after the most recent deaths."

references.label: Arkham Asylum for the Criminally Insane

items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Batman, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Arkham Asylum is a laughably thin membrane keeping the madness away from the city's streets. You've gathered Arkham's notes, exposing more of his sickness. Diseased minds like his are why I will never rest in keeping Gotham safe."

summary: Family Honor is a global briefing that can be found on Titans Island, in the Titans Targeted! alert, and in the Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn raid. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Teen Titans: The Judas Contract.

sections.title: Overview
items: Family Honor is a global briefing that can be found on Titans Island, in the Titans Targeted! alert, and in the Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn raid. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Teen Titans: The Judas Contract.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The Wilson family has a tragic past."

sections.title: Part 1: Honor Thy Father
items: Zone: Titans Targeted!
Region: Titans Tower
Location:

Briefing: Deathstroke:" I never gave Grant the time he deserved. He was my son... But the job always came first. It had to. So, naturally, he wanted to be part of my world, which is why he became the Ravager. He knew the Titans were a nuisance to me, and he thought if he could remove them, he'd win my approval. Sadly, he failed..."

sections.title: Part 2: Honor Thy Mother
items: Zone: Titans Targeted!
Region: Titans Tower
Location: At a wall before you enter the room of the final fight

Briefing: Adeline Wilson:" All Grant ever wanted was to be loved by Slade. He let H.I.V.E. experiment on him so he could be like his father. And in the end, it was the contract on the Titans that was his undoing. Joseph on the other hand didn't see the same fascination with his father... especially not after the incident."

sections.title: Part 3: Honor Thy Family
items: Zone: Titans Island
Location: At the rear wall of Cyborg's workshop in a corner

Briefing: Deathstroke:" I took Grant's contract with H.I.V.E. to preserve his honor. None of my family understood the importance of honor; of doing the job and seeing it through to completion no matter what the cost. I built my reputation on it... And no son of mine, will be dishonored or dishonor me with their short comings."

sections.title: Part 4: A Victim of Honor
items: Zone: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Location: After the hall in which you enter, behind some crates to the left.

Briefing: Adeline Wilson:" Grant accepted his fate when he signed that contract but Joseph did not. Poor Joseph was just a bystander. A victim of my ex-husband's stubbornness and hubris. He paid the price of my husband's honor."

images.label: Family Honor - A Victim of Honor

sections.title: Part 5: An Honorable Excuse
items: Zone: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Location: At the far right side of the hall where you fight Guard Captain Buzzzcut and Lieutenant Bombus, at an antenna.

Briefing: Deathstroke:" A two bit terrorist known as the Jackal wanted information on a hit I did. But I wouldn't give up contractor... it was against my personal code of ethics. It would sully my reputation..."

sections.title: Part 6: An Honorable Death
items: Zone: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Location: In the section right behind the exit portal in the near left corner.

Briefing: Adeline Wilson:" The Jackal's men put a knife to our son, Joseph's throat and demanded Slade to speak. Slade would not be extorted. He would not accept the ultimatum. Instead, he made his move... When it was over, all the hitmen lay dead... and our son lay dying in the street."

sections.title: Part 7: Death Before Dishonor
items: Zone: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn
Location: In the hallway behind the hall where you fight Deathstroke, at the left wall behind an destroyable object.

Briefing: Deathstroke:" I regret what happened to Joseph. I love him. But how could I allow him to see me compromise my ethics in front of low life scum like the Jackal. Any true son of mine would give his life to honor his father."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Nightwing or Deathstroke, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " These journals from Adeline Wilson explain a lot about Slade's past."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " A man without honor is not a man. I did what needed to be done and never dishonored myself or my family. These journals are proof of that."

title: Forever Evil (Briefings)
summary: Forever Evil is a global briefing that can be found in locations of the Earth 3: The Visitor duo and the Earth 3: The Panopticon and Earth 3: The Escape raids. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Earth 3 episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Forever Evil is a global briefing that can be found in locations of the Earth 3: The Visitor duo and the Earth 3: The Panopticon and Earth 3: The Escape raids. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Earth 3 episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The Crime Syndicate shows their true colors towards one another when left to their own devices."

sections.title: Part 1: Tyrant from the Stars
items: Zone: Earth 3 Panopticon
Instance: Earth 3: The Panopticon
Location: To the east of the entrance where you walk in to fight Ultraman.

Briefing: Ultraman:" The Syndicate is unstoppable with me leading it. Planets will kneel at my feet if I wish it! It is only fitting that I am serviced by the most worthy woman on the planet. I have found a super-woman whose beauty, strength and ruthlessness will produce my ideal offspring. If anyone opposes me, be it, Luthor, Owlman, or my Superwoman... I will destroy them without remorse. No one stands agaisnt me!"

sections.title: Part 2: The Owl Sees All
items: Zone: Earth 3 Panopticon
Instance: Earth 3: The Escape
Location: Behind a wall, north of the "Return to Last Location" portal in the starting area.

Briefing: Owlman: " With the little resistance against us dead or missing, this Syndicate we've formed is tentative at best. I need to consider all exit strategies. Note to Self: Locate and destroy all sources of Kryptonite planet side. Begin development of yellow solar radiation cannon. Monitor frequency of Superwoman's visits to Ultraman's quarters. End Note."

sections.title: Part 3: The Perfect Mate
items: Zone: Earth 3 Panopticon
Instance: Earth 3: The Escape
Location: In a corner to the south leading to the final boss area where you fight Ultraman, Owlman, and Superwoman.

Briefing: Superwoman:" My designs for the Crime Syndicate are simple. Owlman and Ultraman will aid me in acquiring what I want because they both desire to possess me. They will murder anyone including each other to earn my touch. I will sit at the head of the table, clinging tightly to which ever one serve me best but in the end I will stand alone. I will be unchallenged in my position because I am the strongest, most desirable woman on the planet. No man can best me, no woman can match me. I am Superwoman."

sections.title: Part 4: Anarchy on Earth-3
items: Zone: Earth 3 Panopticon
Instance: Earth 3: The Panopticon
Location: Behind the console to the northwest in the room with TV screens all over the walls and where you fight Johnny Quick.

Briefing: Johnny Quick :" So I joined The Crime Syndicate because it seemed like a cool idea; all the biggest, bad asses on the planet making the mouth-breathing dredges bow down to us. But honestly, me and Atomica have always been aces on our own and the more I hang with these douche nozzles, the more I realize how LAME they can be. Money and power are nice but me and shortcakes; we get our kicks from more carnal pleasures, if you catch my drift. Nothing hotter than watching some stupid brat cry his eyes out as you drag his mom around at Mach five... For the moment, we're in. Be we're still getting OUR kicks one way or another."

sections.title: Part 5: A Desparation Move
items: Zone: Smallville
Instance: Earth 3: The Visitor
Location:

Briefing: Alexander Luthor :" Tomorrow I leave this Earth, which I protected my entire life, to travel to another. Not to escape the misery and barbarity of the Crime Syndicate, but in the hope that I am right in my estimations. It is an Earth like our own, but filled with heroes, fighting for the downtrodden and exploited. I pray the greatest of them will succeed where I have not. I will beg them to help me defeat the Crime Syndicate and bring peace and justice to this world."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from The Flash or Lex Luthor, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " These Crime Syndicate crazies certainly have no love lost between them... Or at least none that matter much!"

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I wonder if the other villains on our world are as big a bunch of backstabbers as the Crime Syndicate is? I need to have a talk with some of my partners."

title: Gorilla Island (Briefings)
summary: Gorilla Island is a Global Briefing that can be found in the alert Gorilla Island. There are four parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Gorilla Island is a Global Briefing that can be found in the alert Gorilla Island. There are four parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Ultra-Humanite has discovered the source of Grodd's devolution technology!"

sections.title: Part 1: Gorilla Island: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Gorilla Island
Instance: Gorilla Island
Location: On a beam by the lava fall between Research and Development and the Supply Depot.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live. STAR Labs confirmed today that the technology used by Gorilla Grodd in his attempt to "devolve" Metropolis is alien in origin - and likely the same technology that the body-swapping scientist Ultra-Humanite is using to hold the world hostage. While Grodd himself has escaped custody, his devolution and broadcast technology remain in STAR Labs custody."

sections.title: Part 2: Gorilla Island: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gorilla Island
Region: Research and Development
Instance: Gorilla Island
Location: North of R&D, on the ground.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " I'm Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because you think humans are the only intelligent species on the planet. Sorry, friend, because not so long ago, aliens crash-landed on a tiny island and their technology created a race - of genius gorillas! And now the Ultra-Humanite has stolen their technology! Think I'm joking? YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 3: Gorilla Island: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gorilla Island
Region: Research and Development
Instance: Gorilla Island
Location: Up on a piece of metal rubble in front of the entrance (east).

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale for Gotham Now! The villain Ultra-Humanite has issued a worldwide ultimatum: pay his ransom, or be turned into "Ultra-Gorillas." The Ultra-Humanite was considered a brilliant scientist, until his mind transference studies were banned worldwide. Now he occupies the body of an enormous white gorilla. Will we join him? Or will the world pay his ransom? Stay tuned!"

sections.title: Part 4: Gorilla Island: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Gorilla Island
Region: Command Bridge
Instance: Gorilla Island
Location: On a beam by the lava fall west from the Bridge

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" This is a top security transmission from Amanda Waller to Sarge Steel. I'm pulling the Suicide Squad from Gorilla Island. The Justice League and the Society are already deployed; I say let them take on the Ultra-Humanite's delusions of grandeur. We have Brainiac to sabotage."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Amanda Waller, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Coded Transmission Follows: Humanite and Grodd can squabble all they want. Checkmate got what it went in for, and we have you at least in part to thank for that. Nice work. Waller out."

title: Gotham's Gang War: Episode 4 (Briefings)
summary: Gotham's Gang War: Episode 4 is an episode briefing that can be found in the Gotham Old Subway challenge and duo. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Gotham's Gang War: Episode 4 is an episode briefing that can be found in the Gotham Old Subway challenge and duo. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Two-Face lays siege to the Penguin's smuggling operation."

sections.title: Part 1: Gang War IV: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Instance: Gotham Old Subway
Location: North from the bar area where you fight Penguin.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale and Gotham Now! with a report on Gotham's coldest hot spot, the Iceberg Lounge! Anyone who's anyone, from the Joker to socialite Kate Kane can be found wining, dining, and dancing at this dice nightclub. As for its owner, the Penguin, has he REALLY gone legit? He claims that his criminal days are behind him, but if so, then who's stirring up the latest Gotham gang war? Commissioner Gordon refused to comment and Batman could not be reached. This is Vicki Vale for Gotham Now."

sections.title: Part 2: Gang War IV: Commissioner Gordon
items: Zone: Gotham City
Instance: Gotham Old Subway
Location: Following the right passage, inside the area where you fight Hush. It's near a flaming barrel to the West.

Briefing: James Gordon: " This is Commissioner Gordon to GCPD in Gotham. Harvey Dent, now known to you as " Two-Face", has called in a location for the Penguin's alleged smuggling activities. We need to know if this is for real or just another flip of his mentally challenged mind. Ever since his face was scarred and his mind split, he's depended on that coin to make his decisions. So until we find out more, keep to your posts. Gordon out."

sections.title: Part 3: Gang War IV: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Gotham City
Instance: Gotham Old Subway
Location: Following the left passage, inside the area where you fight Bane. It's behind a group of Box Pallets to the East.

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " This is Jack Ryder and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because you thought boosting venom was just a cute little street punk hobby. Well I have news for you friends, Bane is back, and he's juicing harder than ever! Someone's tampered with his new Venom, making this beefy brute a pawn for any two-bit Kingpin looking for muscle! Think Bane's days in the Gang War are over? Hate to tell you, friend, but YOU ARE WRONG!."

sections.title: Part 4: Gang War IV: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Gotham City
Instance: Gotham Old Subway
Location: Near the wall, on the highest point in the first room, near a bird statue.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale for Gotham Now! The shapeshifting criminal known as Clayface has a sad and sordid history on the silver screen - and now, far from being a leading man, has turned into a horrifying mass of walking, talking mud! With no known cure for his condition, so Clayface has turned to a life of crime, where his ability to pound through walls and impersonate any human form certainly come in handy. Just remember, anyone around you - COULD be Clayface in disguise! This is Vicki Vale for Gotham Now!"

sections.title: Part 5: Gang War IV: Two-Face
items: Zone: Gotham City
Instance: Gotham Old Subway
Location: Left from cave where you arrive, on the rails.

Briefing: Two-Face:" Joker, this is Two-Face. Didn't you start this little Gang War? Well, Penguin's taking all the credit. When I take over his operation I'll be sure to mention you don't approve. So no need to attend this latest party. I'll catch you - on the flip-side."

sections.title: Part 6: Gang War IV: Two-Face
items: Zone: Gotham City
Instance: Gotham Old Subway
Location: In the bar area, near the booths to the South.

Briefing: Two-Face:" Batman. Batman, are you reading this? This is Harvey. Harvey Dent. Listen, I know we've had our differences, but trust me, I can handle this takedown of the Penguin. I've got the new heroes to help me out. You'll see. I can keep Two-Face under control - for the good of the city."

title: Grayson's Fate (Briefings)
summary: Grayson's Fate is a briefing that can be found in the Earth 3: Injustice System alert of the Earth 3 epsiode. There are 5 parts to this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Grayson's Fate is a briefing that can be found in the Earth 3: Injustice System alert of the Earth 3 epsiode. There are 5 parts to this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "On this Earth, Richard Grayson's tale is one of tragedy."

sections.title: Part 1: A Night at the Circus
items: Zone: Earth 3: Injustice System
Region: Municipal Building
Location: In the room with Mayor Gordon and his wall of SWAT officers, in the highest side corridor to the right.

Briefing: Mayor Gordon:" The Owlman has informed me our money laundering operation inside C.C. Haly's and Norton Bros. Circus has been skimming. I'm a bit surprised since the Flying Graysons have been loyal providers for me for over a decade. Not to mention their talented son has always been ideal leverage. If he really wants the Graysons dead so badly there must be a reason, one he'd pay through the nose for."

sections.title: Part 2: The Death of a Family
items: Zone: Municipal Building
Instance: Earth 3: Injustice System
Location: After first encountering Mayor Gordon and defeating his guards, head up the stairs and make a right. The briefing will be down the hall to the right in a dead end.

Briefing: Mayor Gordon: " Owlman asked that I cover up the death of the Flying Graysons and the price was to ensure my upcoming re-election this year. If a couple of dead circus folk means I can keep my seat of power, then to hell with them. A little gauche that their kid had to watch his parents die that way but Gotham isn't exactly gay Paris. I wonder why Thomas Wayne Jr. would want to adopt that circus brat..."

sections.title: Part 3: Talon in Training
items: Zone: Municipal Building
Instance: Earth 3: Injustice System
Location: Where you fight the Judge, Jury, and Executioner, it is in the upper right corridor above the arena.

Briefing: Mayor Gordon:" Owlman has been leaning on me more than ever to hide any evidence of Grayson's adoption by Wayne. It seems it was a cover up so Owlman could take him under his wing. What Owlman has been teaching the kid since Wayne adopted him, I'll never know, but it seems Owlman is grooming a new partner. The last thing I need is another maniac looking for his cut of Gotham. I'm not too worried though, the kid seems soft to me."

sections.title: Part 4: O' Brother Where Art Thou
items: Zone: Municipal Building
Instance: Earth 3: Injustice System
Location: After defeating the Judge, Jury, and Executioner, go down the left hall and the first room to the right will be an office. The briefing will be behind the desk.

Briefing: Owlman:" Taking the boy was a wise choice. He will not only make a powerful confidant, but I cannot help but see the incredible similarities to Bruce. He has natural talent, far more talent than Bruce ever did. He's like a sponge, taking in everything I've taught him and adapting it to his strengths. I have hope that this act may ease my loneliness Bruce left with his weakness. I must be certain to ensure any similar signs of weakness are purged from the boy."

sections.title: Part 5: Diary of a Madman
items: Zone: Municipal Building
Instance: Earth 3: Injustice System
Location: In the final room near Batman and Mayor Gordon behind a coffee table and in between two chairs.

Briefing: Owlman:" Foolish, sanctimonious brat thinks he can deal with my enemies compassionately. He dares criticize my methods! He's as weak as Bruce was... just another coward unable to do what's needed. Why must they all be so weak? Why! Let him go. Let him pay a visit to our crime fighting friend, the Joker, now that the clown has completely lost his mind. Whatever scars Richard walks away with due to his unwillingness to kill or be killed, will serve as a lesson to him. I refuse to pull his hide from the fire... He will have to learn the hard way no matter what the cost."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Don't bother reading into it too much... This other world is NUTS! All you need to know is Owlman has no qualms about offing annoying sidekicks. Batman should take the hint!"

sections.title: Overview
items: Hall of Doom Armory is a global briefing comprised of four parts, which can be found in both regular and Legends version of the The Hall of Doom Armory alert.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Something has gone horrible[SIC] wrong in the depths of the Hall of Doom Armory!

sections.title: Part 1: Hall of Doom Armory: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Region: The Armory
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live on the Hall of Doom, the mysterious headquarters of the Secret Society of Supervillains. Its top secret location is protected by numerous technological, biological, and magical wards, making it almost impossible to target. Reports have placed it variously under the sea, Austin, Texas, and at the Earth's core. The Society itself refused to comment."

sections.title: Part 2: Hall of Doom Armory: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Region: The Armory
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane, reporting on the lastest activities of Doctor Sivana. A renowned technological genius, and Shazam's sworn enemy, Doctor Sivana has allegedly refused President Veronica Cale's offer of work on Oolong Island for the depths of the Hall of Doom. No reports yet on what this evil mastermind may unleash."

sections.title: Part 3: Hall of Doom Armory: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Region: The Armory
Location:

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch! on - the enemy! The Secret Society of Supervillains, or the Society for short, was formed in response to the formation of the Justice League. Although all Society members are free agents, we hear reports of regular dues, required contests of strength, and a near-constant atmosphere of chaos. I can hope to never see it in person! This is Vicki Vale for JLA Watch!"

sections.title: Part 4: Hall of Doom Armory: LexCorp
items: Zone: Hall of Doom
Region: The Armory
Location:

Briefing: Agent Serenity:" This is Agent Serenity to Lex Luthor. Lex, heads up. Our remote analysis system is detecting some sort of interference in the Hall of Doom's armory. If you want to take advantage of the situation, I'd move in before Calculator and Doctor Sivana get in there first.. Serenity out."

title: Heraldry of Atlantis (Briefings)
summary: Heraldry of Atlantis is a global briefing that can be found in the Atlantis: Royal Palace challenge, the Atlantis: The Silent School alert, the Atlantis: Crown of Thorns raid and the Atlantis: The Throne raid. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Atlantis episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Heraldry of Atlantis is a global briefing that can be found in the Atlantis: Royal Palace challenge, the Atlantis: The Silent School alert, the Atlantis: Crown of Thorns raid and the Atlantis: The Throne raid. There are seven parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Atlantis episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Heraldry of Atlantis: Mera and Aquaman's private musings on the Widowhood's Heraldry of Atlantis, acquired by traitorous Drift spies.

sections.title: Part 1: Words of Wisdom
items: Zone: Atlantean Royal Palace
Instance: Atlantis: Royal Palace
Location: Just north of where you enter the instance, next to the west wall.

Briefing: Aquaman: " Greetings, my beloved. These historical documents that the Widowhood sent me documenting the lineage of Atlantean Kings are fascinating. As a King, I must learn from my predecessors' mistakes, as well as, their greatest accomplishments. A good king must learn from the past. Only then can we build a better future."

images.label: Heraldry of Atlantis - Words of Wisdom

sections.title: Part 2: Namesake
items: Zone: Atlantean Royal Palace
Instance: Atlantis: Royal Palace
Location: At the final junction where you enter the room of the last fight to the left, in the hallway to the right.

Briefing: Mera: " My love, you are as wise as you are cliché. I didn't know you were named after the brother of the very first King of Atlantis. It seems he was quite ambitious. But tell me this, why is King Atlan known as the Dead King? It sounds as if there is more to this tale."

sections.title: Part 3: The Great King
items: Zone: Silent School
Instance: Atlantis: The Silent School
Location: On the first floor of the room where you fight The Faceless One.

Briefing: Aquaman:" According to this, King Atlan was a powerful mage, known as "The Great King". He crafted the Trident of Poseidon and was founder of the House of Atlan. His brother, Orin the First, betrayed him, killed his family, and took his place as King. Atlan, believed dead, went into exile to seek revenge. Definitely, a dark time in our history it seems."

images.label: Heraldry of Atlantis - The Great King

sections.title: Part 4: The Dead King's Scepter
items: Zone: Atlantis
Region: (open world)
Location: Under the central bridge, below its northern arch, next to a pillar.

Briefing: Aquaman: " While in exile, Atlan forged several powerful artifacts from a mysterious metal, the most powerful of which was the Scepter of Atlan, known now as the Dead King's Scepter. Atlan used the Scepter to sink Atlantis as punishment for his betrayal."

images.label: Heraldry of Atlantis - The Dead King's Scepter

sections.title: Part 5: Xebel, Xebel
items: Zone: Crown of Thorns
Instance: Atlantis: Crown of Thorns
Location: Near west wall of the first chamber.

Briefing: Mera: " This all sounds familiar, Arthur. This was during the time when Atlantis resided above the sea and my home, Xebel was still part of the kingdom proper. If I recall, legends claim that Xebel sank into a vortex inside what land-dwellers call "The Bermuda Triangle". The vortex transported our people to our current home. So it was the Dead King that separated our people and destroyed Atlantis?"

sections.title: Part 6: Changing the Tide
items: Zone: Crown of Thorns
Instance: Atlantis: Crown of Thorns
Location: Near the entrance to the third room after the King Shark fight, at the right side behind some thorns.

Briefing: Mera: " So it was the Dead King that divided our people and destroyed Atlantis? How absurd. Imagine how different things could have been if Atlantis had remained above the sea and Xebel was never chastised as outsiders and criminals. But surely this is all legend and folklore. If not, then where are the Dead King's Artifacts today?"

images.label: Heraldry of Atlantis - Changing the Tide

sections.title: Part 7: A Gift of the Dead King
items: Zone: Atlantis Risen
Instance: Atlantis: The Throne
Location: Behind the entrance portal on the left side at a pillar

Briefing: Aquaman: " I am afraid this is not a legend, my love. The Dead King's Scepter and the rest of his Artifacts were buried with him in his tomb, deep below the palace. Only one of his creations was not buried with him. On his death bed, Atlan decreed that it would be passed down from one King of Atlantis to the next. It is the same weapon I now wield, The Trident of Poseidon."

images.label: Heraldry of Atlantis - A Gift of the Dead King

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Mera or Ocean Master, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages

items: Meta Clinic ID

History of Dakota's Finest is an episode briefing that can be found in Dakota City and the Abandoned Subway duo. There are eight parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Shock to the System episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Dakota's finest reminisce."

sections.title: Part 1: Meeting an Icon
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: Three blocks east and one block south of the canal, at rooftop level.

Briefing: " Rocket: When I met Icon, he had no interest in being a superhero. Can you believe that? He was an ole' 'get off my lawn' squatter in a robe who never left the house. The world has a lot to thank me for!" " Icon: Get the facts straight, Rocket. I own that house. The one you broke into. You should be thankful I didn't call the cops."

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - Meeting an Icon

sections.title: Part 2: A Better World
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: At the west-side streetlevel of the block two blocks down and three blocks right from the northwest corner of the area.
Briefing: Icon:" The planet I'm from, Terminus, our culture thrives because we are bonded by and motivated by love. For Earth to last, it will have to do the same."

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - A Better World

sections.title: Part 3: Hope Restored
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: Four blocks north and two blocks east from the southwest corner of the area, at rooftop level.

Briefing: Icon:" I have been on Earth for several centuries now, and in that time, had given up on improving life here. I had come to believe that the morality of human beings was too primitive. But meeting Rocket, someone who has suffered the worst of this planet, and seeing her still have hope inspired me. Now, I hope you get it right this time."

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - Hope Restored

sections.title: Part 4: Never Forget
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: At the north-side of the eastern block of the park just south of the highway.
Briefing: Static:" I got my powers protesting with the Black Lives Matter movement. Nothing's ever perfect, but I'll always fight for anything that unites people against injustice."

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - Never Forget

sections.title: Part 5: Unpaid Pains
items: Zone: Shock: Abandoned Subway
Region: Abandoned Subway
Location: Head south after defeating Turtledove and the briefing will be to the west at the corner of the long hallway.
Briefing: Static:" It's a shame money tends to corrupt. Luckily for the world, superheroes don't get paid..."

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - Unpaid Pains

sections.title: Part 6: How Fitting
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: North-side mid-level of the construction two blocks down and two blocks left from the northeast corner of the area.

Briefing: Rocket:" I've always loved a good fit, but I never could have guessed that a belt would be the key to my superpowers. It's alien tech from Icon, and it creates an inertial field that absorbs force and allows me to send it right back! I wish I had it when my momma used to whoop my butt!"

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - How Fitting

sections.title: Part 7: Proud Mama
items: Zone: Dakota City
Location: North-side street level four blocks down and four blocks right from the northwest corner of the area.
Briefing: Rocket:" When you get a kid, it's the small things. We got 'mama' down, next up: 'Rocket!'"

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - Proud Mama

sections.title: Part 8: No Shade
items: Zone: Shock: Abandoned Subway
Region: Abandoned Subway
Location: Southeast of Ebon (the final boss for the duo) on top of two shipping crates.
Briefing: Ebon:" Look down on me if you want, but when the worst of the Bang Babies got messed up by the gas, when everyone else called them monsters, it was me who gave them a home."

images.label: History of Dakota's Finest - No Shade

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Rocket, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " People like to hate on Dakota City. Especially the part where I'm from. But if they really knew what was going on here, and what we've been through, they wouldn't just judge us based on incendiary headlines in the news. I hope you got a chance to see this is a place worth saving, and that just like everywhere else, we have heroes too. And if you didn't, at least you get this."

sections.title: Trivia
items: The briefings are erroneously sorted under episode briefings and would normally be sorted under global briefings. The term episode briefing existed long before new content releases were (re)named episodes and was meant in the meaning of episodic.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Ixion, Zeus, and Hades relay the tale of Ixion's fall from grace."

sections.title: Part 1: True and Great
items: Zone: Raising Hades
Region: River Styx
Location: At the start near the vendor

Briefing: Ixion:" I was once a true and great king ruling over a most noble and ancient tribe of Thessaly. My father in law stole horses from me, so I pushed him into a burning fire... and for this I was shunned. Outcast! Nearly driven mad."

images.label: Ixion's Tale of Woe - True and Great

sections.title: Part 2: By Hera's... Beauty
items: Zone: Raising Hades
Region: River Styx
Location: In the area where you fight the two harpies in the far right corner.
Briefing: Ixion: " Zeus took pity on me and invited me to walk amongst the gods in Olympus... but I was transfixed by the beauty of Hera."

images.label: Ixion's Tale of Woe - By Hera's... Beauty

sections.title: Part 3: Cloud Confusion
items: Zone: Raising Hades
Region: River Styx
Location: In the room where you fight the dogs
Briefing: Zeus:" The audacity of that mortal fool, Ixion! His passions brimming for MY wife. Ha! So... I tricked him with a cloud and cast him to Hades."

images.label: Ixion's Tale of Woe - Cloud Confusion

sections.title: Part 4: Highway to Hell
items: Zone: Raising Hades
Region: River Styx
Location: In the small room where you first talk to Hades at the right wall
Briefing: Ixion:" Zeus, in his anger, blasted me with his mighty lightning bolt and cast me to Tartarus!"

images.label: Ixion's Tale of Woe - Highway to Hell

sections.title: Part 5: Hades Hath No Fury
items: Zone: Raising Hades
Region: River Styx

Briefing: Hades:" The irony of my brother, Zeus, sending a mortal to me to punish for "indiscretions"... But Ixion was almost as prideful as the king of the gods... At times I do relish my role as tormentor of the dead."

summary: Kahndaq is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Kahndaq raid. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Kahndaq is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Kahndaq raid. There are six parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Black Adam's attempt to raise Isis have caused Kahndaq's ancient dead to rise!

sections.title: Part 1: Kahndaq: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Region: Shiruta Market
Instance: Kahndaq (Raid)
Location: To the North of the Shiruta Market, after the doorway.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane for Daily Planet Live with on the crisis brewing in the middle eastern country of Kahndaq. Black Adam, ruler of Kahndaq, launched what is now called World War 3 when his wife, Isis, was killed by assassins. The country, and neighboring Bialya, have never recovered. What's in store for Kahndaq? Join our special Daily Planet Live series on the marvels and terrors of this ancient country in the sands."

sections.title: Part 2: Kahndaq: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Instance: Kahndaq (Raid)
Location: In the central street between the Shiruta Market and the Shiruta Bath House, on the broken bridge.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale with a JLA Watch! on one-time Justice Society member, Black Adam. Black Adam has a long and troubled relationship with the power of Shazam, which gave him the powers of the ancient Egyptian gods and the ability to summon lightning. Despite the actions of this troubled antihero, the Justice Society continues to hope for his return to the heroic fold."

sections.title: Part 3: Kahndaq: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Region: Palace Courtyard
Instance: Kahndaq (Raid)
Location: On a ledge on the East side of the collapsed building structure - on the side facing the Palace of Kahndaq.

Briefing: Vicki Vale: " This is Vicki Vale with JLA Watch! Captain Marvel is often compared to Superman due to his strength, speed, and flight. But "Cap", as he's called, gains his powers from a magical source - and can summon lightning with a word! Although his long-time nemesis, Black Adam, joined and then left the Justice Society, Cap himself never gives up hope for the power of Shazam!"

sections.title: Part 4: Kahndaq: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Region: Palace Courtyard
Instance: Kahndaq (Raid)
Location: Between the two large obelisks on the East side of the Palace Courtyard.

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" Amanda Waller to all agents in or near Kahndaq. Black magic is rising in the capital city of Shiruta. The dead are walking, and they are PISSED. Felix Faust's necromancy is clearly involved, as well as some sort of faux Lazarus pit water they've got in the city wells. Long story short, pull back. The time for covert action is done. The Society and The League are going in."

sections.title: Part 5: Kahndaq: Circe
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Region: Palace of Kahndaq
Instance: Kahndaq (Raid)
Location: On the staircase area leading to the Palace of Kahndaq, on the arch above the central aqueduct.

Briefing: Circe:" Circe speaks and you will obey! Black Adam unknowingly does our will by punishing the treacherous Faust. *contemplative, pleased* Black Adam...now there is a man worthy of consorting with a goddess. And who better to replace Isis in his heart than...myself? *commanding* Break his murderous rage, bring peace to Kahndaq... and *seductive* know Circe will be pleased."

sections.title: Part 6: Kahndaq: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Instance: Kahndaq (Raid)
Location: South of the two large obelisks on the West side of the Palace Courtyard.

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" This is Wonder Woman. Black Adam's hate and pain corrupt all around him so he knows no allies, only foe. This is the result of magic used for tyranny. If you fight now for good, strength to your arm! And if you fight for evil, I wish you the wisdom to defy Circe's lies. To battle!"

rows: " Coded Transmission Follows: A threat to national security like that should never have been allowed to return to power in Kahndaq. Regardless of your personal motives, thank you for stepping in. Waller out."

title: Last Sons of Krypton (Briefings)
summary: Last Sons of Krypton is a global briefing that can be found in the two stages of the The Phantom Zone operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Episode 22.

sections.title: Overview
items: Last Sons of Krypton is a global briefing that can be found in the two stages of the The Phantom Zone operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Episode 22.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Most of Krypton's people perished years ago when the planet was destroyed. Some of them survived, imprisoned in the Phantom Zone."

sections.title: Part 1: Phantom Zone Prison
items: Zone: The Phantom Zone
Region: Fortress of Solitude
Location: just behind the spawning area

Briefing: Superman: " The Phantom Zone is a place outside of - and away from - the time and space that we know. My father discovered it, and later, Kryptonian used it as a prison. Prisoners hardly age, and they don't even need to eat. They just have to wait out their sentences."

sections.title: Part 2: Last General of Krypton
items: Zone: The Phantom Zone
Region: Fortress of Solitude
Location: Behind a crystal to the right of Jor-El A.I.'s spawning location.

Briefing: Superman: " General Zod, Ursa and Non were imprisoned for trying to overthrow the Kryptonian government. I truly wish they could be released from the Phantom Zone, but they made it perfectly clear that they do not have any interest in sharing Earth with humans."

sections.title: Part 3: New Krypton
items: Zone: The Phantom Zone
Region: Fortress of Solitude
Location: Behind crystals to the right from the Phantom Zone Projector

Briefing: General Zod: " My people! Listen to me now. We may be stuck inside the Phantom Zone, but time changes all things. Including myself. Never again will I allow a panel of sanctimonious politicians to do nothing while our people die. I could have saved Krypton if only the council have bowed before me. Follow me now, and I swear, Krypton will be reborn!"

sections.title: Part 4: Art of War
items: Zone: The Phantom Zone
Region: Phantom Zone
Location: Just before the facility's entrance, up to the right.

Briefing: General Zod: " It was not unforeseen that Kal-El might send us back into the Phantom Zone. A great tactician always has a contingency plan. While we had control of the Fortress, our scientists uploaded a virus to the Phantom Projector. It was designed to alert Kal-El and then pull him inside once he was close enough."

sections.title: Part 5: Exodus
items: Zone: The Phantom Zone
Region: Phantom Zone
Location: Downstairs, after the final boss room.

Briefing: General Zod: " Once we detain Kal-El, the virus will commence creating holes in the Space-Time continuum, other doors if you will, allowing us to make our exodus. The only complication is knowing when the virus will activate, as time outside the Phantom Zone passes differently. For now we wait, and our freedom will come.'"

summary: Magic Artifacts is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across the JLD: Pub Crawl duo, JLD: Darkness Rising 4-player operation, and JLD: Shattered Gotham raid as part of the Justice League Dark episode. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Overview
items: Magic Artifacts is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across the JLD: Pub Crawl duo, JLD: Darkness Rising 4-player operation, and JLD: Shattered Gotham raid as part of the Justice League Dark episode. There are 5 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: A.R.G.U.S. tracks the most powerful mystical artifacts on Earth and beyond, but the Phantom Stranger has been keeping an eye on them for millennia.

sections.title: Part 1: Crime Bible
items: Zone: European Castle
Instance: JLD: Darkness Rising
Location: At a fountain at the end of the left way around the castle

Investigation: Phantom Stranger: " Even as I wander the Earth to pay for my misdeeds, others worship murder and betrayal as a religion. I find it intriguing that the Crime Bible, a focus for the deification of criminal trespass, has earned special interest from Batwoman. The Crime Bible, and the Book of Lilith within, is a powerful tool in the hands of evil, but there will always be forces of good to maintain the balance."

sections.title: Part 2: Spear of Destiny
items: Zone: European Castle
Instance: JLD: Darkness Rising
Location: At a fountain all the way right around the castle

Investigation: Phantom Stranger: " The Spear of Destiny reminds my of dark times. I am tempted to use its reality-altering powers to try to lift my curse, but fear the consequences. It is fortunate that A.R.G.U.S. sealed it in their Black Room after Freedom Force liberated the spear from Vandal Savage. However, it concerns me that Savage somehow separated the Mark of Cain from the spear."

sections.title: Part 3: Seven Spells of Shazam
items: Zone: Oblivion Bar
Instance: JLD: Pub Crawl
Location: In the hallway near the back of the bar.

Investigation: Phantom Stranger: " The powers within the Seven Spells of Shazam are known only to the Wizard and to the Rock of Eternity itself. However, it is clear that the spells are intrinsically tied to the Rock. In the wrong hands, those spells could be a threat to all the power of Shazam."

images.label: Magic Artifacts - Seven Spells of Shazam

sections.title: Part 4: The Ibistick
items: Zone: Shattered Gotham
Instance: JLD: Shattered Gotham

Location: From the very small structure with the large tree on it, jump into the portal to land on another structure with the investigation node. You need to take a detour since you would normally pass by the structure with the tree.

Investigation: Phantom Stranger: " The Ibistick is an artifact of nigh-unlimited power, especially given its ability to absorb mystic energy from others. Its origins stretch back to the height of the Egyptian gods' influence on the world. Its power in the wrong hands could tip the balance from Order to Chaos. I hope I never see that day."

sections.title: Part 5: Historama
items: Zone: Rock of Eternity
Instance: JLD: Pub Crawl
Location: In a niche of a side room of the hall of the last fight, near the coffin

Investigation: Phantom Stranger: " The Historama is one of the Rock of Eternity's most powerful tools. One need only say, "Historama show me..." to view anything on any plane of existence. Mortals these days worship their web of computers, but the Historama is a repository of information that puts all others to shame."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Steve Trevor, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " If we're going to succeed in our mission to save reality from the Devourer's incursion, you'll need to know about the mystic artifacts involved."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " I'm not a fan of sharing this intel with the likes of you, but if we're going to succeed in our mission to save reality from the Devourer's incursion, you'll need to know about the mystic artifacts involved."

sections.title: Trivia
items: Part 2: The events mentioned by Phantom Stranger happened during the Age of Justice episode.

title: Magic Locations (Briefings)
summary: Magic Locations is a global briefing that can be found in the JLD: Pub Crawl duo, the JLD: Darkness Rising 4-player operation and the JLD: Fellowship of the Arcane 8-player operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Justice League Dark episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Magic Locations is a global briefing that can be found in the JLD: Pub Crawl duo, the JLD: Darkness Rising 4-player operation and the JLD: Fellowship of the Arcane 8-player operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Justice League Dark episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Madame Xanadu has foreseen that these mystic locations will be of great import(ance) in the coming days."

sections.title: Part 1: Rock of Eternity
items: Zone: JLD: Pub Crawl
Region: Rock of Eternity
Location: In the entrance hall of the Rock of Eternity on the left side in an upper tunnel

Briefing: Shazam:" Update for the Wizard: Still running the Rock of Eternity for you, even though it's kinda weird and spooky. That's why I blocked off the prisons of the Seven Deadly Sins. I'm still creeped out by that tomb though. Maybe one day you'll return and tell me who's in there. Also, I found a tablet the other day that says this place was created from place of Heaven and a piece of Hell and lives at the center of the multiverse. Is that true?"

sections.title: Part 2: Black Room
items: Zone: JLD: Darkness Rising
Region: The Black Room
Location: On the right side of the first storey of the hall where you fight Etrigan a bit hidden by a crate

Briefing: Steve Trevor:" A.R.G.U.S. Daily Report: We've tightened security at the Black Room in light of the dimensional incursion over Gotham City. Waller recommended to military brass that we deploy the Spear of Destiny or Crown of Thorns to deal with the problem, but I warned them that any use of these artifacts could lead to dire results. They still ordered my to use the Herne-Ramsgate Cauldron's ability to scry magical creatures to search for intel. I'm not looking forward to it."

sections.title: Part 3: Limbo Town
items: Zone: JLD: Fellowship of the Arcane
Region: Limbo Town
Location: Behind the single shack in the east of the map

Briefing: Doctor Fate:" Lords of Order report: I recently observed Limbo Town. The descendants of the lost villagers of Roanoke continue to worship dark powers in the name of Croatoan. Their wayward witch Klarion Bleak does them no favors with his devotion to the Lords of Chaos. His actions may one day call attention to the village and I suspect that could bring doom down upon his people."

sections.title: Part 4: Shadows Gather
items: Zone: JLD: Darkness Rising
Region: European Castle
Location: In the right side room of the hall of the final fight at some crates

Briefing: Tala:" I am pleased to report that my cultivation of the Order of Eternal Night is close to bearing fruit. Those stinking vampires have been squatting in that village for more than seventy years, doing nothing but worshiping shadows and breeding monsters. Under my direction, they have turned their attention towards finding the lost Mark of Cain and the Crime Bible's 'Book of Lilith.' Those artifacts will help grow my power... and YOURS as well, of course!"

sections.title: Part 5: House of Mystery
items: Zone: JLD: Fellowship of the Arcane
Region: House of Mystery
Location: In the far right wing of the library on a ledge at first floor level

Briefing: Zatanna:" Lords of Order report: The House of Mystery's origins remain unknown; ironic since it's a repository of stories. It used to belong to Cain, the world's first murderer. John Constantine won it in a card game before I took ownership. The House seems to like me, but it has a dark side, ranging from mischief to major creepiness. On the plus side, it exists across multiple dimensions, making it a useful HQ for my little Justice League Dark."

Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " As you seek to defend this plane from the Devourer, the Fellowship of the Arcane has gathered lore on many mystical locations. Let knowledge guide your fate!"

sections.title: Trivia
items: Part 1: The Rock of Eternity was indeed made of a piece of Hell and a piece of Heaven, for the purpose of containing a three-headed demon known as Three Faces of Evil. The tomb mentioned is probably the one that holds Ibis the Invincible.

summary: Memoirs of Earth 3 is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Earth 3 Gotham open world zone and the the Earth 3: The Panopticon raid, featured as part of the Earth 3 episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Memoirs of Earth 3 is a collection of Investigations that can be found in the Earth 3 Gotham open world zone and the the Earth 3: The Panopticon raid, featured as part of the Earth 3 episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: "The contradiction that is this Earth has affected all of the Justice League but none more profoundly than Wonder Woman."

sections.title: Part 1: Arrival
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location: To the East near the safezone at a vent (near to #2).

Investigation: Wonder Woman: " My arrival on this other Earth feels much like my first journey to the world of man; overwhelming, confusing and heartbreaking. I arrived with an open heart and a mission to spread the message of my people. Sadly, this world seems far more in need of love and guidance than even our Earth does."

sections.title: Part 2: In the Shadow of the Syndicate
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location: To the East near the safezone at a house behind a planter (near to #1).

Investigation: Wonder Woman: " It is no wonder the people of this planet have taken to desperation. Every day is spent in the merciless shadow of the Crime Syndicate. These poor people live without virtue because virtuous behavior holds no value to them. I wish to show them that virtues have purpose and meaning."

images.label: Memoirs of Earth 3 - In the Shadow of the Syndicate

sections.title: Part 3: A Prayer for Earth 3
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location: In the South next to the Tricorner Yards on top of a silo.

Investigation: Wonder Woman: " Merciful Minerva! Forgive these poor souls for their acts. The things I have seen on this Earth are beyond anything I could imagine. No law, no order and no heroes to act as paragons for those at the end of their wits. Hera, protect them and give me strength to act on their behalf and grant hope to this darkened world."

images.label: Memoirs of Earth 3 - A Prayer for Earth 3

sections.title: Part 4: Taking Superwoman to Task
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location: Two blocks East from the safezone at a house behind two trash dumpsters

Investigation: Wonder Woman: " If I had the means I would summon all of my sisters from Themyscira, march them down the streets of every city and unseat all those who profit from its misery. I would take this Superwoman to task and show her sisters that violence and ruthlessness are not the Amazon way."

images.label: Memoirs of Earth 3 - Taking Superwoman to Task

sections.title: Part 5: A Hero's Reward
items: Zone: Earth 3: The Panopticon
Instance: Earth 3: The Panopticon
Location: In the room where you fight Owlman, to the east.

Investigation: Wonder Woman: " I know our time here on this Earth is short, and that it would be easy to turn a blind eye to the troubles of this world. But if we can leave here with the knowledge that our actions made a difference, no matter how small, we can stand proud. To succeed in such an act is greater than any reward."

table.caption: Mail Messages

sections.title: Overview
items: Mirror Image: Justice League is a global briefing that can be found in locations of the Earth 3 Gotham open world and the Earth 3: The Panopticon raid. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Earth 3 episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " This Earth is nothing like the Justice League has ever encountered. It's clear by their Watchtower logs, everyone's a bit shaken up."

sections.title: Part 1: Hope Remains
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location:

Briefing: Superman:" Since the discovery of this OTHER Earth, the team has been shaken up by what they've witnessed. Batman focuses his rage on Gotham, and taking down Owlman and this evil James Gordon. On the other hand Diana's heart goes out to all of this world's innocents, even the most ungrateful ones. She holds a candle of hope no matter how dark the situation seems."

images.label: Mirror Image - Justice League - Hope Remains

sections.title: Part 2: More Human than Humans
items: Zone: Earth 3 Gotham
Location:

Briefing: Cyborg:" Coming to this other Earth has opened up some old wounds for me. Since my accident, people stopped seeing me as "fully human". I had to earn their trust and understanding by being more than just a machine. Despite whatever pain or anguish I was going through, I swallowed it and showed empathy to even the most undeserving people. Seeing the way this other version of the Justice League behaves makes me wonder what sort of monster my evil double on this other Earth is. Don't get me wrong, I've always wanted a bump into the big leagues, but I really hope the evil me didn't pass their try outs."

images.label: Mirror Image - Justice League - More Human than Humans

references.label: other version of the Justice League

sections.title: Part 3: Cut to the Quick
items: Zone: Earth 3 Panopticon
Instance: Earth 3: The Panopticon
Location:

Briefing: The Flash:" If I haven't mentioned it here, I'm a speedster. They call e the fastest man alive and I take a lot of pride in that title. It means no matter how dire a situation is help can be there in a flash. Flash Fact: I've traveled to the past and the future and alternate Earths. I've thrown down with a ton of other world speedsters. But I've never seen a world quite like this one; a world where that sadistic jerk, Johnny Quick is only half a heartbeat away from hurting some innocent kid of somebody's loved ones."

sections.title: Part 4: Ultra-Violence
items: Zone: Earth 3 Panopticon
Instance: Earth 3: The Panopticon
Location:

Briefing: Superman:" Of all these evil doppelgangers on this other Earth, the one known as Ultraman frightens me the most. The thought of a ruthless, power-mad version of myself willing to murder on a whim, ties my stomach in knots. He has abused the gifts I was given and bullied the people of this Earth into believing that might makes right. It's my duty to make an example of him, to prove to the people of this Earth that truth, justice and honor will never give in to his tyranny."

summary: Myth or Legends? is a global briefing that can be found in the Mercenary Base and Kahndaq stages of the A Rip in Time operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Episode 25.

sections.title: Overview
items: Myth or Legends? is a global briefing that can be found in the Mercenary Base and Kahndaq stages of the A Rip in Time operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Episode 25.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Audio recordings that detail the background of new team member, Vixen and the efforts of the relentless Vandal Savage."

sections.title: Part 1: The Red
items: Zone: Mercenary Base
Instance: A Rip in Time
Location:

Briefing: Vixen: " I guess we have to do one of these things when we join the team. I am Vixen, the newest member of this entourage. I grew up in Africa, which is where I inherited an ancient and mystical totem, called the Tantu Totem. I am connected to what we call the "Red." With it, I can channel the attributes of any living, or previously living animal on the planet."

sections.title: Part 2: Part of the Team
items: Zone: Mercenary Base
Instance: A Rip in Time
Location:

Briefing: Vixen: " My powers can give me an advantage in almost any situation. I can possess the strength of a gorilla, of the speed of a cheetah, and those are just the basics. The uniqueness of my powers is probably why I was recruited to this team. I don't know our " mystery person" as well as some, but I do know that I can trust my friends in Justice League."

sections.title: Part 3: Something Savage
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Instance: A Rip in Time
Location:

Briefing: Vandal Savage: " I am Vandal Savage. I have walked this planet since before the invention of writing and I have lived for thousands of years. In that time, I have perfected the art of war. Am I the wealthiest man on Earth? The only wealth I seek is that of power. In every generation, the world's power belongs to me."

sections.title: Part 4: Catastrophic Events
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Instance: A Rip in Time
Location:

Briefing: Vandal Savage: " I have ruled many civilizations because I am immortal. Through my years I have noticed that mankind needs...one could say, a "reset" from time to time. I am behind all the great, violent mysteries of history. Atlantis, Pompeii, the black plague, just to name a few."

sections.title: Part 5: Divide and Conquer
items: Zone: Kahndaq
Instance: A Rip in Time
Location:

Briefing: Vandal Savage: " Teth-Adam has access to great power. Unlike any I have seen in recent times. This ancient power should belong to me. I cannot attack him directly, but if I were to destroy all that he loves, it may be enough of a distraction to strike him down."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Vixen, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Did these just fall out of Rip's ship or something? I'm not upset you found my recordings, but I am concerned about Vandal Savage. What else could he be planning?"

title: Oolong Island (Briefings)
summary: Oolong Island is a Global Briefing that can be found on Oolong Island during the Alert of the same name. There are ten parts that comprise this briefing, spread out across the entire island.

sections.title: Overview
items: Oolong Island is a Global Briefing that can be found on Oolong Island during the Alert of the same name. There are ten parts that comprise this briefing, spread out across the entire island.

Note: The island is comprised of a series of buildings. The buildings do not actually have in-game names but are ordered in this guide based on the order they are approached in the alert. The buildings are referred to as complexes, numbered 1 to 5. e.g.: Complex 5 is the last building you encounter in the normal progress of the alert, which houses Chang Tzu.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: T.O. Morrow's coup on Oolong Island endangers the entire planet!

sections.title: Part 1: Oolong Island: Scientist
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Chang Tzu's Personal Lab
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: In the rocky portion where the ground explode beneath you. The node is South of the exit, on a puddle.

Briefing: Ira Quimby:" Ira Quimby's journal. Gotta admit, Doc Magnus's responsometer is total genius. It allows the base personality of matter to come to life! Now that we just gotta keep it away from the nutjob T.O. Morrow. I think his mind snapped when Red Tornado ran off and joined the Justice League. I'm used to working with sick personalities, but that guy? He gives me the creeps."

sections.title: Part 2: Oolong Island: Amanda Waller
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Prototyping Facility
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: Roof to the left of the entrance to T.O. Morrow's lab.

Briefing: Amanda Waller:" Amanda Waller to Oolong "President" Veronica Cale. I am still awaiting your response on what exactly has happened to The Four Horsemen project. Namely, Yurrd the Unknown, Rogga of the Seven Atrocities, Zorrm the Desolate, and Azraeuz the Silent King of Death. Since they were created in YOUR Island, I advise you to answer soon, before the diplomatic relations become... strained."

sections.title: Part 3: Oolong Island: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Oolong Beach
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: Over the cliffs on the east side, underneath a palm tree next to a rock.

Briefing: Jack Ryder:" I am Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because Apokolips isn't just an evil planet out in space. It's spawning here on Earth! Just look at Chang Tzu. He's a talking egg, people. On legs. A WALKING TALKING GENIUS APOKOLIPTIAN EGG. ON LEGS. Think there's a sweet baby chicken inside that thing? Hate to tell you, friend, but - YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 4: Oolong Island: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Oolong Beach
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: On the boat on the East side of the docks.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane at Daily Planet Live. Veronica Cale, president of the small island nation of Oolong, stated that her nation of scientific geniuses is now taking bids for their next project. Oolong stated goal is to allow their population of self-described "mad geniuses" free reign to break the boundaries of science. Given Oolong's past history, the world community remains in alert for disaster."

sections.title: Part 5: Oolong Island: Batman
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Primary Manufacturing
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: Roof to the right of the entrance of the building.

Briefing: Batman:" Batman, recording XX-IV-9. The WayneTech force-fueled injector may actually increase the Batmobile's top speed by a factor of five. Unfortunately...even the Batmobile's reinforce housing can't sustain the pressure from those speeds. Project sidelined until an infused metal structure can be found."

sections.title: Part 6: Oolong Island: Circe
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: On top of closed door on the North side of the large mountain southwest from the Primary Manufacturing building.

Briefing: Circe:"*sweetly* What do you call this device? A - magic transcriptor? To record my every word? *suddenly changing tone to cold menace* Fool! I have slaves to note my every utterance for eternity! But since you wish to serve me, I have a far more suitable role for you. *magic zap, then a braying Bestiamorph sound as the scientist is transformed* There. A role far more fitting to your skills and... intellect."

sections.title: Part 7: Oolong Island: Joker
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Danger - Mutagenics Research Area
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: On the pipes entering the mountain behind Metaloid Testing Lab 4.
Briefing: Joker:"*laughs* KA-BLOOEY! Got you that time! Curiosity killed the cat! *laughs*"

sections.title: Part 8: Oolong Island: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: Middle of the hill between the Prototyping Facility and Chang Tzu's Personal Lab.

Briefing: Lex Luthor:" Lex to TO Morrow. My patience is at an end. This artificial kryptonite is a pale imitation of the original. May I remind you we are looking for substance that can cripple or even kill the Man of Steel? This won't even make him queasy. I suggest you live up to your reputation, Morrow, and produce the kryptonite of the future.. or you may just miss out on your own."

sections.title: Part 9: Oolong Island: Lois and Superman
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Chang Tzu's Personal Lab
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: West of entrance to Chang Tzu's lab, underneath pipes on the corner.

Briefing: LOIS:" Superman, if the Daily Planet could just get a word -" / SUPERMAN:" Miss Lane, I'm afraid I can't comment on Oolong Island's involvement with the Four Horsemen that devastated Kahndaq. I'm sure our international tribunal and Checkmate will soon get to the bottom of it... and the proper people will be called to account. Now if you'll excuse me --" / LOIS:" Superman, wait, what about -- *tape cuts off*"

sections.title: Part 10: Oolong Island: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Oolong Island
Region: Oolong Beach
Instance: Oolong Island (Alert)
Location: On the ground by the rocks on the beach, to the West from the end of the bridge.

Briefing: Wonder Woman:" I, Princess Diana, gift my sister, Amazon Artemis, with this Orb of Athena as reward for her skills in tournament this day. For her prowess with a blade, for her courage under attack, for her daring in assaulting the enemy, we all salute you."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Coded Transmission Follows: You never know what your research money is really funding until the project ends. Good work out there. We'll handle the cleanup. Waller out."

Part 2 and 9 reference the events of the blight that plagued Kahndaq, resulting on the death of Isis in 52 #44 (2007).

items: Battling the Dark Multiverse left cracks in the Source Wall. Opening reality to the unfathomable energy beyond the bounds of the universe is having unpredictable effects.

sections.title: Part 1: Beyond the Source Wall

Region: LexCorp Tower

Investigation: Oracle: " Working with Mr. Terrific to create probes that can detect spikes in Source energy has been a challenge, to say the least. How do I write code to measure something that literally warps reality? Maybe an adapting algorithm base on Big Barda's Mega-Rod power signature?"

Location: On the Metro railway in front of and almost left of LexCorp Tower.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Black Canary's nightmares were actually visions of events that were taking place in Earth 55. That story is told in the comic mini-series DCeased (2019) - hence the name of her audio note.

Starfire's audio note seem to tease a Teen Titans episode that never came into fruition, as she is next seen later in the same year in Long Live the Legion episode, which is set 100 years in the future. Her conflict with her sister Blackfire would be explored 2 years later with the introduction of the Homecoming seasonal event, but whatever happened to Tamaran due to the break of the Source Wall and Starfire's adventure is never mentioned in the game.; Based on Starfire's words and the fact that they were adapting the events that occurred between the two Metal Wars, that episode would've adapted the events of Justice League Odyssey (2018-2020). The comics feature prominent DC characters that were yet to be introduced in the game, including Blackfire, Green Lantern Jessica Cruz, Azrael, and Red Lantern Dex-Starr; Starfire would've returned along with Cyborg, Orion and Darkseid - the latter two would make a brief apparition in the following episode, Wonderverse (similarly to Starfire in Birds of Prey, their cameo didn't pay off during the Source Saga storyline).

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Stryker's Island has come under new management: a psychopathic, ragebound Gorilla Grodd!"

sections.title: Part 1: Stryker's Island: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location: Under some pipes in a corner before cell block 2

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane at Daily Planet Live. Metropolis residents will recognize Stryker's Correctional Facility as the iron-clad island just outside of Metropolis. Now, with the rise of the new generation of villains, the prison is filled to overflowing. Stryker's staff continues to deny reports of internal corruption and understaffing, insisting that their facility provides the best, safest and most humane prison environment for meta, magic and tech villains threatening the city."

sections.title: Part 2: Stryker's Island: Jack Ryder
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location: West guard watch room of cell block 2

Briefing: Jack Ryder: " This is Jack Ryder, and YOU ARE WRONG! Why? Because you think once criminals go to jail, they STAY THERE! Just look at Stryker's outside of Metropolis. Place looks like a fort, right? No way any of those super-powered tech-crazy magic-loving baby-eating villain maniacs could EVER bust out of THERE, right? Sorry, friend - but YOU ARE WRONG!"

sections.title: Part 3: Stryker's Island: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location: South end of Evidence room, behind an evidence cabinet

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live. The Rogues, Keystone City's notorious group of criminals, were transferred today to Stryker's Island, where they await trial. Captain Cold, Mirror Master, Heat Wave, and Weather Wizard continue to insist on their innocence. Lex Luthor himself has taken an interest in their cause and is providing legal representation free of charge."

sections.title: Part 4: Stryker's Island: Scientist
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location: Above a turbine generator-looking structure in the room before the containment Chamber

Briefing: Scientist:" This is STAR Labs to Stryker's. Hello? We've found the piece the Flash removed from Grodd's headgear. Do you need it? It might snap him out of that coma. Or, you know, it might allow him to broadcast to everyone there...Oh, I guess we wouldn't want that! Well, if you want it, just call."

sections.title: Part 5: Stryker's Island: Lex Luthor
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location: Third cell in Containment chamber lower level

Briefing: Lex Luthor:" This is Luthor to Stryker's Command. Are you trying to anger me? I do not appreciate your hostile and aggressive respones to the Society's earlier requests for information. So one last time: where is Mirror Master? He has failed to arrive for the hearing the Society arranged for him in Metropolis. In light of our...future dealings...I demand you contact the Society immediately."

sections.title: Part 6: Stryker's Island: Superman
items: Zone: Metropolis
Instance: Stryker's Island Penitentiary (Alert)
Location: The room after the Evidence room

Briefing: Superman:" Superman at the Watchtower contacting Stryker's with urgent information from STAR Labs. They've analyzed Grodd's failed primal mind control tech. It created a fatal feedback loop which may have affected Grodd himself. Get Grodd in deep psychic lockdown, or activate the time stasis cell we developed for Vandal Savage - otherwise his mind could affect everyone at Stryker's."
