title: The Amazon Queen (Briefings)
summary: The Amazon Queen is a Global Briefing that can be found in the duos Port of Paradise and Supply Lines as well as the alert Themyscira Divided. There are six parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Amazon Fury Part I episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Amazon Queen is a Global Briefing that can be found in the duos Port of Paradise and Supply Lines as well as the alert Themyscira Divided. There are six parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the Amazon Fury Part I episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: Hippolyta, Queen of the Amazons, and mother to Wonder Woman, has lived a long life, filled with both joy and sorrow -- collect these magical recordings to visit a few of these moments in time.

sections.title: Part 1: Profound Loneliness
items: Zone: Port of Paradise
Region: Themyscira: Storage District
Location:

Briefing: "My Queen. We are blessed to see you here at the temple." -- "Wise priestess Sorreto, I come to you seeking guidance. While Paradise Island truly is such and I am greatful to the goddesses I feel... a loneliness that I do not understand. I am surrounded by my sisters and serve them with all the love in my heart." -- "Honorable Hippolyta, you have so much selfless love to give, I believe your heart desires to be a mother to more than your people."

sections.title: Part 2: A Moment of Pride
items: Zone: Supply Lines
Region: Themyscira: Storage District
Location:

Briefing: "Remove your helm, champion, and reveal the identity of our victor. Let your sisters see the face of our new representitive to the mortal world." [Ohhs and ahhs] "Mother, forgive me for going against your orders, but I must do this duty for our people" -- "Diana, the mortal world is not like Themyscira. It is treacherous and is plagued by deceit. You will face endless chellenges." -- "I am prepared, mother" -- "I know... and you will make me proud."

sections.title: Part 3: A Great Sorrow
items: Zone: Port of Paradise
Region: Themyscira: Storage District
Location:

Briefing: "Brainiac's trespass on Themyscira was a dark day for the Amazons. His invasion attacked that which we hold most sacred, the sanctity of our island and our duty to protect the Gate of Tartarus. This breach could threaten the entire world with chaos, war and death. I pray to the gods that we can stop this wave of darkness this before it shadows the world."

sections.title: Part 4: Amazon Fury
items: Zone: Themyscira Divided
Region: Themyscira: Palace District
Location:

Briefing: "Release the dogs of war, my sisters. No longer will we sit by and let the mortals poison the earth with their cowardess, their own feeble. And they have failed to defend our world from Brainiac. This weakness resulted in the desecration of our home and the loss of our sisters. It is time. They must answer for their failures."

sections.title: Part 5: Treason
items: Zone: Themyscira Divided
Region: Themyscira: Palace District
Location:

Briefing: "Diana's betrayal is treason. Once captured she will be imprisoned at the Gate of Tartarus as a warning to all who defy me." -- "Hippolyta, if I may say, you have grown quite the appetite for war and death, hehe. Don't get me wrong. It's quite becoming of you."

sections.title: Part 6: Enemies of the Crown
items: Zone: Themyscira Divided
Region: Themyscira: Palace District
Location:

Briefing: "Queen Hippolyta, the magic barrier we placed over Gotham will allow us to hunt down all that's left of Brainiac." -- "My enemies in Gotham City do not stop with Brainiac. The mortals will suffer for their weakness and cowardess. I will bring them a war they will never forget." -- "My, your majesty, that sounds positively divine, hehehe."

Briefing: Batman:" Batman, recording XXX-I-9. Brainiac has bottled large areas of Gotham in some kind of resistant encryption. So far we've managed to hold the line here and in Metropolis. Now we need to find a way to take out that bottling technology."

items: Zone: Batcave

items: Zone: Batcave
Region: Batcave: Inner Sanctum

The Justice League has faced threats of this kind before, but this one has changed our entire world. Future Luthor was desperate. I am increasing security at the Batcave and bringing the new drone defenses online."

sections.title: Overview
items: The Black Eulogy is a collection of investigations that can be found scattered across the Atlantis open world and within the Atlantis: The Throne Raid. There are 7 parts that comprise this set.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: A set of logs from the Sea-Devil himself, detailing events between the attack on Spindrift Station and the Rise of King Rath.

sections.title: Part 1: Damnation
items: Zone: Atlantis

Location: Go over the bridge above King Shark. Follow the bridge to the North and cross the first arch until you see a path on the ground below. Follow the path towards the West passing the two smaller bridges, then stop and look at your right. The node is on the ledge of the tower closest to you.

Investigation: Black Manta: " The coward... He was not man enough to finish me. Instead he abandons me here to drown in the carcass of his failure, Spindrift Station, pinned to the floor by rubble, waiting for death to take me. If vengeance holds any weight to the gods of his infernal people... Grant me salvation to seek my revenge..."

sections.title: Part 2: Salvation
items: Zone: Atlantis

Location: Go to the Northwest corner of the map and look for an Atlantis Statue - Victory on the roofs by the Courtyard with the Silent School Adepts (one of the areas for the Loss of Leadership mission). From the statue, follow the path heading south until you're next to a water dome. The node is southeast of the dome, on the floor.

Investigation: Black Manta: " I am alive, but how I am unclear. A man named Rath claims to be my savior. He is one of them, but different, common. He has promised me that in exchange for my help in gaining the throne of Atlantis, the Aquaman's death would be at my hands."

sections.title: Part 3: Concession
items: Zone: Atlantis

Location: In the Eastern half of the map, look for a Atlantis Statue - Tribute on the roofs. Look down from that statue to the floor below, and find a broken statue holding a trident by one of the paths. The trident is pointing to a building with a yellow dome; he node is on the front of the small tower next to it.

Investigation: Black Manta: " This Corum Rath is a resourceful confederate. His hatred for Arthur and all of the aristocracy of Atlantis is a powerful motivator. It almost rivals mine, but I sense he has other motives that drive him while I have a singular purpose."

sections.title: Part 4: Sacrifice
items: Zone: Atlantis

Location: Follow the center bridge the North until you're standing in front of its last arch. Go to the massive tower to the East right next to the bridge and look down. The node is on the smaller bridge connecting the tower to the building with a water dome to the south.

Investigation: Black Manta: " I have been the unseen hammer that drives the nails into Arthur's reign as King. Stirring up unrest with both Atlantis and his allies topside, have fed the fires of dissent and allowed Rath to use his silver-tongued, patriotic demagoguery to turn Arthur's people against him. Satisfying work, yet pales in comparison to what I will do to him."

sections.title: Part 5: Fulfillment
items: Zone: Atlantean Royal Palace
Region: Atlantis Throne Room
Instance: Atlantis: The Throne
Location: In the second of the small rooms towards the Throne Room around the first left wall.

Investigation: Black Manta: " Rath is finally in position to seize the throne. All is going according to our plan. Arthur will be denounced as King, Rath will take the throne, and I will be there to end his life. In twenty four hours, Atlantis will have a new king and Aquaman will be buried in a shallow grave under the sea floor."

sections.title: Part 6: Loss
items: Zone: Atlantean Royal Palace
Region: Atlantis Throne Room
Instance: Atlantis: The Throne
Location: Up the stairs in the entrance hall at the far end of the far center wall.

Investigation: Black Manta: " No! This cannot be! I am blocked from the palace by a quagmire of magical thorns, denying me Arthur's death! Rath swore he would be mine! Does this venomous snake dare to make an enemy of the Sea-Devil himself? Rath will answer for this. And if Arthur Curry is dead when I arrive, then Atlantis will need yet another King to sit on the throne."

sections.title: Part 7: Nemesis
items: Zone: Atlantean Royal Palace
Region: Ritual Feeding Chamber
Instance: Atlantis: The Throne
Location: Behind the entrance at the right side in the near corner.

Investigation: Black Manta: " This will be my final entry. Not even Corum Rath's duplicity could keep Arthur Curry safe from my vengeance. Fate has screamed out its verdict and in mere moments, Aquaman will be no more. My oath, my life's purpose, my glorious vindication will all culminate and fate will dine well on my retribution."

The Flashing Lights of Gotham is a global briefing that can be found in the Flashpoint Gotham City open world, the duo FP: Queen's Row Penitentiary and the 4-player operation FP: The Royal War. There are six parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the World of Flashpoint episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The glitz and glam of Flashpoint Gotham City."

sections.title: Part 1: The Oracle of Catwoman
items: Zone: Flashpoint Gotham City
Region: Psi-Ops deployment area
Location: On the block northwest of Subject Doomsday battlefield, between the two smaller buildings.

Briefing: Flashpoint Oracle: " Back when I was Catwoman, I thought the only way to get up in life was to shove someone else down. Batman changed all of that, showed me that when I lift up others, I get lifted up, too. I like the life I have now. My old entry skills come in handy, it's just mostly electronic now."

images.label: The Flashing Lights of Gotham - The Oracle of Catwoman

sections.title: Part 2: Flashpoint Joker
items: Zone: Flashpoint Gotham City
Region: Wayne Enterprises
Location: On the lowest balcony facing north.

Briefing: Flashpoint Oracle: " I can't imagine a Joker worse than our Joker. She targets children. Children! And because she's so special to Batman, he refuses to deal with her properly. He still thinks he can cut through all of her grief and reach the real her. But the woman she was died that night when Joe Chill pulled the trigger."

images.label: The Flashing Lights of Gotham - Flashpoint Joker

sections.title: Part 3: Bending with the Wind
items: Zone: Flashpoint Gotham City
Location: On the top of the shortest tower of the building on the third block from Iceberg Lounge and west of the hospital.

Briefing: ´ Flashpoint Penguin: " I'm not like the rest of those ninnies who couldn't feel the winds of change. All I have to do is draw criminals in with the flashing lights and look the other way when they earn their final payout. Here more than most, the house always wins."

images.label: The Flashing Lights of Gotham - Bending with the Wind

sections.title: Part 4: What Really Matters
items: Zone: Atlantis Frontline
Instance: FP: The Royal War
Location: After leaving the safezone, ahead inside the cavern right ahead.
Briefing: Flashpoint Batman: " Money, power, and fame are just crude instruments. What Flash has offered throws that in sharp relief."

images.label: The Flashing Lights of Gotham City - What Really Matters

sections.title: Part 5: Former Surgeon
items: Zone: Queen's Row Penitentiary
Instance: FP: Queen's Row Penitentiary
Location: In the hallway after passing the area with the on-storming mobs, inside a cell to the south.
Briefing: Flashpoint Batman: " I used to be surgeon to the people of Gotham. Now I'm surgeon to Gotham itself, and there's a lot left to cut."

images.label: The Flashing Lights of Gotham - Former Surgeon

sections.title: Part 6: Green Arrow Industries
items: Zone: Flashpoint Gotham City
Region: Penitentiary
Location: In a recess in the tower of the building in front of the GCPD Headquarters.

Briefing: Flashpoint Oracle: " Queen's Row Penitentiary has tried to swoop up Gotham's criminals in the past. Their CEO has some wild idea about being a hero by reusing villain gadgets. Batman always knew it was a bad idea that would blow up in their faces. Now it looks like it's going to blow up on our doorstep instead. Think Mr. Queen'll face justice, or will he quiver and hide behind the excuse of green judgement?"

images.label: The Flashing Lights of Gotham - Green Arrow Industries

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Flashpoint Oracle, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " My Gotham's been through a lot. But the fact that we've suffered through it together makes us that much more willing to come together when we really need it. I believe in Gotham, that it can be better. I have to. Otherwise, what am I doing with my life? Anyway, take this for listening to me ramble."

title: The Path to Perdition (Briefings)
summary: The Path to Perdition is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Gotham Wastelands, the Tunnel of Lust, Ruined Cathedral, Knightsdome Arena and the Trigon's Prison alert. There are twelve parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Path to Perdition is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Gotham Wastelands, the Tunnel of Lust, Ruined Cathedral, Knightsdome Arena and the Trigon's Prison alert. There are twelve parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Sin permeates the Gotham Wastelands, chipping away at the souls within it's hellish borders. It's effects can be damaging and everlasting.

sections.title: Part 1: Perdition: Envy
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Knightsdome Wastelands
Location: Southwest corner in the ruins of Ace Chemicals, hidden between a chimney and a building wall.

Briefing: Jesse's Follower: Jesse, do you even hear me? Do you listen to your most devoted follower? Jacob listens to his devotees... Why do they deserve better than I? I've given myself to you! I want something in return!

sections.title: Part 2: Perdition: Envy
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Knightsdome Arena
Location: Inside the room near the safezone, behind a busted Row of File Cabinets.

Briefing: Jesse's Follower: Jesse, I demand that you answer my calls to you. Jared listens to his disciples. He fills then with wrath, and grants them unimaginable power! Why can't I have what they have...?

sections.title: Part 3: Perdition: Envy
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Knightsdome Arena
Location: Inside the arena per se, near the wall East from the entrance.

Briefing: Jesse's Follower: Jesse! I MUST have your attention! Why does everyone else get your ear but not me! I will not give up until I have more power than the other cultists. They don't deserve what they have. I gave my life to my master. I DESERVE IT.

sections.title: Part 4: Perdition: Lust
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Ruins of Amusement Mile
Location: Behind Tunnel of Lust, up in a recess in the rocks near the ceiling.

Briefing: Fanatic of Lust: Jacob, are you out there? Listening? I've been chosen. They've selected me to join your followers. To worship you. They say your[SIC] irresistible. I'm just glad they didn't put me in a labor camp.

sections.title: Part 5: Perdition: Lust
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Tunnel of Lust
Location: In the first room after the safezone, on the second floor.
Briefing: Fanatic of Lust: Jacob, are you there? It's me. I've devoted myself to becoming your greatest disciple. You will be so proud of me. You won't need any other followers...

sections.title: Part 6: Perdition: Lust
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Tunnel of Lust
Location: On a swan pedal boat in the tunnel before Jacob.

Briefing: Fanatic of Lust: Jacob? I know you're listening. I know it because I am your favorite! You want me above all others. In fact... I'll get rid of the others! Yes. That will prove my love to you. I'll see you soon.

sections.title: Part 7: Perdition: Wrath
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Cathedral Outskirts
Location: Right next of Ruined Cathedral, inside the structure to the left.

Briefing: Jared's Follower: Jared, I know you hear all. You are true wrath. Unlike my brothers and sisters -- for they are weak! They take pleasure in pitting the drudges against each other. This is not for sport! It is for wrath!

sections.title: Part 8: Perdition: Wrath
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Ruined Cathedral
Location: In the room where you fight Jared, above a door to the West.

Briefing: Jared's Follower: Jared, your flock is straying! They are fools and have forgotten what we bleed for. My superior humiliated me in front of the others... They found his body this morning. Burned badly. Now I am the superior. I will do great things in your name!

sections.title: Part 9: Perdition: Wrath
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Ruined Cathedral
Location: Choosing the middle cog when requested, inside the room in the middle of West Tower, in the room where you fight Smoldering Wrath.
Briefing: Jared's Follower: Jared, hear me! My subordinates are weak! They are not true believers. They have strayed from you will. I will slaughter them in your name! For Jared, he who IS vengeance!

sections.title: Part 10: Perdition: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Mausoleum Grounds
Location: Close to the great beam spawning Grand Watchers.

Briefing: Wonder Woman: Wonder Woman, daily report. Circe clearly has an ulterior motive for releasing Trigon. I know her far too well to expect her to stand by and let anyone other than herself be worshipped. I just wish she realized the gravity of waking a sleeping giant.

sections.title: Part 11: Perdition: Circe
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Trigon's Prison
Location: By the second staircase room (after the Prominent Family ghosts), above the entrance

Briefing: Circe: Cult of Blood, Circe speaks to you! Triumph is at hand, thanks to the Victory Stone. Taken ages ago from Alexander the Great by one of my most loyal bestiamorphs, I have kept the weakened gemstone in secret. But, soon, it will be recharged...soon, I will have incomprehensible power!

sections.title: Part 12: Perdition: Circe
items: Zone: Gotham Wastelands
Region: Trigon's Prison
Location: In the room where you fight the Avatar of Sin, behind the rocks to the North

Briefing: Circe: Cult of Blood, heed Circe's words! You will help me break through the barrier that imprisons Trigon! Once his mystical restraints are fractured, my own magics will be able to siphon Trigon's infinite evil to recharge the Victory Stone.

sections.title: Rewards
items: Upon completion of this briefing collection players receive a message from either Nightwing, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail message
rows: " Where did you get these messages? Their importance is pretty significant...and boy, cultists are creepy. I'll let Wonder Woman know. Thanks."

title: The Prime Battle (Briefings)
summary: The Prime Battle is an episode briefing that can be found in the The Prime Battleground raid. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the The Battle for Earth episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Prime Battle is an episode briefing that can be found in the The Prime Battleground raid. There are five parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the The Battle for Earth episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " This is it, ground zero of Brainiac's plan to tap into the immense power at the Earth's core, the center of the multiverse."

sections.title: Part 1: Prime Battle: Lois Lane
items: Zone: The Prime Battleground
Location: As you head from the entrance to the arena, clearly visible a little right at the wall

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane with a special report from behind enemy lines. I've been trailing a group of villains... Or are they heroes? I don't know - either way, they've fought their way inside the bottled Gotham Central and I can't believe what I'm seeing! It's like... mega versions of those massive Brainiac robots... unbelievable! I'm going to move in for a closer look... Eep. Okay, maybe not."

images.label: Locations - The Prime Battle - Lois Lane

sections.title: Part 2: Prime Battle: Seismologist
items: Zone: The Prime Battleground
Location: On the far side of the long building on the right, on the terrace slightly left

Briefing: Seismologist Dr. Archer:" Seismic Investigation Log - Entry 36c. Doctor Archer. I've checked and rechecked our data and I still can't believe it. Even if he's an allen I don't see how he could manage something of this scale. I mean... its geophysically impossible and complete insane. Is he trying to dig to hell?"

sections.title: Part 3: Prime Battle: Lex Luthor (Future)
items: Zone: The Prime Battleground

Location: On the roof top just right from the entrance in a vortex. Drop down into the center of the vortex, on the 'H', and you will be in the calm eye of the vortex, being able to grap the briefing.

Briefing: Future Lex Luthor:" I've recorded this message for posterity. So that future generations can experience the moment of my glorious victory. By the time you listen to this my plan has succeeded. And, well, I think I deserve some time to boast seeing as I've fooled everyone - even myself and the "World's Greatest Detective". I knew what Brainiac was after at the center of the Earth... The very nexus of reality. The center... of the multiverse!"

images.label: Locations - The Prime Battle - Lex Luthor (Future)

sections.title: Part 4: Prime Battle: Batman (Future)
items: Zone: The Prime Battleground

Location: On the far side of the rooftop of the right side building, encased in an energy field. There are three consoles, which need to be used in the order 1-3-2, seen from behind the consoles and looking at the energy field. This will shut down the energy field.

Briefing: Future Batman:" Record Omega 12: Luthor seems genuine in his desire to cooperate since Brainiac's Invasion. But the hand he extended in peace was wet with the blood of my dearest friends. I will never forgive him for the death of Superman and Wonder Woman. I will never trust him. The contingency plan is prepared."

sections.title: Part 5: Prime Battle: Brainiac
items: Zone: The Prime Battleground
Location: Left from the entrance in another red energy field. You need to use the container, fight off the adds, which will finally shut down the energy field.

Briefing: Brainiac:" Citizens. Remain calm. Your existence as individuals nears its end. My objective to uncover the nexus of the multiverse will soon be complete. You are fortunate, for you will bear witness to the destruction of the multiverse and the conception of a single, universal conciousness."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Batman or Lex Luthor, accessible from any Mail Terminal.
Heroes:
Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Lex Luthor is as underhanded as they come. I'm going to examine all that we're learned from the encounter at GCPD Headquartes. The information you've gathered will help."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Blast! I should have known I couldn't trust my future self. How infuriating! Well, at least now I know the extent of the operation at the center of the Earth. That power will be mine."

title: Themyscira: Oathbound (Briefings)
summary: Themyscira: Oathbound is an global briefing that can be found in Themyscira during the Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus raid. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the The Battle for Earth episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Themyscira: Oathbound is an global briefing that can be found in Themyscira during the Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus raid. There are four parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of the The Battle for Earth episode.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Long ago, Terridus and his army of men trespassed on Themyscira and challenged the Amazons in battle. This is the epic tale of what became of them."

sections.title: Part 1: Themyscira: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus
Region: Themyscira
Location: On the North side of the Courtyard of the Slumbering Colossus, on the second storey behind a pillar

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " Terridus made such a war on the Amazons of Themyscira, his great helm a symbol of his battle fury. He cut the ground beneath him with his feet as he strode, and his soldiers stained the land with trident and spear and bow."

sections.title: Part 2: Themyscira: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus
Region: Themyscira
Location: Above the exit gate of Paradise Court (second boss fight), behind a pillar

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " The soldiers of Themyscira have passed down a tale of man's world and its dangers. Terridus, son of Andraemon, sailed to the lands of myth and legend on a sorcerous breeze. Paradise Island he found, and gazing on it from his flagship the warrior vowed he would never leave its shores."

sections.title: Part 3: Themyscira: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus
Region: Themyscira
Location: On ground level on the South side of the Courtyard of the Slumbering Colossus, next to a Peasant Woman Statue at the wall

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " Finally the warmonger Terridus faced Hippolyta, the great matron of Paradise Island, in single combat. Set in array against him, she held her own against his blade with a glad heart. Though Terridus and his soldiers were mighty, the numbers ranged against them were greater, and fiercer, and more courageous."

sections.title: Part 4: Themyscira: Wonder Woman
items: Zone: Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus
Region: Themyscira
Location: On the far left side of the Forum of the Five (final fight) on top of some rubble

Briefing: Wonder Woman: " With a blow of steel on steel that rang across the world, Hippolyta laid Terridus low. But the Gods did not forgive the warmonger or his armies and allow them escape into Tartarus. Instead they were righted, and armed, and clad in casts of earth and metal and stone. To this day, Terridus and his army stands watch, defending the shores of Paradise Island from those who might follow their example."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this briefing players receive a message from Wonder Woman or Circe, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " The fate of Terridus and his men serves as a warning to those who wish to violate Paradise Island. Do not worry, friend, you were invited! Your assistance to the Amazons will not be forgotten."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " What an amusing tale. Terridus and his soldiers fell to Hippolyta and the Amazons because they were feeble, mortal men. I will not fail, the Amazons will kneel before me!"

title: Titans Among Us (Briefings)
summary: Titans Among Us is a global briefing that can be found on Titans Island, in the Titans Training Sim duo, and in the Titans Targeted! alert. There are six parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Teen Titans: The Judas Contract.

sections.title: Overview
items: Titans Among Us is a global briefing that can be found on Titans Island, in the Titans Training Sim duo, and in the Titans Targeted! alert. There are six parts that comprise this briefing. It is part of Teen Titans: The Judas Contract.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Key members of the Titans reflect on what being a Titan means to them."

sections.title: Part 1: Roots
items: Zone: Titans Island
Location: On top of Cyborg's workshop.

Briefing: Nightwing:" The Titans are my roots. I was a founding member of the original Teen Titans, oh sorry the "Junior Justice League". It's incredible how many years of my life I've spent as a Titan. What's more incredible is how deeply the Titans and each member of the team have shaped who I am. You could say I grew up a Titan."

sections.title: Part 2: Family
items: Zone: Titans Training Sim
Region: Titans Tower
Location: Next to the poster closest to the large TV set.

Briefing: Starfire:" For me, the Titans are a family. They are the first people I ever met after arriving on Earth. Nightwing was the first Earthling I ever kissed...even if it was just to learn English. He was also my first love. In my time on the team, I have learned to become a leader and in some ways a mother. It has prepared me in so many ways for everything life could offer."

sections.title: Part 3: Home
items: Zone: Titans Targeted!
Region: Titans Tower
Location: In Cyborg's room, behind a large box next to the door.

Briefing: Cyborg:" The Titans? The Titans are home to me. After my accident, when even my father couldn't relate to me, the Titans took me in. No questions asked. They reminded me I belonged and had a place in the world, despite what I looked like. I built Titans Tower not just to be a sophisticated and advanced HQ, but to be the place we could all call home."

sections.title: Part 4: Hope
items: Zone: Titans Island
Location: On the upper cliffs at the Northwest corner of the island, near Raven's meditation spot.

Briefing: Raven:" I would say the Titans are a source of hope for me. Having battled demons both literal and emotional throughout my life, I am no stranger to despair. The Titans taught me to have hope. Seeing them overcome their own struggles and inner demons, while still helping others gave me hope. And hope is a powerful thing."

sections.title: Part 5: Fun
items: Zone: Titans Island
Region: Titans Tower
Location: In the main hub area on top of Titans Tower, behind the stairs leading to the helicopter pad.

Briefing: Beast Boy:" Ok...So to me...The Titans equal FUN! When I want to go all super-cali-freaky-ocious and dance until my paws, talons, underbelly or what have you hurt, guess who I call? Duh! The Titans! When I want to chillax and binge watch eleven hours straight of Angry Evil Kitchen Dude...Who do I call? Oh Yeah! The Titans! And when I'm jonesing for a super-mondo, double veggie, triple cheese pizza with all the works... Who do I call? Yup! And you know why? Because the Titans equal fun..."

sections.title: Part 6: Courage
items: Zone: Titans Island
Region: Titans Tower
Location: Near the base of Titan's Tower, next to the large red sign over the north door where the Giant Robot spawns

Briefing: Red Robin:" When I think of the Titans, I think of their courage. As Robin, I had some pretty big shoes to fill. Not to mention, tons of villains out to make an example of me. Even when I was scared, I couldn't let Batman know. When I joined the Titans though, I was amazed at how fearless these kids were. Over time, I learned that they weren't really fearless... They were just like me, except that together, they found courage in one another."

Villains:

rows: " Thanks for digging up these old interview clips. I'm going to take these with me to remind me why I'll always be a Titan."

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Excellent! These files will provide excellent insight into how to destroy the Titans from within. Remember, Psimon says, your enemies' greatest strengths are also their greatest weaknesses."

title: Trigon's Arrival (Briefings)
summary: Trigon's Arrival is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Unholy Matrimony operation. There are four parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Trigon's Arrival is a Global Briefing that can be found in the Unholy Matrimony operation. There are four parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Our universe is in peril now that Brother Blood has released a great terror upon it. Perhaps these oaths will shed light on this ternal darkness.

sections.title: Part 1: Trigon's Word
items: File:.png
File:Brief.1-1 Trigon's Arrival.png
Zone: Unholy Matrimony
Region: Trigon's Prison
Location: First room, near the lava.

Briefing: Trigon:" I will make this world's suffering beyond that of any I have conquered before. For what they have done to me, I will do one thousand times worse to them. Mountains of their flesh and bones will be my throne, for I am TRIGON, THE TERRIBLE!"

sections.title: Part 2: Blood's Machinations
items: File:.png
File:Brief.1-2 Trigon's Arrival.png
Zone: Unholy Matrimony
Region: Trigon's Prison
Location: Near to the entrance of the proper Trigon's Prison

Briefing: Brother Blood:" Circe's interference with Trigon's rise tore Raven assunder -- splitting her in twain. But through my machinations, the best Raven has not only survived, but she now thrives with ALL the power of Pride! No longer bound to her other half, she will be bound to me as the Bride of Blood. And all will tremble under our reign of terror!"

sections.title: Part 3: Blood's Sinful Success
items: File:.png
File:Brief.1-3 Trigon's Arrival.png
Zone: Unholy Matrimony
Region: Trigon's Prison
Location: In the Avatar of Sin's battlefield

Briefing: Brother Blood:" The sons of Trigon are too weak and foolish to properly use the sinful energy that they have collected. And each sin fights the others for power. What I know, what I truly know, is that the path to Trigon's glory is through ALL sins. That is why I have collected energy from each to fuel my ritual. And that is why Trigon is free!"

sections.title: Heroes
items: File:.png
File:Brief.1-4 Trigon's Arrival.png
Zone: Unholy Matrimony
Region: Hell's Doorway
Location: Hell's Shadow, above the entrance

Briefing: Raven:" My brothers are a product of their lineage and their environment. They are what they were born to be. I do pity them, but I will never forgive them for what they have done to my true family - the Titans. I cannot allow my father or my brothers to get a foothold in our reality. My new friends will give me the strength to stop them all!"

sections.title: Villains
items: File:.png
File:Brief.1-4 Trigon's Arrival.png
Zone: Unholy Matrimony
Region: Hell's Doorway
Location: Hell's Shadow, above the entrance

Briefing: Raven:" My brothers are weak-minded and weak-willed! They rival for father's doting affection, when they should be taking it for themselves. I will conquer them, Blood, Father, and the universe."

sections.title: Rewards
items: Upon completion of this briefing collection players receive a message from Raven, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

sections.title: Mail message
items: Heroes
Villains
Task Force X - Heroes

table.caption: Mail message
rows: " " At last, I can be at peace. Until sin spreads across our world again... Human weakness makes this inevitable. ""

table.caption: Mail message
rows: " " You were wise to give these messages to me. Now that my father is banished back to his prison, the greatest sin will spread across the world. Pride will take you all. ""

table.caption: Mail message
rows: " " You were wise to give these messages to me. Now that my father is banished back to his prison, the greatest sin will spread across the world. Pride will take you all. --FEED INTERRUPTED-- This is Amanda Waller. I see from your excursion in Hell, that you've been participating in the Task Force X initiative. Very good. Here is a reward that you may already have. Welcome to working for the government. ""

sections.title: Overview
items: Wartime Spy Notes is a Global Investigation that can be found in the Another Time and Space location of The Bombshell Paradox operation. There are five parts that comprise this investigation. It is part of Episode 15: Bombshell Paradox & Corrupted Zamaron.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " The Contessa Selina Digatti, aka "The Catwoman", delivers top-secret information to her contacts within the Allied powers."

sections.title: Part 1: Report: Powerful Family
items: Zone: Another Time and Space
Instance: The Bombshell Paradox
Location:

Investigation: The Catwoman:" In the wake of one of my most bacchanalian parties, I learned from a German intelligence officer that a very powerful, yet seclusive family has been spotted in Eastern Europe. The tremble in his voice belied his assurances that this old dynasty couldn't possibly threaten the fuhrer. I'm rather curious. Just how dangerous are these al Ghuls?"

sections.title: Part 2: Request Received: Break-In
items: Zone: Another Time and Space
Instance: The Bombshell Paradox
Location:

Investigation: The Catwoman: "This is the Contessa, confirming that I've received your request for assistance. A break-in at a munitions factory? I was hoping for a challenge. Leave this to me, I'll slip in unnoticed and show these little kittens what a real cat burglar can do."

sections.title: Part 3: Report: New Partner
items: Zone: Another Time and Space
Instance: The Bombshell Paradox
Location:

Investigation: The Catwoman:" My new partner is setting into the villa nicely. An American, quite adept in a fight and more than eager to wallop a few Nazis. However, I'm not so sure about a career as a spy. I mean...easy on the eyes...but a terrible liar. A little on the brooding side, but I like that. There's darkness behind those eyes...they have definitely seen war, but there has never been a war like this one."

sections.title: Part 4: Classified Message: The Lady Al Ghul
items: Zone: Another Time and Space
Instance: The Bombshell Paradox
Location:

Investigation: The Catwoman:" This is the Contessa with an urgent classified message: The Lady al Ghul, Talia, mistress of the secretive al Ghul family, has been spotted near the Soviet border. My contact in the area describes her as "madder than usual." She also mentioned something about Talia's right hand. She said that it was covered in "pure evil, as if cursed by 'Baba Yaga.'" What exactly are we dealing with here?"

sections.title: Part 5: Request for Back-Up
items: Zone: Another Time and Space
Instance: The Bombshell Paradox
Location:

Investigation: The Catwoman:" We know that the al Ghuls use their assassins to "influence" politics on a global scale, but this is something far more alarming. I may need back-up. I don't suppose the Batwoman is available? No? Aw. Well, maybe next time."

Villains:

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " This information is top-secret and your interdimensional travels are considered unsanctioned by the United States Government. We will be taking these reports off your hands immediately."

title: Watchtower Containment Facility (Briefings)
summary: Watchtower Containment Facility is a global briefing that can be found in the Watchtower Containment Facility (Alert) (PvE and Legends PvE). There are four parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: Watchtower Containment Facility is a global briefing that can be found in the Watchtower Containment Facility (Alert) (PvE and Legends PvE). There are four parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: " Something has gone horrible wrong in the depths of the Watchtower's Containment unit!."

sections.title: Part 1: Watchtower Containment: Lois Lane
items: Zone: Watchtower
Region: Watchtower Containment Facility
Location: In the hall where you fight the System Hacker on the far tube under the ceiling near the wall.

Briefing: Lois Lane:" This is Lois Lane with Daily Planet Live on the formation of the new Justice League Watchtower, in satellite orbit above the Earth. The new and improved Watchtower was designed to provide a meeting and training ground for the new generation of heroes. Funding was provided by Wayne Enterprises, Queen Industries, and the legacy of Ted Kord."

sections.title: Part 2: Watchtower Containment: Vicki Vale
items: Zone: Watchtower
Region: Watchtower Containment Facility
Location: In the large hall before you advance to Prince Ulgo left on top of the second energy field cell, the with the console facing towards Prince Ulgo's hall.

Briefing: Vicki Vale:" I'm Vicki Vale and this is JLA Watch! on Hawkman and Hawkgirl. These two warriors wear gear designed on Thanagar, made of a fabulous Nth metal that bestows strength, endurance, and flight. When not fighting with the JSA, Hawkman also heads the Justice League's arena training, enabling heroes to take the fight directly to contested battlegrounds."

sections.title: Part 3: Watchtower Containment: Booster Gold
items: Zone: Watchtower
Region: Watchtower Containment Facility
Location: In the hall where you fight Prince Ulgo near the near right corner behind a container.

Briefing: Booster Gold:" Oracle! Hey! Booster Gold. I think this is the right number... anyway, give me a call. I'm seeing definite merchandising opportunities with this whole Watchtower thing. I'm seeing hoodies, hats, even - wait for it - a sports drink! Something with the word Boost in it. Call me, this could be big."

sections.title: Part 4: Watchtower Containment: Sarah Charles
items: Zone: Watchtower
Region: Watchtower Containment Facility
Location: In the large hall next after you free Hawkman and Hawkgirl in the near corner left to the entrance on the basement level behind a column.

Briefing: Sarah Charles:" This is Doctor Sarah Charles at STAR Labs. Our remote analysis alarms were triggered by some sort of interference in your main core. I'm assuming it's some sort of tech glitch on our side? The readings are very subtle, but I wanted to bring it to your attention. Thanks."

sections.title: Mail Messages
items: Upon completion of this collection players receive a message from Lois Lane, accessible from any Mail Terminal.

table.caption: Mail Messages
rows: " Daily Planet News Brief: Representatives of the JLA's Watchtower facility released a terse report today noting an 'incident' in their maximum-security containment facility. The JLA went on to applaud the efforts of the new generation of heroes for its part in quelling the incident. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

items: This briefing rewards the player with one  token.

items: It is possible for villains to complete this briefing via Legends PvE.
The order of the nodes as you advance through the map is 2, 3, 1 and 4.

title: The War Around The World (Briefings)
summary: The War Around The World is an episode briefing that can be found during The Bombshell Paradox operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Overview
items: The War Around The World is an episode briefing that can be found during The Bombshell Paradox operation. There are five parts that comprise this briefing.

sections.title: Synopsis
items: In these war-time news reels, Lois Lane of the Daily Planet reports on the latest events of the War.

sections.title: Part 1: France Has Fallen
items: Zone: The Bombshell Paradox
Region: Another Time and Space
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with the Daily Planet News: The War Around the World. France has fallen to the Axis powers, but the British, Americans, and Russians stand tall. Powerful American industrialists such as Lex Luthor and Kate Kane have supported the war effort both at home and overseas."

sections.title: Part 2: Shadows in Europe
items: Zone: The Bombshell Paradox
Region: Another Time and Space
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with the Daily Planet News. Rumors of shadows in Eastern Europe have both the Allies and the Axis powers on alert. Enemies unseen until the soldiers last moments. One brave survivor could not describe what had attacked his squadron. Only that they were commanded by a black hand."

sections.title: Part 3: Bombshells
items: Zone: The Bombshell Paradox
Region: Another Time and Space
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with the Daily Planet News. The Bombshells Program has been dropped on the enemies of peace. Top secret national defense leaders have recruited sensational individuals to fight fascism wherever it spreads. But this reporter wonders just where these girls of justice came from."

sections.title: Part 4: United Against Aggression
items: Zone: The Bombshell Paradox
Region: Another Time and Space
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with the Daily Planet News: United Against Aggression. Scientists on order from the President, Prime Minister, and other Allied leaders have devised a method to fight the Axis and swiftly bring peace. When questioned, the president explained that this method is a wartime secret."

sections.title: Part 5: Secrets Revealed
items: Zone: The Bombshell Paradox
Region: Another Time and Space
Location:

Briefing: Lois Lane: " This is Lois Lane with...an independent update on the War Around the World. Disturbing news from undisclosed battlefronts. Monsters walk the Earth as the gears of war turn on the field of battle. Tears in the sky, some even on the ground! Is this machine versus magic? Americans have the right to know!"
